! Additive callback interface required by LSMR; the matrix changes between fixtures.
module example_matrix
   use lsmrDataModule,only:ip=>lsmr_ip,wp=>lsmr_wp
   implicit none
   real(wp),allocatable::matrix(:,:)
contains
   subroutine multiply(m,n,x,y)
      integer(ip),intent(in)::m,n
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(n)
      real(wp),intent(inout)::y(m)
      integer::i,j
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,m
            y(i)=y(i)+matrix(i,j)*x(j)
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine transpose_multiply(m,n,x,y)
      integer(ip),intent(in)::m,n
      real(wp),intent(inout)::x(n)
      real(wp),intent(in)::y(m)
      integer::i,j
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,m
            x(j)=x(j)+matrix(i,j)*y(i)
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine
end module
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/iterative-ls-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use lsmrModule,only:lsmr
   use example_matrix
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::shapes(2,6)=reshape([1,1,2,1,3,2,5,3,2,3,3,5],[2,6])
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),saved_a(:,:),b(:,:),saved_b(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:)
   real(real64),allocatable::expected(:,:),noise(:,:),x(:,:),v(:),r(:,:),d(:)
   real(real64)::value,z,rho,normalization,answer_error,residual_error,stationary,worst_x,worst_r,worst_s
   integer::status,iterations
   real(real64)::norm_a,condition,residual,normal_residual,norm_x
   integer::shape_id,m,n,k,is,rotation,level,i,j,l,c,fixtures,calls,nonzero
   fixtures=0; calls=0; nonzero=0; worst_x=0; worst_r=0; worst_s=0
   do shape_id=1,size(shapes,2)
      m=shapes(1,shape_id); n=shapes(2,shape_id); k=min(m,n)
      allocate(a(m,n),saved_a(m,n),b(m,3),saved_b(m,3),left(m,m),right(n,n))
      allocate(expected(n,3),noise(m,3),r(m,3),d(k))
      do is=1,size(scales)
         d=[(real(i,real64)*scales(is),i=1,k)]
         do rotation=1,2
            call orthogonal_factor(left,rotation); call orthogonal_factor(right,rotation)
            a=0
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,m
                  do l=1,k
                     a(i,j)=a(i,j)+left(i,l)*d(l)*right(j,l)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            do level=1,2
               rho=0
               if (level==2.and.m>n) rho=0.25_real64
               noise=0; expected=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     do l=1,k
                        z=real(2*l-c,real64)/4
                        expected(j,c)=expected(j,c)+right(j,l)*z
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (m>n) noise(:,c)=rho*c*left(:,n+1)
               end do
               if (rho>0) nonzero=nonzero+1
               b=noise
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        b(i,c)=b(i,c)+a(i,j)*expected(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               saved_a=a; saved_b=b
               allocate(x(n,3),v(n))
               do c=1,3
                  matrix=a
                  call lsmr(m,n,multiply,transpose_multiply,b(:,c),0.0_real64, &
                     1e-12_real64,1e-12_real64,1e8_real64,100,0,0,v,status,iterations, &
                     norm_a,condition,residual,normal_residual,norm_x)
                  if (status<0.or.status>2) error stop 'solver did not converge normally'
                  if (iterations<0.or.iterations>100) error stop 'iteration count'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'nonfinite solution'
                  x(:,c)=v
                  answer_error=maxval(abs(v-expected(:,c)))/max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(expected(:,c))))
                  if (answer_error>3e-12_real64) error stop 'known minimum-norm solution'
                  worst_x=max(worst_x,answer_error)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               if (any(a/=saved_a).or.any(b/=saved_b)) error stop 'inputs changed'
               r=-b
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        r(i,c)=r(i,c)+a(i,j)*x(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(b)))
               residual_error=maxval(abs(r+noise))/normalization
               if (residual_error>5e-12_real64) error stop 'known residual'
               worst_r=max(worst_r,residual_error)
               stationary=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     value=0
                     do i=1,m
                        value=value+a(i,j)*r(i,c)
                     end do
                     stationary=max(stationary,abs(value)/(normalization*max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(a)))))
                  end do
                  value=abs(sum(r(:,c)**2)-(rho*c)**2)/max(1.0_real64,(rho*c)**2)
                  if (value>1e-11_real64) error stop 'known residual norm'
               end do
               if (stationary>1e-11_real64) error stop 'normal-equation residual'
               worst_s=max(worst_s,stationary)
               deallocate(x,v)
               fixtures=fixtures+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,saved_a,b,saved_b,left,right,expected,noise,r,d)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=72.or.calls/=216.or.nonzero/=18) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Full-rank least-squares fixtures: ',fixtures,'; solver calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Overdetermined fixtures with prescribed nonzero residuals: ',nonzero
   print '(a)', 'Square/tall/wide; three vector RHS calls per fixture; zero damping.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized prescribed-residual error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized normal-equation residual: ',worst_s
   print '(a)', 'PASS lsmr-least-squares-reference'
contains
   subroutine orthogonal_factor(q,variant)
      real(real64),intent(out)::q(:,:)
      integer,intent(in)::variant
      real(real64)::norm
      integer::i,j,n
      n=size(q,1); q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (variant==1) return
      norm=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/norm
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine orthogonal_factor
end program main

name: gams-forsvd-spectrum-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/spectral-wrappers-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use forsvd, only: svd
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::shapes(2,6)=reshape([1,1,2,3,3,2,3,3,4,2,2,5],[2,6])
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),input(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:),u(:,:),vt(:,:),s(:),expected(:),d(:)
   real(real64)::value,normalization,reconstruction,orthogonal,worst_s,worst_r,worst_o,triplet,worst_t,lambda
   integer::shape_id,m,n,k,pattern,is,rotation,mode,i,j,l,b,c,cols_u,rows_v,calls,fixtures
   calls=0; fixtures=0; worst_s=0; worst_r=0; worst_o=0; worst_t=0
   do shape_id=1,size(shapes,2)
      m=shapes(1,shape_id); n=shapes(2,shape_id); k=min(m,n)
      allocate(a(m,n),input(m,n),left(m,m),right(n,n),expected(k),d(k))
      do pattern=1,4
         do is=1,size(scales)
            do i=1,k
               select case(pattern)
               case(1)
                  d(i)=real(k-i+1,real64)
               case(2)
                  d(i)=2
               case(3)
                  d(i)=0
                  if (i==1) d(i)=3
               case(4)
                  d(i)=0
               end select
            end do
            expected=d*abs(scales(is))
            d=d*scales(is)
            normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(d)))
            do rotation=1,2
               call orthogonal_factor(left,rotation)
               call orthogonal_factor(right,rotation)
               a=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,m
                     do l=1,k
                        a(i,j)=a(i,j)+left(i,l)*d(l)*right(j,l)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               fixtures=fixtures+1
               do mode=1,3
                  input=a
                  allocate(u(m,m),vt(n,n),s(k))
                  ! Only the first k columns/rows are returned in reduced mode.
                  u=0; vt=0; s=0
                  select case(mode)
                  case(1)
                     call svd(input,u,s,vt)
                  case(2)
                     call svd(input,u,s,vt,method='gesvd')
                  case(3)
                     call svd(input,u,s,vt,method='gesdd')
                  end select
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(s))) error stop 'nonfinite singular values'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(u(:,1:k)))) error stop 'nonfinite U'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(vt(1:k,:)))) error stop 'nonfinite VT'
                  cols_u=k; rows_v=k
                  value=maxval(abs(s-expected))/normalization
                  if (value>2e-12_real64) error stop 'known singular values'
                  worst_s=max(worst_s,value)
                  if (any(s<0)) error stop 'negative singular value'
                  do i=2,k
                     if (s(i)>s(i-1)) error stop 'singular value ordering'
                  end do
                  reconstruction=0; orthogonal=0
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,m
                        value=0
                        do l=1,k
                           value=value+u(i,l)*s(l)*vt(l,j)
                        end do
                        reconstruction=max(reconstruction,abs(value-a(i,j))/normalization)
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,cols_u
                     do i=1,cols_u
                        value=0
                        do l=1,m
                           value=value+u(l,i)*u(l,j)
                        end do
                        if (i==j) value=value-1
                        orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,rows_v
                     do i=1,rows_v
                        value=0
                        do l=1,n
                           value=value+vt(i,l)*vt(j,l)
                        end do
                        if (i==j) value=value-1
                        orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                     end do
                  end do
                  ! Independently check returned reduced singular-vector eigenspaces.
                  triplet=0
                  do j=1,cols_u
                     lambda=0
                     if (j<=k) lambda=s(j)**2
                     do i=1,m
                        value=0
                        do b=1,n
                           do c=1,m
                              value=value+a(i,b)*a(c,b)*u(c,j)
                           end do
                        end do
                        triplet=max(triplet,abs(value-lambda*u(i,j))/normalization**2)
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,rows_v
                     lambda=0
                     if (j<=k) lambda=s(j)**2
                     do i=1,n
                        value=0
                        do b=1,m
                           do c=1,n
                              value=value+a(b,i)*a(b,c)*vt(j,c)
                           end do
                        end do
                        triplet=max(triplet,abs(value-lambda*vt(j,i))/normalization**2)
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (triplet>1e-11_real64) error stop 'singular-vector eigenspace residual'
                  worst_t=max(worst_t,triplet)
                  if (reconstruction>5e-12_real64.or.orthogonal>5e-12_real64) &
                     error stop 'SVD reconstruction/orthogonality'
                  worst_r=max(worst_r,reconstruction); worst_o=max(worst_o,orthogonal)
                  if (allocated(u)) deallocate(u)
                  if (allocated(vt)) deallocate(vt)
                  deallocate(s)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,input,left,right,expected,d)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=144.or.calls/=432) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Known-spectrum rectangular matrices: ',fixtures,'; SVD calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Default/GESVD/GESDD; reduced factors, distinct/repeated/rank-one/zero spectra.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized singular-value error: ',worst_s
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar reconstruction error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar orthogonality error: ',worst_o
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar singular-vector residual: ',worst_t
   print '(a)', 'PASS forsvd-spectrum-reference'
contains
   subroutine orthogonal_factor(q,variant)
      real(real64),intent(out)::q(:,:)
      integer,intent(in)::variant
      real(real64)::norm
      integer::i,j,n
      n=size(q,1); q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (variant==1) return
      norm=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/norm
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine orthogonal_factor
end program main

name: gams-foreig-symmetric-reference

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/spectral-wrappers-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use foreig, only: eig
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[1,2,3,5]
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),input(:,:),saved(:,:),q(:,:),v(:,:),w(:),expected(:),d(:)
   real(real64)::normalization,t,value,residual,orthogonal,worst_w,worst_r,worst_o
   integer::in,n,pattern,is,rotation,i,j,k,calls,fixtures
   calls=0; fixtures=0; worst_w=0; worst_r=0; worst_o=0
   do in=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(in)
      allocate(a(n,n),input(n,n),saved(n,n),q(n,n),expected(n),d(n))
      do pattern=1,4
         do is=1,size(scales)
            do i=1,n
               select case(pattern)
               case(1)
                  d(i)=real(2*i-n-1,real64)
               case(2)
                  d(i)=2
               case(3)
                  d(i)=real(i-1,real64)
               case(4)
                  d(i)=0
               end select
            end do
            d=d*scales(is); expected=d
            call sort(expected)
            normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(d)))
            do rotation=1,2
               q=0
               do i=1,n
                  q(i,i)=1
               end do
               if (rotation==2) then
                  t=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,n
                        q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/t
                     end do
                  end do
               end if
               a=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     do k=1,n
                        a(i,j)=a(i,j)+q(i,k)*d(k)*q(j,k)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               fixtures=fixtures+1
               input=a
               ! Finite poison verifies that the API uses only the upper triangle.
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     if (i>j) &
                        input(i,j)=real(1000+17*i+31*j,real64)
                  end do
               end do
               saved=input
               call eig(input,v,w,method='syev')
               if (size(w)/=n) error stop 'eigenvalue shape'
               if (any(input/=saved)) error stop 'default input preservation'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(w))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenvalues'
               value=maxval(abs(w-expected))/normalization
               worst_w=max(worst_w,value)
               if (value>2e-12_real64) error stop 'known eigenvalues'
               if (any(shape(v)/=[n,n])) error stop 'eigenvector shape'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenvectors'
               residual=0; orthogonal=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     value=0
                     do k=1,n
                        value=value+a(i,k)*v(k,j)
                     end do
                     residual=max(residual,abs(value-w(j)*v(i,j))/normalization)
                     value=0
                     do k=1,n
                        value=value+v(k,i)*v(k,j)
                     end do
                     if (i==j) value=value-1
                     orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                  end do
               end do
               if (residual>5e-12_real64.or.orthogonal>5e-12_real64) &
                  error stop 'eigenvector residual/orthogonality'
               worst_r=max(worst_r,residual); worst_o=max(worst_o,orthogonal)
               calls=calls+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,input,saved,q,v,w,expected,d)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=96.or.calls/=96) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Known-spectrum symmetric matrices: ',fixtures,'; eigen calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Upper triangle with unused-lower-half poison; SYEV eigenvalues and eigenvectors.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized eigenvalue error: ',worst_w
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar eigenvector residual: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar orthogonality error: ',worst_o
   print '(a)', 'PASS foreig-symmetric-reference'
contains
   subroutine sort(x)
      real(real64),intent(inout)::x(:)
      real(real64)::tmp
      integer::i,j
      do i=2,size(x)
         tmp=x(i); j=i-1
         do while(j>=1)
            if (x(j)<=tmp) exit
            x(j+1)=x(j); j=j-1
         end do
         x(j+1)=tmp
      end do
   end subroutine sort
end program main

name: gams-regridpack-polynomial-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/regrid-rk45-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use regridpack_module,only:regrid
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[4,7,12]
   real(wp),parameter::scales(*)=[-2.0_wp,0.5_wp,3.0_wp]
   real(wp),allocatable::x(:),y(:),xx(:),q(:),expected(:),sx(:),sy(:),st(:)
   real(wp)::t,f,value,worst,normalization
   integer::n,m,is,grid,method,degree,i,j,c,idx,status,calls,points,rejected
   real(wp)::bad(4),out(2)
   calls=0; points=0; rejected=0; worst=0
   do is=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(is); m=4*n-2
      allocate(x(n),y(n),xx(m),q(m),expected(m),sx(n),sy(n),st(m))
      do grid=1,2
         do i=1,n
            t=real(i-1,wp)/real(n-1,wp)
            if (grid==2) t=t*t
            x(i)=-2+5*t
         end do
         idx=0
         do i=1,n-1
            do j=0,3
               idx=idx+1
               xx(idx)=x(i)+real(j,wp)*(x(i+1)-x(i))/4
            end do
         end do
         xx(m-1:m)=x(n)
         do c=1,size(scales)
            do method=1,3,2
               do degree=0,method
                  y=scales(c)*x**degree
                  expected=scales(c)*xx**degree
                  call checked_call(method)
               end do
            end do
            ! Linear interpolation of nonaffine data: independently locate intervals.
            y=scales(c)*x*x
            do j=1,m
               i=1
               do while(i<n-1)
                  if (xx(j)<=x(i+1)) exit
                  i=i+1
               end do
               f=(xx(j)-x(i))/(x(i+1)-x(i))
               expected(j)=(1-f)*y(i)+f*y(i+1)
            end do
            call checked_call(1)
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,y,xx,q,expected,sx,sy,st)
   end do
   ! Wrapper diagnostics: outputs on failed calls are intentionally not inspected.
   call regrid([0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[1.0_wp],[0.5_wp],out(:1),1,status)
   call expect_status(10)
   call regrid([0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[1.0_wp,2.0_wp],[0.5_wp],out(:1),2,status)
   call expect_status(6)
   call regrid([0.0_wp],[1.0_wp],[0.0_wp],out(:1),1,status)
   call expect_status(2)
   call regrid([0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[1.0_wp,2.0_wp],[0.5_wp],out(:1),3,status)
   call expect_status(2)
   call regrid([0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[1.0_wp,2.0_wp],[-0.1_wp],out(:1),1,status)
   call expect_status(3)
   call regrid([0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[1.0_wp,2.0_wp],[1.1_wp],out(:1),1,status)
   call expect_status(3)
   bad=[0.0_wp,1.0_wp,1.0_wp,3.0_wp]
   call regrid(bad,bad,[0.5_wp,2.5_wp],out,1,status)
   call expect_status(4)
   bad=[0.0_wp,1.0_wp,2.0_wp,3.0_wp]
   call regrid(bad,bad,[2.5_wp,0.5_wp],out,1,status)
   call expect_status(4)
   call regrid(bad,2*bad+1,[0.5_wp,2.5_wp],out,3,status)
   if (status/=0.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(out))) error stop 'recovery status'
   if (maxval(abs(out-[2.0_wp,6.0_wp]))>1e-12_wp) error stop 'recovery answer'
   calls=calls+1; points=points+2
   if (calls/=127.or.points/=3614.or.rejected/=8) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Successful regrids: ',calls,'; analytical value checks: ',points
   print '(a,i0)', 'Expected rejected requests: ',rejected
   print '(a)', 'Uniform/nonuniform grids; linear/cubic monomials and piecewise-linear references.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized interpolation error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS regridpack-polynomial-reference'
contains
   subroutine checked_call(interpolation)
      integer,intent(in)::interpolation
      sx=x; sy=y; st=xx
      call regrid(x,y,xx,q,interpolation,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'interpolation status'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(q))) error stop 'nonfinite values'
      if (any(x/=sx).or.any(y/=sy).or.any(xx/=st)) error stop 'changed input'
      normalization=max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(expected)))
      value=maxval(abs(q-expected))/normalization
      if (value>2e-12_wp) error stop 'analytical interpolation reference'
      worst=max(worst,value)
      calls=calls+1; points=points+size(q)
   end subroutine
   subroutine expect_status(code)
      integer,intent(in)::code
      if (status/=code) error stop 'unexpected rejection code'
      rejected=rejected+1
   end subroutine
end program

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/regrid-rk45-drivers-MIT.txt.
module reference_models
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   implicit none
   type model_parameters
      integer::family=0,calls=0
      real(wp)::rate=1
   end type
contains
   function exact(t,family,rate) result(y)
      real(wp),intent(in)::t,rate
      integer,intent(in)::family
      real(wp)::y(2),s
      s=rate*t
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         y=[exp(s),2*exp(-s)]
      case(2)
         y=[1+s+s*s,2-s+0.5_wp*s**3]
      case(3)
         y=[cos(s)+0.25_wp*sin(s),-sin(s)+0.25_wp*cos(s)]
      case default
         error stop 'unknown reference family'
      end select
   end function
   subroutine rhs(t,y,dydt,args)
      real(wp),intent(in)::t,y(:)
      real(wp),intent(out)::dydt(:)
      class(*),optional,intent(inout)::args
      real(wp)::s
      if (.not.present(args)) error stop 'missing callback state'
      select type(args)
      type is(model_parameters)
         args%calls=args%calls+1
         s=args%rate*t
         select case(args%family)
         case(1)
            dydt=args%rate*[y(1),-y(2)]
         case(2)
            dydt=args%rate*[1+2*s,-1+1.5_wp*s*s]
         case(3)
            dydt=args%rate*[y(2),-y(1)]
         case default
            error stop 'unknown callback family'
         end select
      class default
         error stop 'incorrect callback state'
      end select
   end subroutine
end module

program main
   use reference_models
   use diffeq,only:runge_kutta_45,ode_container
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter::rates(*)=[0.5_wp,2.0_wp],tolerances(*)=[1e-8_wp,1e-10_wp]
   type(runge_kutta_45)::solver
   type(ode_container)::model
   type(model_parameters)::parameters
   real(wp),allocatable::solution(:,:)
   real(wp)::times(17),saved_times(17),iv(2),saved_iv(2),reference(2),tol,error,worst,invariant
   integer::family,ir,it,direction,i,runs,points,rhs_calls
   runs=0; points=0; rhs_calls=0; worst=0
   model%fcn=>rhs
   do family=1,3
      do ir=1,size(rates)
         do direction=1,2
            do it=1,size(tolerances)
               tol=tolerances(it)
               times=[(real(i-1,wp)/8,i=1,17)]
               if (direction==2) times=times(17:1:-1)
               parameters=model_parameters(family,0,rates(ir))
               iv=exact(times(1),family,rates(ir)); saved_iv=iv; saved_times=times
               call solver%clear_buffer()
               call solver%set_absolute_tolerance(tol)
               call solver%set_relative_tolerance(tol)
               call solver%set_maximum_step_size(0.3_wp)
               call solver%solve(model,times,iv,args=parameters)
               solution=solver%get_solution()
               if (any(shape(solution)/=[17,3])) error stop 'requested output shape'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(solution))) error stop 'nonfinite solution'
               if (maxval(abs(solution(:,1)-times))>1e-13_wp) error stop 'incomplete requested times'
               if (any(times/=saved_times).or.any(iv/=saved_iv)) error stop 'changed inputs'
               if (parameters%calls<=0) error stop 'callback not evaluated'
               if (parameters%family/=family.or.parameters%rate/=rates(ir)) error stop 'changed model state'
               do i=1,17
                  reference=exact(times(i),family,rates(ir))
                  error=maxval(abs(solution(i,2:3)-reference))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(reference)))
                  if (error>50*tol) error stop 'analytical IVP reference'
                  worst=max(worst,error)
                  if (family==3) then
                     invariant=abs(sum(solution(i,2:3)**2)-1.0625_wp)
                     if (invariant>100*tol) error stop 'oscillator energy'
                  end if
                  points=points+1
               end do
               rhs_calls=rhs_calls+parameters%calls
               runs=runs+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (runs/=24.or.points/=408) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Analytical IVP runs: ',runs,'; requested solution points: ',points
   print '(a,i0)', 'RHS callback evaluations: ',rhs_calls
   print '(a)', 'Exponential/polynomial/oscillator; two rates, both directions and two tolerances.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS diffeq-rk45-reference'
end program

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/fitpack-polynomials-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use fitpack,only:fitpack_curve,FP_REAL,FP_FLAG,FITPACK_SUCCESS
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[8,13],orders(*)=[1,3,5]
   real(FP_REAL),parameter::scales(*)=[-2.0_FP_REAL,0.5_FP_REAL,3.0_FP_REAL]
   type(fitpack_curve)::curve
   real(FP_REAL),allocatable::x(:),y(:),saved_x(:),saved_y(:),values(:),nodes(:)
   real(FP_REAL)::targets(33),reference(33),scalar,t,worst,error,normalization
   integer(FP_FLAG)::status
   integer::is,n,grid,ik,k,degree,c,i,r,j,fits,checks
   fits=0; checks=0; worst=0
   targets=[(-0.5_FP_REAL+real(i-1,FP_REAL)/16,i=1,33)]
   do is=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(is)
      allocate(x(n),y(n),saved_x(n),saved_y(n))
      do grid=1,2
         do i=1,n
            t=real(i-1,FP_REAL)/real(n-1,FP_REAL)
            if (grid==2) t=t+0.2_FP_REAL*t*(1-t)
            x(i)=-0.5_FP_REAL+2*t
         end do
         if (grid==2) x=x(n:1:-1)
         do ik=1,size(orders)
            k=orders(ik)
            do degree=0,k
               do c=1,size(scales)
                  y=scales(c)*x**degree
                  saved_x=x; saved_y=y
                  status=curve%new_fit(x,y,smoothing=0.0_FP_REAL,order=k)
                  if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'polynomial fit status'
                  if (any(x/=saved_x).or.any(y/=saved_y)) error stop 'changed source data'
                  fits=fits+1
                  reference=scales(c)*targets**degree
                  values=curve%eval(targets,status)
                  if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'vector evaluation status'
                  if (size(values)/=33.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'vector values'
                  normalization=max(1.0_FP_REAL,maxval(abs(reference)))
                  error=maxval(abs(values-reference))/normalization
                  if (error>5e-12_FP_REAL) error stop 'vector polynomial reference'
                  worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+33
                  do i=1,33
                     scalar=curve%eval(targets(i),status)
                     if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status).or..not.ieee_is_finite(scalar)) &
                        error stop 'scalar evaluation status'
                     error=abs(scalar-reference(i))/normalization
                     if (error>5e-12_FP_REAL) error stop 'scalar polynomial reference'
                     worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+1
                  end do
                  ! Vector evaluation requires sorted targets, independently of source order.
                  if (grid==2) then
                     nodes=curve%eval(x(n:1:-1),status)
                     error=maxval(abs(nodes-y(n:1:-1)))
                  else
                     nodes=curve%eval(x,status)
                     error=maxval(abs(nodes-y))
                  end if
                  if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(nodes))) &
                     error stop 'source node evaluation'
                  error=error/max(1.0_FP_REAL,maxval(abs(y)))
                  if (error>5e-12_FP_REAL) error stop 'source node interpolation'
                  worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+n
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,y,saved_x,saved_y)
   end do
   call curve%destroy()
   if (curve%m/=0.or.allocated(curve%x).or.allocated(curve%y).or.allocated(curve%t)) &
      error stop 'curve destruction'
   if (fits/=144.or.checks/=11016) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Polynomial fits: ',fits,'; value references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'Degrees 1/3/5; uniform and reversed nonuniform data; scalar/vector overloads.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized value error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS fitpack-polynomial-values'
end program

program main
   use fitpack,only:fitpack_curve,FP_REAL,FP_FLAG,FITPACK_SUCCESS
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[8,13],orders(*)=[1,3,5]
   real(FP_REAL),parameter::scales(*)=[-2.0_FP_REAL,0.5_FP_REAL,3.0_FP_REAL]
   type(fitpack_curve)::curve
   real(FP_REAL),allocatable::x(:),y(:),saved_x(:),saved_y(:),values(:),nodes(:)
   real(FP_REAL)::targets(33),reference(33),scalar,t,worst,error,normalization
   integer(FP_FLAG)::status
   integer::is,n,grid,ik,k,degree,c,i,r,j,fits,checks
   fits=0; checks=0; worst=0
   targets=[(-0.5_FP_REAL+real(i-1,FP_REAL)/16,i=1,33)]
   do is=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(is)
      allocate(x(n),y(n),saved_x(n),saved_y(n))
      do grid=1,2
         do i=1,n
            t=real(i-1,FP_REAL)/real(n-1,FP_REAL)
            if (grid==2) t=t+0.2_FP_REAL*t*(1-t)
            x(i)=-0.5_FP_REAL+2*t
         end do
         if (grid==2) x=x(n:1:-1)
         do ik=1,size(orders)
            k=orders(ik)
            do degree=0,k
               do c=1,size(scales)
                  y=scales(c)*x**degree
                  saved_x=x; saved_y=y
                  status=curve%new_fit(x,y,smoothing=0.0_FP_REAL,order=k)
                  if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'polynomial fit status'
                  if (any(x/=saved_x).or.any(y/=saved_y)) error stop 'changed source data'
                  fits=fits+1
                  do r=0,k
                     reference=0
                     if (r<=degree) then
                        scalar=scales(c)
                        do j=0,r-1
                           scalar=scalar*real(degree-j,FP_REAL)
                        end do
                        reference=scalar*targets**(degree-r)
                     end if
                     normalization=max(1.0_FP_REAL,maxval(abs(reference)))
                     values=curve%dfdx(targets,order=r,ierr=status)
                     if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'vector derivative status'
                     if (size(values)/=33.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) &
                        error stop 'nonfinite vector derivative'
                     error=maxval(abs(values-reference))/normalization
                     if (error>1e-8_FP_REAL) error stop 'analytical vector derivative'
                     worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+33
                     do i=1,33
                        scalar=curve%dfdx(targets(i),order=r,ierr=status)
                        if (.not.FITPACK_SUCCESS(status).or..not.ieee_is_finite(scalar)) &
                           error stop 'scalar derivative status'
                        error=abs(scalar-reference(i))/normalization
                        if (error>1e-8_FP_REAL) error stop 'analytical scalar derivative'
                        worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+1
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,y,saved_x,saved_y)
   end do
   call curve%destroy()
   if (curve%m/=0.or.allocated(curve%x).or.allocated(curve%y).or.allocated(curve%t)) &
      error stop 'curve destruction'
   if (fits/=144.or.checks/=44352) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Polynomial fits: ',fits,'; derivative/value references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'Degrees 1/3/5; uniform and reversed nonuniform data; scalar/vector overloads.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized derivative/value error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS fitpack-polynomial-derivatives'
end program

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/diagonal-response-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use SpecialMatrices,only:diagonal,solve,dense
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[1,2,7,32]
   real(wp),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_wp,0.125_wp,8.0_wp]
   type(diagonal)::matrix
   real(wp),allocatable::d(:),saved_d(:),b(:,:),saved_b(:,:),expected(:,:),x(:,:),v(:),before(:,:),after(:,:)
   real(wp)::value,worst,residual,worst_r,normalization
   integer::is,n,pattern,c,i,j,fixtures,calls,checks
   fixtures=0; calls=0; checks=0; worst=0; worst_r=0
   do is=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(is)
      allocate(d(n),saved_d(n),b(n,4),saved_b(n,4),expected(n,4))
      do pattern=1,3
         do j=1,size(scales)
            do i=1,n
               select case(pattern)
               case(1)
                  d(i)=i
               case(2)
                  d(i)=(-1.0_wp)**i*(1+mod(i,3))
               case(3)
                  d(i)=2.0_wp**(mod(i,7)-3)
               end select
            end do
            d=d*scales(j); saved_d=d
            matrix=diagonal(d)
            before=dense(matrix)
            do c=1,4
               do i=1,n
                  expected(i,c)=real(2*i-3*c,wp)/8
                  if (c==4) expected(i,c)=0
                  b(i,c)=d(i)*expected(i,c)
               end do
            end do
            saved_b=b
            x=solve(matrix,b)
            if (any(shape(x)/=[n,4]).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'matrix solution'
            calls=calls+1
            do c=1,4
               v=solve(matrix,b(:,c))
               if (size(v)/=n.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'vector solution'
               normalization=max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(expected(:,c))))
               value=max(maxval(abs(x(:,c)-expected(:,c))),maxval(abs(v-expected(:,c))))/normalization
               if (value>2e-13_wp) error stop 'known diagonal solution'
               worst=max(worst,value)
               residual=0
               do i=1,n
                  normalization=max(1.0_wp,abs(b(i,c)),abs(d(i)*expected(i,c)))
                  residual=max(residual,abs(d(i)*x(i,c)-b(i,c))/normalization, &
                     abs(d(i)*v(i)-b(i,c))/normalization)
               end do
               if (residual>2e-13_wp) error stop 'diagonal residual'
               worst_r=max(worst_r,residual)
               calls=calls+1; checks=checks+2*n
            end do
            after=dense(matrix)
            if (any(after/=before).or.any(d/=saved_d).or.any(b/=saved_b)) error stop 'changed input'
            fixtures=fixtures+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(d,saved_d,b,saved_b,expected)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=36.or.calls/=180.or.checks/=3024) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Nonsingular diagonal fixtures: ',fixtures,'; solve calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known solution coordinate checks: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'One four-column RHS and four vector RHS calls; signed diagonals and zero RHS.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar residual: ',worst_r
   print '(a)', 'PASS specialmatrices-diagonal-reference'
end program

name: gams-dynamics-response-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/diagonal-response-drivers-MIT.txt.
module force_model
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   implicit none
   type force_state
      integer::pattern=1,calls=0
   end type
contains
   function physical_force(w,n,pattern) result(f)
      real(wp),intent(in)::w
      integer,intent(in)::n,pattern
      complex(wp)::f(n)
      integer::i
      do i=1,n
         f(i)=cmplx(real(i,wp)*(1+0.1_wp*w),real(pattern,wp)*(0.25_wp*i-0.2_wp*w),wp)
      end do
   end function
   subroutine forcing(w,f,args)
      real(wp),intent(in)::w
      complex(wp),intent(out)::f(:)
      class(*),optional,intent(inout)::args
      if (.not.present(args)) error stop 'missing force state'
      select type(args)
      type is(force_state)
         args%calls=args%calls+1
         f=physical_force(w,size(f),args%pattern)
      class default
         error stop 'incorrect force state'
      end select
   end subroutine
end module

program main
   use force_model
   use dynamics,only:frf,frequency_response,modal_excite
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter::frequencies(*)=[0.0_wp,0.5_wp,1.0_wp,1.5_wp,2.0_wp,2.5_wp,3.0_wp,4.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::alphas(*)=[0.1_wp,0.4_wp],betas(*)=[0.0_wp,0.05_wp]
   type(frf)::response
   type(force_state)::state
   procedure(modal_excite),pointer::callback
   real(wp),allocatable::mass(:,:),stiffness(:,:),lambda(:),modes(:)
   real(wp)::alpha,beta,w,value,worst,modal_error
   complex(wp),allocatable::f(:),expected(:)
   integer::n,ia,ib,pattern,i,iw,fixtures,checks
   callback=>forcing
   fixtures=0; checks=0; worst=0
   do n=1,3
      allocate(mass(n,n),stiffness(n,n),lambda(n),f(n),expected(n))
      lambda=[(real(i*i,wp),i=1,n)]
      mass=0; stiffness=0
      do i=1,n
         mass(i,i)=1
         stiffness(i,i)=lambda(i)
      end do
      do ia=1,size(alphas)
         alpha=alphas(ia)
         do ib=1,size(betas)
            beta=betas(ib)
            do pattern=1,2
               state=force_state(pattern,0)
               response=frequency_response(mass,stiffness,alpha,beta,frequencies,callback, &
                  modes=modes,args=state)
               if (any(shape(response%responses)/=[8,n])) error stop 'response shape'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(abs(response%responses)))) error stop 'nonfinite response'
               if (state%calls/=8.or.state%pattern/=pattern) error stop 'force callback state'
               if (any(response%frequency/=frequencies)) error stop 'frequency output'
               modal_error=maxval(abs(modes-sqrt(lambda)))
               if (modal_error>1e-12_wp) error stop 'known natural frequencies'
               do iw=1,size(frequencies)
                  w=frequencies(iw); f=physical_force(w,n,pattern); expected=0
                  do i=1,n
                     expected(i)=f(i)/cmplx(lambda(i)-w*w,w*(alpha+beta*lambda(i)),wp)
                  end do
                  value=maxval(abs(response%responses(iw,:)-expected))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(expected)))
                  if (value>1e-10_wp) then
                     print *, 'Mismatch n,alpha,beta,force,w,error:', &
                        n,alpha,beta,pattern,w,value
                     error stop 'closed-form harmonic response'
                  end if
                  worst=max(worst,value); checks=checks+n
               end do
               fixtures=fixtures+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(mass,stiffness,lambda,f,expected)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=24.or.checks/=384) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Harmonic response fixtures: ',fixtures,'; complex coordinate checks: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'Unit mass, diagonal stiffness only; broader failed probes retained separately.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized response error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS dynamics-response-reference'
end program

name: gams-orderpack-ranking-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/ranking-magic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:int32,real32,real64
   use M_orderpack,only:rank
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::lengths(*)=[0,1,2,3,4,7,8,15,16,31,32,63,64,127]
   integer(int32),allocatable::a(:)
   integer::n,i,j,pattern,fixtures,calls,permutations
   fixtures=0; calls=0; permutations=0
   do n=1,7
      a=[(int(i,int32),i=1,n)]
      call permute(1)
   end do
   do j=1,size(lengths)
      n=lengths(j)
      if (allocated(a)) deallocate(a)
      allocate(a(n))
      do pattern=1,6
         do i=1,n
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               a(i)=i-n/2
            case(2)
               a(i)=n-i
            case(3)
               a(i)=7
            case(4)
               a(i)=mod(i,3)-1
            case(5)
               a(i)=(-1)**i*i
            case(6)
               a(i)=mod(37*i+11,17)-8
            end select
         end do
         call check_rank()
      end do
   end do
   if (permutations/=5913.or.fixtures/=5997.or.calls/=23988) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exhaustive permutations through length seven: ',permutations
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Total ranking fixtures: ',fixtures,'; overload calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Integer32, real32, real64 and character keys; empty input, ties and boundary sizes.'
   print '(a)', 'Independent insertion-order reference; permutation integrity and input preservation.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS orderpack-ranking-reference'
contains
   recursive subroutine permute(first)
      integer,intent(in)::first
      integer::k,temp
      if (first>size(a)) then
         call check_rank()
         permutations=permutations+1
         return
      end if
      do k=first,size(a)
         temp=a(first); a(first)=a(k); a(k)=temp
         call permute(first+1)
         temp=a(first); a(first)=a(k); a(k)=temp
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine check_rank()
      integer::idx(size(a)),expected(size(a)),saved(size(a)),i,j,temp,mode
      real(real32)::single(size(a)),saved_single(size(a))
      real(real64)::double(size(a)),saved_double(size(a))
      character(len=4)::keys(size(a)),saved_keys(size(a))
      expected=a; saved=a
      do i=2,size(a)
         temp=expected(i); j=i-1
         do while(j>=1)
            if (expected(j)<=temp) exit
            expected(j+1)=expected(j); j=j-1
         end do
         expected(j+1)=temp
      end do
      single=real(a,real32)/8; double=real(a,real64)/8
      do i=1,size(a)
         write(keys(i),'(i4.4)') a(i)+512
      end do
      saved_single=single; saved_double=double; saved_keys=keys
      do mode=1,4
         idx=-1
         select case(mode)
         case(1)
            call rank(a,idx)
         case(2)
            call rank(single,idx)
         case(3)
            call rank(double,idx)
         case(4)
            call rank(keys,idx)
         end select
         if (any(idx<1).or.any(idx>size(a))) error stop 'index range'
         do i=1,size(a)
            if (count(idx==i)/=1) error stop 'indices are not a permutation'
         end do
         if (any(a(idx)/=expected)) error stop 'independent sorted-value reference'
         if (any(a/=saved).or.any(single/=saved_single).or.any(double/=saved_double) &
            .or.any(keys/=saved_keys)) error stop 'changed input'
         calls=calls+1
      end do
      fixtures=fixtures+1
   end subroutine
end program

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/ranking-magic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:int64,real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use M_LA,only:mat_magic
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:)
   integer(int64),allocatable::entries(:,:)
   integer(int64)::target,total,diagonal,reverse_diagonal
   integer::n,rows,padding,repeat,i,j,k,calls,value_checks,sum_checks,classes(3)
   calls=0; value_checks=0; sum_checks=0; classes=0
   do n=1,32
      if (n==2) cycle ! No normal order-two magic square exists.
      if (mod(n,2)==1) then
         classes(1)=classes(1)+1
      else if (mod(n,4)==0) then
         classes(2)=classes(2)+1
      else
         classes(3)=classes(3)+1
      end if
      target=int(n,int64)*(int(n,int64)**2+1)/2
      do padding=0,3,3
         rows=n+padding
         allocate(a(rows,n),entries(n,n))
         do repeat=1,2
            a=-9999
            call mat_magic(a,rows,n)
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(a))) error stop 'nonfinite matrix'
            if (padding>0) then
               if (any(a(n+1:,:)/=-9999)) error stop 'leading dimension padding overwritten'
            end if
            entries=nint(a(:n,:),kind=int64)
            if (any(a(:n,:)/=real(entries,real64))) error stop 'noninteger magic entries'
            if (any(entries<1).or.any(entries>int(n,int64)**2)) error stop 'entry range'
            do k=1,n*n
               if (count(entries==k)/=1) error stop 'entries not a permutation'
            end do
            value_checks=value_checks+n*n
            diagonal=0; reverse_diagonal=0
            do i=1,n
               total=0
               do j=1,n
                  total=total+entries(i,j)
               end do
               if (total/=target) error stop 'row sum'
               total=0
               do j=1,n
                  total=total+entries(j,i)
               end do
               if (total/=target) error stop 'column sum'
               diagonal=diagonal+entries(i,i)
               reverse_diagonal=reverse_diagonal+entries(i,n+1-i)
            end do
            if (diagonal/=target.or.reverse_diagonal/=target) error stop 'diagonal sums'
            sum_checks=sum_checks+2*n+2
            calls=calls+1
         end do
         deallocate(a,entries)
      end do
   end do
   if (calls/=124.or.value_checks/=45744.or.sum_checks/=4456) error stop 'accounting'
   if (any(classes/=[16,8,7])) error stop 'order families'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Magic-square calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Entry checks: ',value_checks,'; exact line-sum checks: ',sum_checks
   print '(a)', 'Orders 1 and 3..32; odd/doubly-even/singly-even; compact/padded storage; repeated calls.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS m-la-magic-reference'
end program

name: gams-maptran-wgs84-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/geodesy-forlab-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use maptran,only:geodetic2ecef,ecef2geodetic
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter::pi=acos(-1.0_wp),a=6378137.0_wp,flattening=1/298.257223563_wp
   real(wp),parameter::eccentricity2=flattening*(2-flattening),b=a*(1-flattening)
   real(wp),parameter::latitudes(*)=[-89.0_wp,-60.0_wp,-30.0_wp,0.0_wp,30.0_wp,60.0_wp,89.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::longitudes(*)=[-180.0_wp,-90.0_wp,-23.0_wp,0.0_wp,74.0_wp,180.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::heights(*)=[-100.0_wp,0.0_wp,1000.0_wp,100000.0_wp]
   real(wp)::lat,lon,h,p,l,radius,reference(3),xyz(3),input(3),saved(3),back(3)
   real(wp)::position_error,angular_error,height_error,worst_p,worst_a,worst_h
   integer::il,io,ih,mode,sign,cases,calls,pole_calls
   logical::degrees
   cases=0; calls=0; pole_calls=0; worst_p=0; worst_a=0; worst_h=0
   do il=1,size(latitudes)
      lat=latitudes(il); p=lat*pi/180
      radius=a/sqrt(1-eccentricity2*sin(p)**2)
      do io=1,size(longitudes)
         lon=longitudes(io); l=lon*pi/180
         do ih=1,size(heights)
            h=heights(ih)
            reference=[(radius+h)*cos(p)*cos(l),(radius+h)*cos(p)*sin(l), &
               (radius*(1-eccentricity2)+h)*sin(p)]
            do mode=1,2
               degrees=mode==1
               input=[lat,lon,h]
               if (.not.degrees) input(:2)=input(:2)*pi/180
               saved=input
               call geodetic2ecef(input(1),input(2),input(3),xyz(1),xyz(2),xyz(3),deg=degrees)
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(xyz))) error stop 'nonfinite ECEF'
               if (any(input/=saved)) error stop 'changed geodetic input'
               position_error=maxval(abs(xyz-reference))
               if (position_error>5e-6_wp) error stop 'independent WGS84 forward reference'
               ! Feed the independent Cartesian reference, not the library's forward output.
               call ecef2geodetic(reference(1),reference(2),reference(3),back(1),back(2),back(3),deg=degrees)
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(back))) error stop 'nonfinite inverse'
               if (.not.degrees) back(:2)=back(:2)*180/pi
               angular_error=max(abs(back(1)-lat), &
                  abs(atan2(sin((back(2)-lon)*pi/180),cos((back(2)-lon)*pi/180)))*180/pi)
               height_error=abs(back(3)-h)
               if (angular_error>2e-7_wp.or.height_error>5e-3_wp) error stop 'independent WGS84 inverse reference'
               worst_p=max(worst_p,position_error); worst_a=max(worst_a,angular_error)
               worst_h=max(worst_h,height_error)
               calls=calls+2; cases=cases+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   ! At the poles only the forward map is checked; longitude there is not unique.
   do sign=-1,1,2
      do ih=2,3
         h=heights(ih)
         do mode=1,2
            degrees=mode==1
            lat=sign*90.0_wp
            if (.not.degrees) lat=lat*pi/180
            call geodetic2ecef(lat,0.0_wp,h,xyz(1),xyz(2),xyz(3),deg=degrees)
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(xyz))) error stop 'nonfinite pole'
            if (maxval(abs(xyz-[0.0_wp,0.0_wp,sign*(b+h)]))>5e-6_wp) error stop 'exact polar axis'
            calls=calls+1; pole_calls=pole_calls+1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (cases/=336.or.calls/=680.or.pole_calls/=8) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Degree/radian geodetic cases: ',cases,'; conversion calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Additional exact forward polar-axis calls: ',pole_calls
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum ECEF error (meters): ',worst_p
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum inverse angular error (degrees): ',worst_a
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum inverse height error (meters): ',worst_h
   print '(a)', 'PASS maptran-wgs84-reference'
end program

name: gams-forlab-least-squares-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/geodesy-forlab-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use forlab,only:solve,real64=>RPRE
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::shapes(2,3)=reshape([2,1,3,2,5,3],[2,3])
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),saved_a(:,:),b(:,:),saved_b(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:)
   real(real64),allocatable::expected(:,:),noise(:,:),x(:,:),v(:),r(:,:),d(:)
   real(real64)::value,z,rho,normalization,answer_error,residual_error,stationary,worst_x,worst_r,worst_s
   integer::shape_id,m,n,k,is,rotation,level,i,j,l,c,fixtures,calls,nonzero
   fixtures=0; calls=0; nonzero=0; worst_x=0; worst_r=0; worst_s=0
   do shape_id=1,size(shapes,2)
      m=shapes(1,shape_id); n=shapes(2,shape_id); k=min(m,n)
      allocate(a(m,n),saved_a(m,n),b(m,3),saved_b(m,3),left(m,m),right(n,n))
      allocate(expected(n,3),noise(m,3),r(m,3),d(k))
      do is=1,size(scales)
         d=[(real(i,real64)*scales(is),i=1,k)]
         do rotation=1,2
            call orthogonal_factor(left,rotation); call orthogonal_factor(right,rotation)
            a=0
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,m
                  do l=1,k
                     a(i,j)=a(i,j)+left(i,l)*d(l)*right(j,l)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            do level=1,2
               rho=0
               if (level==2.and.m>n) rho=0.25_real64
               noise=0; expected=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     do l=1,k
                        z=real(2*l-c,real64)/4
                        expected(j,c)=expected(j,c)+right(j,l)*z
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (m>n) noise(:,c)=rho*c*left(:,n+1)
               end do
               if (rho>0) nonzero=nonzero+1
               b=noise
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        b(i,c)=b(i,c)+a(i,j)*expected(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               saved_a=a; saved_b=b
               allocate(x(n,3))
               do c=1,3
                  v=solve(a,b(:,c))
                  if (size(v)/=n.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) then
                     print *, 'Failure m,n,scale,rotation,residual-level,RHS:',m,n,scales(is),rotation,level,c
                     print *, 'Matrix:',a
                     print *, 'RHS:',b(:,c)
                     error stop 'vector solution'
                  end if
                  x(:,c)=v
                  answer_error=maxval(abs(v-expected(:,c)))/max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(expected(:,c))))
                  if (answer_error>3e-5_real64) error stop 'known least-squares solution'
                  worst_x=max(worst_x,answer_error)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               if (any(a/=saved_a).or.any(b/=saved_b)) error stop 'inputs changed'
               r=-b
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        r(i,c)=r(i,c)+a(i,j)*x(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(b)))
               residual_error=maxval(abs(r+noise))/normalization
               if (residual_error>5e-5_real64) error stop 'known residual'
               worst_r=max(worst_r,residual_error)
               stationary=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     value=0
                     do i=1,m
                        value=value+a(i,j)*r(i,c)
                     end do
                     stationary=max(stationary,abs(value)/(normalization*max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(a)))))
                  end do
                  value=abs(sum(r(:,c)**2)-(rho*c)**2)/max(1.0_real64,(rho*c)**2)
                  if (value>2e-4_real64) error stop 'known residual norm'
               end do
               if (stationary>1e-4_real64) error stop 'normal-equation residual'
               worst_s=max(worst_s,stationary)
               deallocate(x)
               fixtures=fixtures+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,saved_a,b,saved_b,left,right,expected,noise,r,d,v)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=36.or.calls/=108.or.nonzero/=18) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Full-rank least-squares fixtures: ',fixtures,'; solver calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Overdetermined fixtures with prescribed nonzero residuals: ',nonzero
   print '(a)', 'Overdetermined only; three vector RHS calls per fixture; native catalog RPRE.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized prescribed-residual error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized normal-equation residual: ',worst_s
   print '(a,i0)', 'Forlab real storage bits: ',storage_size(0.0_real64)
   print '(a)', 'PASS forlab-least-squares-reference'
contains
   subroutine orthogonal_factor(q,variant)
      real(real64),intent(out)::q(:,:)
      integer,intent(in)::variant
      real(real64)::norm
      integer::i,j,n
      n=size(q,1); q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (variant==1) return
      norm=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/norm
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine orthogonal_factor
end program main

name: gams-nonlin-lsq-jacobian-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/jacobian-transforms-drivers-MIT.txt.
module fit_problem
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   implicit none
   integer::residual_calls,jacobian_calls
   real(wp)::amplitude,exponent
contains
   subroutine model(x,f,jac)
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(2)
      real(wp),intent(out)::f(5),jac(5,2)
      real(wp)::t,v
      integer::i
      do i=1,5
         t=real(i-3,wp)/2; v=exp(x(2)*t)
         f(i)=x(1)*v-amplitude*exp(exponent*t)
         jac(i,:)=[v,x(1)*t*v]
      end do
   end subroutine model
   subroutine residual_callback(x,f,args)
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(:)
      real(wp),intent(out)::f(:)
      class(*),optional,intent(inout)::args
      real(wp)::jac(5,2)
      call model(x,f,jac)
      residual_calls=residual_calls+1
   end subroutine
   subroutine jacobian_callback(x,jac,args)
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(:)
      real(wp),intent(out)::jac(:,:)
      class(*),optional,intent(inout)::args
      real(wp)::f(5)
      call model(x,f,jac)
      jacobian_calls=jacobian_calls+1
   end subroutine
end module fit_problem
program main
   use fit_problem
   use nonlin,only:vecfcn_helper,least_squares_solver,iteration_behavior,vecfcn,jacobianfcn
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(vecfcn_helper)::objective_helper
   type(least_squares_solver)::solver
   type(iteration_behavior)::tracking
   procedure(vecfcn),pointer::residual_pointer
   procedure(jacobianfcn),pointer::jacobian_pointer
   real(wp),parameter::amplitudes(*)=[0.5_wp,2.0_wp],exponents(*)=[-1.0_wp,0.25_wp,1.0_wp]
   real(wp)::x(2),expected(2),f(5),jac(5,2),check_f(5),check_j(5,2),plus(5),minus(5),scratch(5,2),xp(2)
   real(wp)::step,error,worst_x,worst_j,objective,expected_objective,gradient,worst_g,value
   integer::ia,ib,start_a,start_b,runs,exact_runs,jac_entries,c
   runs=0; exact_runs=0; jac_entries=0; worst_x=0; worst_j=0; worst_g=0
   residual_pointer=>residual_callback; jacobian_pointer=>jacobian_callback
   call objective_helper%set_fcn(residual_pointer,5,2)
   call objective_helper%set_jacobian(jacobian_pointer)
   call solver%set_step_scaling_factor(1.0_wp)
   call solver%set_max_fcn_evals(2000)
   call solver%set_fcn_tolerance(1e-12_wp)
   call solver%set_var_tolerance(1e-12_wp)
   call solver%set_gradient_tolerance(1e-12_wp)
   do ia=1,size(amplitudes)
      amplitude=amplitudes(ia)
      do ib=1,size(exponents)
         exponent=exponents(ib); expected=[amplitude,exponent]
         do start_a=1,2
            do start_b=1,2
               x=[amplitude*real(2*start_a-1,wp)/2,exponent+real(2*start_b-3,wp)/2]
               call fit()
               exact_runs=exact_runs+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (runs/=24.or.exact_runs/=24.or.jac_entries/=240) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,2i5)', 'Total / exact-fit solves: ',runs,exact_runs
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytical Jacobian entries checked by central differences at starting points: ',jac_entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized parameter error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized Jacobian finite-difference error: ',worst_j
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute J-transpose-residual component: ',worst_g
   print '(a)', 'PASS nonlin-lsq-jacobian-reference'
contains
   subroutine fit()
      real(wp)::start(2)
      start=x
      call model(x,check_f,check_j)
      do c=1,2
         step=1e-5_wp*max(1.0_wp,abs(x(c)))
         xp=x; xp(c)=xp(c)+step; call model(xp,plus,scratch)
         xp=x; xp(c)=xp(c)-step; call model(xp,minus,scratch)
         error=maxval(abs((plus-minus)/(2*step)-check_j(:,c)))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(check_j(:,c))))
         if (error>2e-7_wp) error stop 'user Jacobian finite-difference check'
         worst_j=max(worst_j,error); jac_entries=jac_entries+5
      end do
      residual_calls=0; jacobian_calls=0
      call solver%solve(objective_helper,x,f,tracking)
      if (.not.(tracking%converge_on_fcn.or.tracking%converge_on_chng.or.tracking%converge_on_zero_diff)) &
         error stop 'nonlin normal stopping status'
      if (residual_calls<=0.or.jacobian_calls<=0) error stop 'both callbacks required'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(f))) error stop 'nonfinite fit'
      call model(x,check_f,check_j)
      if (maxval(abs(check_f-f))>1e-11_wp) error stop 'returned residual consistency'
      error=maxval(abs(x-expected))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(expected)))
      if (error>2e-7_wp) then
         print *, 'amplitude, exponent:',amplitude,exponent
         print *, 'start, final, expected, normalized error:',start,x,expected,error
         print *, 'convergence flags:',tracking%converge_on_fcn,tracking%converge_on_chng,tracking%converge_on_zero_diff
         error stop 'known fit parameters'
      end if
      worst_x=max(worst_x,error)
      objective=sum(f*f); expected_objective=0
      if (abs(objective-expected_objective)/max(1.0_wp,expected_objective)>1e-10_wp) &
         error stop 'known minimum residual norm'
      gradient=maxval(abs([sum(check_j(:,1)*f),sum(check_j(:,2)*f)]))
      if (gradient>1e-6_wp) error stop 'least-squares stationarity'
      worst_g=max(worst_g,gradient)
      if (maxval(abs(f))>1e-8_wp) error stop 'exact-fit residual'
      runs=runs+1
   end subroutine fit
end program main

name: gams-fglm-transform-reference

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/jacobian-transforms-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_c_binding,only:c_float,c_double
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use vector_3d,only:vec3d
   use matrix_4f,only:mat4f
   implicit none
   real(c_float),parameter::pi=acos(-1.0_c_float)
   real(c_float),parameter::angles(*)=[-2*pi,-pi,-pi/2,-pi/3,0.0_c_float,pi/6,pi/2,pi,2*pi]
   real(c_float),parameter::translations(3,4)=reshape([0.0_c_float,0.0_c_float,0.0_c_float, &
      1.0_c_float,-2.0_c_float,0.5_c_float,-4.0_c_float,0.0_c_float,2.0_c_float, &
      0.25_c_float,0.5_c_float,-0.75_c_float],[3,4])
   real(c_float),parameter::points(4,3)=reshape([1.0_c_float,2.0_c_float,3.0_c_float,1.0_c_float, &
      -2.0_c_float,0.5_c_float,0.0_c_float,1.0_c_float,1.0_c_float,-1.0_c_float,2.0_c_float,0.0_c_float],[4,3])
   type(vec3d)::a,b,result
   type(mat4f)::transform
   real(c_double)::av(3),bv(3),values(3),expected(4),p(4),t(3),co,si,error,worst_v,worst_t,value,det
   real(c_float)::matrix(4,4),actual(4)
   integer::i,j,k,ia,it,mode,ip,vector_calls,transforms,point_checks
   vector_calls=0; transforms=0; point_checks=0; worst_v=0; worst_t=0
   do i=1,24
      av=[real(i,c_double)/8,real(i-12,c_double)/4,(-1.0_c_double)**i/2]
      bv=[real(25-i,c_double)/4,-real(i,c_double)/8,real(mod(i,5)-2,c_double)]
      a=vec3d(av); b=vec3d(bv)
      result=a+b; values=result%as_array()
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'nonfinite vector sum'
      error=maxval(abs(values-(av+bv)))
      if (error>1e-13_c_double) error stop 'component sum'
      worst_v=max(worst_v,error)
      result=a*b; values=result%as_array()
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'nonfinite vector product'
      error=maxval(abs(values-av*bv))
      if (error>1e-13_c_double) error stop 'component product'
      worst_v=max(worst_v,error)
      if (any(a%as_array()/=av).or.any(b%as_array()/=bv)) error stop 'changed vectors'
      vector_calls=vector_calls+2
   end do
   do ia=1,size(angles)
      co=cos(real(angles(ia),c_double)); si=sin(real(angles(ia),c_double))
      do it=1,size(translations,2)
         t=real(translations(:,it),c_double)
         do mode=1,2
            call transform%identity()
            if (mode==1) then
               call transform%translate(translations(1,it),translations(2,it),translations(3,it))
               call transform%rotate_z(angles(ia))
            else
               call transform%rotate_z(angles(ia))
               call transform%translate(translations(1,it),translations(2,it),translations(3,it))
            end if
            matrix=reshape(transform%data,[4,4])
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(matrix))) error stop 'nonfinite transform'
            do j=1,3
               do i=1,3
                  value=0
                  do k=1,3
                     value=value+real(matrix(k,i),c_double)*real(matrix(k,j),c_double)
                  end do
                  if (i==j) value=value-1
                  if (abs(value)>2e-6_c_double) error stop 'rotation orthogonality'
               end do
            end do
            det=real(matrix(1,1),c_double)*(real(matrix(2,2),c_double)*matrix(3,3)- &
               real(matrix(2,3),c_double)*matrix(3,2))-real(matrix(1,2),c_double)* &
               (real(matrix(2,1),c_double)*matrix(3,3)-real(matrix(2,3),c_double)*matrix(3,1))+ &
               real(matrix(1,3),c_double)*(real(matrix(2,1),c_double)*matrix(3,2)- &
               real(matrix(2,2),c_double)*matrix(3,1))
            if (abs(det-1)>2e-6_c_double) error stop 'rotation determinant'
            do ip=1,size(points,2)
               p=real(points(:,ip),c_double)
               if (mode==2) p(:3)=p(:3)+t*p(4)
               expected=[co*p(1)-si*p(2),si*p(1)+co*p(2),p(3),p(4)]
               if (mode==1) expected(:3)=expected(:3)+t*p(4)
               actual=matmul(matrix,points(:,ip))
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite transformed point'
               error=maxval(abs(real(actual,c_double)-expected))/max(1.0_c_double,maxval(abs(expected)))
               if (error>2e-6_c_double) error stop 'independent transform reference'
               worst_t=max(worst_t,error); point_checks=point_checks+4
            end do
            transforms=transforms+1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (vector_calls/=48.or.transforms/=72.or.point_checks/=864) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Double-precision vector operations: ',vector_calls
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Single-precision rigid transforms: ',transforms,'; coordinate references: ',point_checks
   print '(a)', 'Both composition orders; points and directions; orthogonality and determinant.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum vector component error: ',worst_v
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized transform error: ',worst_t
   print '(a)', 'PASS fglm-transform-reference'
end program

program main
   use function_parser,only:fparser
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   character(len=96),parameter::expressions(*)=[character(len=96):: &
      'pgx+2*pgy','(pgx+2)*(pgy-3)','pgx**2+3*pgx*pgy+pgy**2', &
      'sin(pgx)**2+cos(pgx)**2','exp(log(pgx+4))','sqrt((pgx+4)**2)', &
      'abs(pgx-pgy)','sin(pgx+pgy)-sin(pgx)*cos(pgy)-cos(pgx)*sin(pgy)', &
      '(pgx-pgy)/(pgx+4)','pgx**3-3*pgx**2*pgy+3*pgx*pgy**2-pgy**3', &
      'log(exp(pgy/4))','2+3*4','(2+3)*4','-(pgx+pgy)']
   real(wp),parameter::xs(*)=[-2.0_wp,-0.5_wp,0.0_wp,0.75_wp,2.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::ys(*)=[-1.5_wp,0.0_wp,0.5_wp,1.25_wp]
   real(wp)::x,y,result,reference,error,worst
   integer::ie,ix,iy,checks,rejected,recovered
   type(fparser)::expression
   character(len=32),parameter::bad_parse(*)=[character(len=32)::'pgx+','(pgx','unknown(pgx)']
   character(len=32),parameter::bad_eval(*)=[character(len=32)::'sqrt(pgx)','log(pgx)','1/(pgx-pgx)']
   real(wp)::inputs(2),saved(2)
   checks=0; rejected=0; recovered=0; worst=0
   do ie=1,size(expressions)
      call expression%clear_errors()
      call expression%destroy()
      call expression%parse(trim(expressions(ie)),['pgx','pgy'])
      if (expression%error()) error stop 'valid expression rejected'
      do ix=1,size(xs)
         x=xs(ix)
         do iy=1,size(ys)
            y=ys(iy)
            select case(ie)
            case(1)
               reference=x+2*y
            case(2)
               reference=(x+2)*(y-3)
            case(3)
               reference=x*x+3*x*y+y*y
            case(4)
               reference=1
            case(5,6)
               reference=x+4
            case(7)
               reference=abs(x-y)
            case(8)
               reference=0
            case(9)
               reference=(x-y)/(x+4)
            case(10)
               reference=(x-y)**3
            case(11)
               reference=y/4
            case(12)
               reference=14
            case(13)
               reference=20
            case(14)
               reference=-x-y
            end select
            inputs=[x,y]; saved=inputs
            call expression%evaluate(inputs,result)
            if (expression%error()) error stop 'valid evaluation rejected'
            if (any(inputs/=saved)) error stop 'changed variable inputs'
            call check(result,reference)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   do ie=1,size(bad_parse)
      call expression%clear_errors()
      call expression%destroy()
      call expression%parse(trim(bad_parse(ie)),['pgx','pgy'])
      if (.not.expression%error()) error stop 'missing parse error'
      rejected=rejected+1
      call recovery()
   end do
   do ie=1,size(bad_eval)
      call expression%clear_errors()
      call expression%destroy()
      call expression%parse(trim(bad_eval(ie)),['pgx','pgy'])
      if (expression%error()) error stop 'domain probe parse failed'
      call expression%evaluate([-1.0_wp,0.5_wp],result)
      if (.not.expression%error()) error stop 'missing evaluation error'
      rejected=rejected+1
      call recovery()
   end do
   call expression%clear_errors()
   call expression%destroy()
   if (checks/=286.or.rejected/=6.or.recovered/=6) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent expression value references: ',checks
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Expected rejected requests: ',rejected,'; successful recoveries: ',recovered
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized expression error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS function-parser-identities'
contains
   subroutine check(value,expected)
      real(wp),intent(in)::value,expected
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite expression value'
      error=abs(value-expected)/max(1.0_wp,abs(expected))
      if (error>2e-12_wp) then
         print *, 'Expression, result, expected, error:',ie,value,expected,error
         error stop 'independent expression reference'
      end if
      worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+1
   end subroutine
   subroutine recovery()
      call expression%clear_errors()
      call expression%destroy()
      call expression%parse('pgx+pgy',['pgx','pgy'])
      if (expression%error()) error stop 'recovery parse'
      call expression%evaluate([0.25_wp,-0.5_wp],result)
      if (expression%error()) error stop 'recovery evaluation'
      call check(result,-0.25_wp)
      recovered=recovered+1
   end subroutine
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use str2real_m,only:str2real
   implicit none
   character(len=12),parameter::mantissas(*)=[character(len=12):: &
      '0','1','25','12345','9876543','.125','12.5','0.000125']
   real(wp),parameter::coefficients(*)=[0.0_wp,1.0_wp,25.0_wp,12345.0_wp,9876543.0_wp, &
      0.125_wp,12.5_wp,0.000125_wp]
   integer,parameter::exponents(*)=[-100,-12,-1,0,1,12,100]
   character(len=32),parameter::boundary(*)=[character(len=32):: &
      '1234567890123456e0','-123456789012345E0', &
      '0.123456789012345678901234e0','-.123456789012345678901234e0']
   real(wp),parameter::boundary_values(*)=[1234567890123456.0_wp,-123456789012345.0_wp, &
      0.123456789012345678901234_wp,-0.123456789012345678901234_wp]
   character(len=:),allocatable::text,prefix
   character(len=8)::suffix
   real(wp)::reference,parsed,read_value,error,worst_arithmetic,worst_read
   integer::i,sign,notation,j,status,calls
   calls=0; worst_arithmetic=0; worst_read=0
   do i=1,size(mantissas)
      do sign=-1,1,2
         prefix=''
         if (sign<0) prefix='-'
         text=prefix//trim(mantissas(i))
         reference=sign*coefficients(i)
         call check()
         do notation=1,2
            do j=1,size(exponents)
               write(suffix,'(sp,i0)') exponents(j)
               text=prefix//trim(mantissas(i))
               if (notation==1) then
                  text=text//'E'//trim(suffix)
               else
                  text=text//'e'//trim(suffix)
               end if
               reference=sign*coefficients(i)*10.0_wp**exponents(j)
               call check()
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   do i=1,size(boundary)
      text=trim(boundary(i)); reference=boundary_values(i)
      call check()
   end do
   if (calls/=244) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Valid decimal conversions: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Two independent references per conversion: arithmetic and formatted READ.'
   print '(a)', 'Both signs; plain decimals; E/e with signed exponents -100..100; long mantissas.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative arithmetic-reference error: ',worst_arithmetic
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative formatted-READ error: ',worst_read
   print '(a)', 'PASS str2real-decimal-reference'
contains
   subroutine check()
      if (len(text)>28) error stop 'fixture string length'
      parsed=str2real(text)
      read(text,*,iostat=status) read_value
      if (status/=0.or..not.ieee_is_finite(read_value)) error stop 'reference READ failed'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(parsed)) error stop 'nonfinite conversion'
      if (reference==0) then
         if (parsed/=0.or.read_value/=0) error stop 'zero conversion'
      else
         error=abs(parsed-reference)/abs(reference)
         if (error>5e-14_wp) then
            print *,text,parsed,reference,error
            error stop 'arithmetic decimal reference'
         end if
         worst_arithmetic=max(worst_arithmetic,error)
         error=abs(parsed-read_value)/abs(read_value)
         if (error>5e-14_wp) error stop 'formatted READ reference'
         worst_read=max(worst_read,error)
      end if
      calls=calls+1
   end subroutine
end program
