! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/conversion-triangulation-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use geompack,only:r8tris2
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[5,9,13]
   real(wp),parameter::scales(*)=[0.5_wp,2.0_wp,8.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::interior(2,9)=reshape([0.0_wp,0.0_wp,-0.7_wp,-0.2_wp,0.2_wp,-0.6_wp, &
      0.65_wp,0.1_wp,-0.1_wp,0.7_wp,-0.45_wp,0.45_wp,0.45_wp,0.55_wp, &
      -0.55_wp,-0.65_wp,0.55_wp,-0.45_wp],[2,9])
   real(wp),allocatable::xy(:,:),saved(:,:)
   integer,allocatable::tri(:,:),neighbor(:,:),edges(:,:)
   logical,allocatable::visited(:,:)
   real(wp)::scale,shift(2),a(2),b(2),c(2),area2,area,det,worst_area,worst_circle,value
   integer::layout,n,is,translation,ordering,nt,t,e,u,v,i,j,k,nb,other,match,boundary_edges
   integer::start_t,start_e,next_t,next_e,link,calls,triangles,circle_checks
   calls=0; triangles=0; circle_checks=0; worst_area=0; worst_circle=0
   do layout=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(layout)
      allocate(xy(2,n),saved(2,n),tri(3,2*n),neighbor(3,2*n),edges(n,n),visited(3,2*n))
      do is=1,size(scales)
         scale=scales(is)
         do translation=1,2
            shift=0
            if (translation==2) shift=[-3.0_wp,5.0_wp]
            do ordering=1,2
               xy(:,:4)=reshape([-1.0_wp,-1.0_wp,1.0_wp,-1.0_wp,1.0_wp,1.0_wp,-1.0_wp,1.0_wp],[2,4])
               xy(:,5:)=interior(:,:n-4)
               do i=1,n
                  xy(:,i)=scale*xy(:,i)+shift
               end do
               if (ordering==2) xy=xy(:,n:1:-1)
               saved=xy; nt=0; tri=0; neighbor=0
               call r8tris2(n,xy,nt,tri,neighbor)
               if (nt/=2*n-6) error stop 'Euler triangle count'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(xy)).or.any(xy/=saved)) error stop 'coordinate restoration'
               if (any(tri(:,:nt)<1).or.any(tri(:,:nt)>n)) error stop 'vertex range'
               do i=1,n
                  if (.not.any(tri(:,:nt)==i)) error stop 'unused vertex'
               end do
               edges=0; area=0; boundary_edges=0; start_t=0; start_e=0
               do t=1,nt
                  do other=1,t-1
                     if (all([(any(tri(:,other)==tri(i,t)),i=1,3)])) error stop 'duplicate triangle'
                  end do
                  a=xy(:,tri(1,t)); b=xy(:,tri(2,t)); c=xy(:,tri(3,t))
                  area2=cross(b-a,c-a)
                  if (area2<=1e-14_wp*scale**2) error stop 'triangle orientation or degeneracy'
                  area=area+area2/2
                  do i=1,n
                     if (any(tri(:,t)==i)) cycle
                     a=xy(:,tri(1,t))-xy(:,i); b=xy(:,tri(2,t))-xy(:,i); c=xy(:,tri(3,t))-xy(:,i)
                     det=sum(a*a)*cross(b,c)-sum(b*b)*cross(a,c)+sum(c*c)*cross(a,b)
                     value=det/max(1.0_wp,scale**4)
                     if (value>1e-10_wp) error stop 'point inside circumcircle'
                     worst_circle=max(worst_circle,value); circle_checks=circle_checks+1
                  end do
                  do e=1,3
                     u=tri(e,t); v=tri(mod(e,3)+1,t)
                     edges(min(u,v),max(u,v))=edges(min(u,v),max(u,v))+1
                     nb=neighbor(e,t)
                     if (nb>0) then
                        if (nb>nt.or.nb==t) error stop 'neighbor range'
                        match=0
                        do k=1,3
                           if (tri(k,nb)==v.and.tri(mod(k,3)+1,nb)==u) then
                              if (neighbor(k,nb)/=t) error stop 'neighbor reciprocity'
                              match=match+1
                           end if
                        end do
                        if (match/=1) error stop 'neighbor shared edge'
                     else if (nb<0) then
                        boundary_edges=boundary_edges+1; start_t=t; start_e=e
                     else
                        error stop 'missing neighbor'
                     end if
                  end do
               end do
               if (any(edges>2).or.count(edges==1)/=4.or.count(edges>0)/=3*n-7) error stop 'edge incidence'
               if (boundary_edges/=4) error stop 'boundary count'
               visited=.false.; t=start_t; e=start_e
               do j=1,4
                  if (visited(e,t).or.neighbor(e,t)>=0) error stop 'boundary cycle'
                  visited(e,t)=.true.; link=-neighbor(e,t)
                  next_t=link/3; next_e=mod(link,3)+1
                  if (next_t<1.or.next_t>nt) error stop 'boundary link range'
                  t=next_t; e=next_e
               end do
               if (t/=start_t.or.e/=start_e) error stop 'boundary cycle closure'
               value=abs(area-4*scale**2)/max(1.0_wp,4*scale**2)
               if (value>5e-12_wp) error stop 'known rectangle area'
               worst_area=max(worst_area,value); triangles=triangles+nt; calls=calls+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(xy,saved,tri,neighbor,edges,visited)
   end do
   if (calls/=36.or.triangles/=432.or.circle_checks/=3360) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Planar triangulations: ',calls,'; checked triangles: ',triangles
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent empty-circumcircle tests: ',circle_checks
   print '(a)', 'Known hull/area; all vertices; edge incidence; reciprocal neighbors; boundary cycle; restored coordinates.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized area error: ',worst_area
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum positive normalized incircle determinant: ',worst_circle
   print '(a)', 'PASS geompack-delaunay-reference'
contains
   pure function cross(a,b) result(value)
      real(wp),intent(in)::a(2),b(2)
      real(wp)::value
      value=a(1)*b(2)-a(2)*b(1)
   end function
end program

         do child=2,5
            k=0
            do parent=1,child-1
               if (btest(mask,bit)) then
                  k=k+1; parents(k)=labels(parent)
                  dependency(labels(child),labels(parent))=.true.
               end if
               bit=bit+1
            end do
            if (k>0) call graph%set_edges(labels(child),parents(:k))
         end do
         do repeat=1,2
            call verify()
         end do
         graphs=graphs+1
         call graph%destroy()
         if (graph%number_of_vertices()/=0) error stop 'graph destruction'
      end do
   end do
   do cycle_size=1,3
      call graph%set_vertices(int(cycle_size,ip))
      do i=1,cycle_size
         call graph%set_edges(int(i,ip),[int(mod(i,cycle_size)+1,ip)])
      end do
      do repeat=1,2
         call graph%toposort(order,status)
         if (status/=-1.or.allocated(order)) error stop 'cycle status/output'
         rejected=rejected+1
      end do
      ! Rebuild the same object after a failed sort and verify a known chain.
      n=3; dependency=.false.
      call graph%set_vertices(3_ip)
      call graph%set_edges(2_ip,[1_ip]); dependency(2,1)=.true.
      call graph%set_edges(3_ip,[2_ip]); dependency(3,2)=.true.
      do repeat=1,2
         call verify()
      end do
      graphs=graphs+1
      call graph%destroy()
   end do
   if (graphs/=2051.or.sort_calls/=4102.or.rejected/=6.or.edge_checks/=20492) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Acyclic graph fixtures: ',graphs,'; valid topological sorts: ',sort_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent dependency precedence checks: ',edge_checks
   print '(a,i0)', 'Expected cyclic rejections: ',rejected
   print '(a)', 'Permutation integrity, repeated sorting, explicit cycle status and object recovery.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS daglib-order-reference'
contains
   subroutine verify()
      integer::i,j,positions(5)
      call graph%toposort(order,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'acyclic sort status'
      if (.not.allocated(order)) error stop 'unallocated order'
      if (size(order)/=n.or.any(order<1).or.any(order>n)) error stop 'order shape/range'
      positions=0
      do i=1,n
         if (count(order==i)/=1) error stop 'order permutation'
         positions(order(i))=i
      end do
      do i=1,n
         do j=1,n
            if (.not.dependency(i,j)) cycle
            if (positions(j)>=positions(i)) error stop 'dependency precedence'
            edge_checks=edge_checks+1
         end do
      end do
      sort_calls=sort_calls+1
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-coretran-sort-reference

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/graph-neighbors-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:int32,int64,real32,real64
   use m_sort,only:sort
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::lengths(*)=[0,1,2,3,4,7,8,15,16,31,32,63,64,127]
   integer(int32),allocatable::a(:)
   integer::n,i,j,pattern,fixtures,calls,permutations
   fixtures=0; calls=0; permutations=0
   do n=1,7
      a=[(int(i,int32),i=1,n)]
      call permute(1)
   end do
   do j=1,size(lengths)
      n=lengths(j)
      if (allocated(a)) deallocate(a)
      allocate(a(n))
      do pattern=1,6
         do i=1,n
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               a(i)=i-n/2
            case(2)
               a(i)=n-i
            case(3)
               a(i)=7
            case(4)
               a(i)=mod(i,3)-1
            case(5)
               a(i)=(-1)**i*i
            case(6)
               a(i)=mod(37*i+11,17)-8
            end select
         end do
         call check_rank()
      end do
   end do
   if (permutations/=5913.or.fixtures/=5997.or.calls/=23988) error stop 'accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exhaustive permutations through length seven: ',permutations
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Total sorting fixtures: ',fixtures,'; typed sorting calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Integer32/64 and real32/64; explicit stable=true only.'
   print '(a)', 'Independent insertion-sort values; empty input, repeated keys and boundary sizes.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS coretran-sort-reference'
contains
   recursive subroutine permute(first)
      integer,intent(in)::first
      integer::k,temp
      if (first>size(a)) then
         call check_rank()
         permutations=permutations+1
         return
      end if
      do k=first,size(a)
         temp=a(first); a(first)=a(k); a(k)=temp
         call permute(first+1)
         temp=a(first); a(first)=a(k); a(k)=temp
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine check_rank()
      integer::expected(size(a)),iv(size(a)),i,j,temp
      integer(int64)::large(size(a))
      real(real32)::single(size(a))
      real(real64)::double(size(a))
      expected=a
      do i=2,size(a)
         temp=expected(i); j=i-1
         do while(j>=1)
            if (expected(j)<=temp) exit
            expected(j+1)=expected(j); j=j-1
         end do
         expected(j+1)=temp
      end do
      iv=a; large=int(a,int64)*10000000000_int64+3_int64
      single=real(a,real32)/8; double=real(a,real64)/8
      call sort(iv,stable=.true.); call sort(large,stable=.true.)
      call sort(single,stable=.true.); call sort(double,stable=.true.)
      if (any(iv/=expected)) error stop 'integer32 sorted reference'
      if (any(large/=int(expected,int64)*10000000000_int64+3_int64)) error stop 'integer64 sorted reference'
      if (any(single/=real(expected,real32)/8)) error stop 'real32 sorted reference'
      if (any(double/=real(expected,real64)/8)) error stop 'real64 sorted reference'
      calls=calls+4
      fixtures=fixtures+1
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-flann-knn-reference
source:
! Independent checked API consumer; see licenses/neighbors-sparse-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_flann_knn
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_float, c_int
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use flann, only: flann_index, KDTreeSingleIndexParams, search_params
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(5)=[1,2,8,31,64]
   integer :: d,s,pattern,order,trees=0,queries=0,searches=0,neighbors=0
   do d=2,3
      do s=1,size(sizes)
         do pattern=1,3
            do order=1,2
               call fixture(d,sizes(s),pattern,order)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Trees: ',trees
   print '(a,i0)', 'Query points: ',queries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Batched exact searches: ',searches
   print '(a,i0)', 'Checked returned neighbors: ',neighbors
   print '(a)', 'PASS flann-knn-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(d,n,pattern,order)
      integer, intent(in) :: d,n,pattern,order
      real(c_float), target :: points(d,n)
      real(c_float) :: original(d,n),q(d,20+n),qcopy(d,20+n)
      real(real64) :: direct(n),sorted(n),value,tol,actual
      real(c_float), allocatable :: dist(:,:)
      integer(c_int), allocatable :: idx(:,:)
      integer(c_int) :: status
      integer :: i,j,l,t,h,k,ks(3),source
      do i=1,n
         source=i
         if (order==2) source=n+1-i
         if (pattern==3) source=(source+1)/2
         do j=1,d
            if (pattern==2) then
               points(j,i)=real(j*source,c_float)/32
            else
               points(j,i)=real(mod((6*j+1)*source,99+2*j),c_float)/real(99+2*j,c_float)
            end if
         end do
      end do
      original=points
      do i=1,20
         do j=1,d
            q(j,i)=real(mod((15-4*j)*i,33-2*j)-6+j,c_float)/real(21-4*j,c_float)
         end do
      end do
      q(:,21:)=points
      qcopy=q
      ks=[1,min(3,n),n]
      ! Block finalization frees the native index while points still exists.
      block
         type(flann_index) :: tree
         tree=flann_index(points,KDTreeSingleIndexParams(),'Euclidean')
         call tree%build_index()
         do t=1,3
            k=ks(t)
            allocate(idx(k,20+n),dist(k,20+n))
            idx=-1; dist=-1
            call tree%knn_search(q,idx,dist,int(k,c_int),search_params(checks=-1),stat=status)
            if (status/=0) error stop 'search status'
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(dist))) error stop 'nonfinite distance'
            if (any(points/=original).or.any(q/=qcopy)) error stop 'input changed'
            do i=1,20+n
               do j=1,n
                  direct(j)=sum((real(original(:,j),real64)-real(q(:,i),real64))**2)
               end do
               sorted=direct
               ! Independent insertion sorting of direct-scan squared distances.
               do j=2,n
                  value=sorted(j); h=j-1
                  do while (h>=1)
                     if (sorted(h)<=value) exit
                     sorted(h+1)=sorted(h); h=h-1
                  end do
                  sorted(h+1)=value
               end do
               do j=1,k
                  l=idx(j,i)+1 ! FLANN indices are zero based.
                  if (l<1.or.l>n) error stop 'index range'
                  if (any(idx(:j-1,i)==idx(j,i))) error stop 'duplicate returned index'
                  actual=real(dist(j,i),real64)
                  tol=32*real(epsilon(1.0_c_float),real64)*max(1.0_real64,sorted(j))
                  if (abs(actual-direct(l))>tol) error stop 'distance/index mismatch'
                  if (abs(direct(l)-sorted(j))>tol) error stop 'not a kth nearest neighbor'
                  neighbors=neighbors+1
               end do
            end do
            deallocate(idx,dist)
            searches=searches+1
         end do
      end block
      trees=trees+1; queries=queries+20+n
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_flann_knn

program checked_sparse_matvec
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use sparse_fortran, only: sparse_coo,sparse_csr
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(5)=[1,2,3,8,17]
   integer :: i,j,pattern,order,fixtures=0,products=0,entries=0
   do i=1,size(sizes)
      do j=1,size(sizes)
         do pattern=1,5
            do order=1,2
               call fixture(sizes(i),sizes(j),pattern,order)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Matrix/order fixtures: ',fixtures
   print '(a,i0)', 'COO/CSR products: ',products
   print '(a,i0)', 'Checked result entries: ',entries
   print '(a)', 'PASS sparse-matvec-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(m,n,pattern,order)
      integer, intent(in) :: m,n,pattern,order
      type(sparse_coo) :: coo
      type(sparse_csr) :: csr
      real(real64) :: a(m,n),saved(m,n)
      real(real64), allocatable :: x(:),ref(:),y(:),z(:)
      integer :: i,j,r,nin,nout
      character :: storage
      a=0
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,m
            select case(pattern)
            case(1) ! Entirely zero, including empty rows/columns.
            case(2)
               if (i==j) a(i,j)=real(2*i-3,real64)/4
            case(3)
               if (i==j) a(i,j)=2
               if (abs(i-j)==1) a(i,j)=-1
            case(4)
               if (i/=max(1,m/2).and.j/=max(1,n/2).and.mod(3*i+5*j,4)==0) &
                  a(i,j)=real(mod(11*i+7*j,19)-9,real64)/8
            case(5)
               a(i,j)=real(mod(11*i+7*j,19)-9,real64)/8
            end select
         end do
      end do
      saved=a
      storage='C'; nin=n; nout=m
      if (order==2) then
         storage='F'; nin=m; nout=n
      end if
      ! This API's non-C order computes the transpose product, not A*x.
      call coo%sparse_init(a,order=storage)
      call csr%sparse_init(a,order=storage)
      if (any(a/=saved)) error stop 'matrix input changed'
      allocate(x(nin),ref(nout))
      do r=1,3
         do i=1,nin
            select case(r)
            case(1)
               x(i)=1
            case(2)
               x(i)=real((-1)**i*i,real64)/8
            case(3)
               x(i)=real(i*(nin+1-i),real64)/4
            end select
         end do
         ref=0
         ! Scalar dense oracle; no use of either sparse representation.
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,m
               if (order==1) then
                  ref(i)=ref(i)+saved(i,j)*x(j)
               else
                  ref(j)=ref(j)+saved(i,j)*x(i)
               end if
            end do
         end do
         y=coo%sparse_product(x); z=csr%sparse_product(x)
         if (size(y)/=nout.or.size(z)/=nout) error stop 'result shape'
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(z))) error stop 'nonfinite product'
         ! Binary fractions and small integer sums make exact comparison appropriate.
         if (any(y/=ref).or.any(z/=ref)) error stop 'scalar reference mismatch'
         products=products+2; entries=entries+2*nout
      end do
      fixtures=fixtures+1
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_sparse_matvec

name: gams-forwarddiff-analytic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/adaptive-ad-drivers-MIT.txt.
module derivative_reference_functions
   use differentia
   implicit none
   integer :: degree=0, expression=1
contains
   function monomial(x) result(y)
      type(dual), intent(in) :: x
      type(dual) :: y
      if (degree==0) then
         y=0*x+3 ! Lift the constant into the seeded dual space.
      else
         y=x**degree
      end if
   end function monomial
   function composite(x) result(y)
      type(dual), intent(in) :: x
      type(dual) :: y
      select case(expression)
      case(1)
         y=1/(1+x*x)
      case(2)
         y=exp(sin(x))
      case(3)
         y=log(2+x)
      case(4)
         y=sqrt(2+x)
      case(5)
         y=sin(2*x)*cos(x)
      case(6)
         y=atan(x)
      case(7)
         y=tan(0.5_wp*x)
      case(8)
         y=(2+x)**1.5_wp
      case(9)
         y=2.0_wp**x
      case(10)
         y=(2+x)**(1+0.25_wp*x)
      case(11)
         y=asin(x/2)
      case(12)
         y=acos(x/2)
      end select
   end function composite
   subroutine reference(x,y,dy)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp), intent(out) :: y,dy
      select case(expression)
      case(1)
         y=1/(1+x*x); dy=-2*x/(1+x*x)**2
      case(2)
         y=exp(sin(x)); dy=y*cos(x)
      case(3)
         y=log(2+x); dy=1/(2+x)
      case(4)
         y=sqrt(2+x); dy=0.5_wp/y
      case(5)
         y=sin(2*x)*cos(x); dy=2*cos(2*x)*cos(x)-sin(2*x)*sin(x)
      case(6)
         y=atan(x); dy=1/(1+x*x)
      case(7)
         y=tan(0.5_wp*x); dy=0.5_wp/cos(0.5_wp*x)**2
      case(8)
         y=(2+x)**1.5_wp; dy=1.5_wp*sqrt(2+x)
      case(9)
         y=2.0_wp**x; dy=log(2.0_wp)*y
      case(10)
         y=(2+x)**(1+0.25_wp*x)
         dy=y*(0.25_wp*log(2+x)+(1+0.25_wp*x)/(2+x))
      case(11)
         y=asin(x/2); dy=0.5_wp/sqrt(1-(x/2)**2)
      case(12)
         y=acos(x/2); dy=-0.5_wp/sqrt(1-(x/2)**2)
      end select
   end subroutine reference
end module derivative_reference_functions
program checked_forwarddiff
   use derivative_reference_functions
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x,y,dy,expected,slope,worst=0,error
   integer :: i,calls=0
   do degree=0,8
      do i=-32,32
         x=real(i,wp)/16
         if (degree==0) then
            expected=3; slope=0
         else
            expected=x**degree; slope=degree*x**(degree-1)
         end if
         call derivative(monomial,x,y,dy)
         call check()
      end do
   end do
   do expression=1,12
      do i=-48,48
         x=real(i,wp)/32
         call reference(x,expected,slope)
         call derivative(composite,x,y,dy)
         call check()
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Scalar derivative calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic value/slope references: ',2*calls
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS forwarddiff-analytic-reference'
contains
   subroutine check()
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite([y,dy]))) error stop 'nonfinite AD output'
      error=max(abs(y-expected)/(1+abs(expected)),abs(dy-slope)/(1+abs(slope)))
      worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>2e-12_wp) error stop 'analytic derivative mismatch'
      calls=calls+1
   end subroutine check
end program checked_forwarddiff

name: gams-flint-ivp-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/adaptive-ad-drivers-MIT.txt.
module analytic_ode_systems
   use FLINT, wp=>FLINT_WP
   implicit none
   type, extends(DiffEqSys) :: analytic_system
      integer :: family=1
      real(wp) :: parameter=1
   contains
      procedure :: F=>rhs
   end type analytic_system
contains
   function rhs(me,x,y,params) result(dy)
      class(analytic_system), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x,y(me%n)
      real(wp), optional, intent(in) :: params(:)
      real(wp) :: dy(size(y)),a
      a=me%parameter
      select case(me%family)
      case(1)
         dy=a*[-0.5_wp,0.25_wp,-1.5_wp]*y
      case(2)
         dy=[a*y(2),-a*y(1),3*x*x-2]
      case(3)
         dy=[-a*y(1),y(1)-a*y(2),2*y(2)-a*y(3)]
      end select
   end function rhs
   function exact(family,a,t) result(y)
      integer, intent(in) :: family
      real(wp), intent(in) :: a,t
      real(wp) :: y(3)
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         y=[1.0_wp,-2.0_wp,0.5_wp]*exp(a*[-0.5_wp,0.25_wp,-1.5_wp]*t)
      case(2)
         y=[cos(a*t)+0.25_wp*sin(a*t),-sin(a*t)+0.25_wp*cos(a*t),t**3-2*t+1]
      case(3)
         y=[1.0_wp,t,t*t]*exp(-a*t)
      end select
   end function exact
end module analytic_ode_systems
program checked_flint
   use analytic_ode_systems
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: methods(4)=[ERK_DOP853,ERK_DOP54,ERK_VERNER98R,ERK_VERNER65E]
   integer :: im,family,parameter,direction,offset,solves=0,dense_entries=0,endpoint_entries=0
   real(wp) :: worst=0
   do im=1,4
      do family=1,3
         do parameter=1,2
            do direction=-1,1,2
               do offset=1,2
                  call fixture(methods(im),family,parameter,direction,offset)
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Adaptive integrations: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Endpoint reference entries: ',endpoint_entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Dense-output reference entries: ',dense_entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS flint-ivp-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(method,family,parameter,direction,offset)
      integer, intent(in) :: method,family,parameter,direction,offset
      type(analytic_system), target :: equation
      type(ERK_class) :: solver
      real(wp) :: a,t0,requested,finish,step,y0(3),saved(3),y(3),times(17),values(3,17),again(3,17)
      integer :: j
      equation%n=3; equation%m=0; equation%family=family
      a=0.5_wp
      if (parameter==2) a=1.5_wp
      equation%parameter=a
      t0=-0.5_wp
      if (offset==2) t0=0.75_wp
      requested=t0+direction*1.25_wp
      finish=requested; y0=exact(family,a,t0); saved=y0; step=0
      if (parameter==1) then
         call solver%Init(equation,10000,Method=method,ATol=[1e-12_wp],RTol=[1e-11_wp],InterpOn=.true.)
      else
         call solver%Init(equation,10000,Method=method, &
            ATol=[1e-12_wp,2e-12_wp,4e-12_wp],RTol=[1e-11_wp,2e-11_wp,4e-11_wp],InterpOn=.true.)
      end if
      if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'initialization status'
      call solver%Integrate(t0,y0,finish,y,StepSz=step)
      if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'integration status'
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(finish)) error stop 'nonfinite reached time'
      if (abs(finish-requested)>32*epsilon(t0)*max(1.0_wp,abs(requested))) error stop 'endpoint not reached'
      if (any(y0/=saved)) error stop 'initial state modified'
      call compare(y,exact(family,a,requested))
      endpoint_entries=endpoint_entries+3
      times=[(t0+(requested-t0)*real(j-1,wp)/16,j=1,17)]
      call solver%Interpolate(times,values,SaveInterpCoeffs=.true.)
      if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'first dense-output status'
      call solver%Interpolate(times,again,SaveInterpCoeffs=.false.)
      if (solver%status/=FLINT_SUCCESS) error stop 'repeat dense-output status'
      do j=1,17
         call compare(values(:,j),exact(family,a,times(j)))
         call compare(again(:,j),exact(family,a,times(j)))
      end do
      if (any(values/=again)) error stop 'repeated interpolation changed'
      dense_entries=dense_entries+2*3*17; solves=solves+1
   end subroutine fixture
   subroutine compare(y,reference)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: y(3),reference(3)
      real(wp) :: error
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'nonfinite solution'
      error=maxval(abs(y-reference)/(1+abs(reference)))
      worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>5e-9_wp) error stop 'closed-form solution mismatch'
   end subroutine compare
end program checked_flint

name: gams-linalg-lu-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/lu-orbits-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_linalg_lu
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64,int32
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite,ieee_is_nan
   use linalg, only: lu_factor,solve_lu
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(6)=[1,2,3,5,8,13],singular_sizes(4)=[1,2,5,8]
   integer :: s,pattern,scale,order,fixtures=0,solves=0,entries=0,rejections=0,pivoted=0
   real(real64) :: worst_solution=0,worst_residual=0,worst_factor=0
   do s=1,size(sizes)
      do pattern=1,4
         do scale=1,2
            do order=1,2
               call fixture(sizes(s),pattern,scale,order)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   do s=1,size(singular_sizes)
      call singular(singular_sizes(s),1)
      call singular(singular_sizes(s),2)
   end do
   if (pivoted==0) error stop 'pivoting not exercised'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Nonsingular factorizations: ',fixtures
   print '(a,i0)', 'Vector/matrix solve calls: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known solution entries: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Singular NaN diagnostics: ',rejections
   print '(a,i0)', 'Factorizations with row swaps: ',pivoted
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_solution
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled factorization error: ',worst_factor
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-lu-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n,pattern,scale,order)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,pattern,scale,order
      real(real64) :: base(n,n),a(n,n),saved(n,n),truth(n,3),b(n,3),bsave(n,3),factor_error,value
      real(real64), allocatable :: packed(:,:),l(:,:),u(:,:),p(:,:),x(:),many(:,:),packed_copy(:,:)
      integer(int32), allocatable :: ipvt(:)
      integer :: i,j,k,r,rows(n),tmp
      base=0
      do i=1,n
         do j=1,n
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               if (i/=j) base(i,j)=real(mod(7*i+3*j,11)-5,real64)/16
            case(2)
               if (j>i) base(i,j)=real(mod(7*i+3*j,11)-5,real64)/16
            case(3)
               if (i>j) base(i,j)=real(mod(7*i+3*j,11)-5,real64)/16
            case(4)
               if (j==mod(i,n)+1) base(i,j)=real(i+1,real64)
            end select
         end do
         if (pattern/=4) base(i,i)=1+sum(abs(base(i,:)))
      end do
      a=base
      if (order==2) a=base(n:1:-1,:)
      if (scale==1) a=a*1e-6_real64
      if (scale==2) a=a*1e6_real64
      saved=a
      do i=1,n
         truth(i,:)=[1.0_real64,real((-1)**i*i,real64)/8,real(i*(n+1-i),real64)/4]
      end do
      b=0
      do r=1,3
         do i=1,n
            do j=1,n
               b(i,r)=b(i,r)+saved(i,j)*truth(j,r)
            end do
         end do
      end do
      bsave=b
      call lu_factor(a,ipvt=ipvt,lu=packed,l=l,u=u,p=p)
      if (any(a/=saved)) error stop 'factorization changed input'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(packed)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(l)).or. &
          .not.all(ieee_is_finite(u)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(p))) error stop 'nonfinite factors'
      if (size(ipvt)/=n.or.any(shape(packed)/=[n,n])) error stop 'factor output shape'
      if (any(ipvt<1).or.any(ipvt>n)) error stop 'pivot range'
      rows=[(i,i=1,n)]
      do i=1,n
         if (ipvt(i)<i) error stop 'LAPACK pivot range'
         tmp=rows(i); rows(i)=rows(ipvt(i)); rows(ipvt(i))=tmp
      end do
      if (any(ipvt/=[(i,i=1,n)])) pivoted=pivoted+1
      factor_error=0
      do i=1,n
         if (l(i,i)/=1) error stop 'nonunit L diagonal'
         do j=1,n
            if (j>i.and.l(i,j)/=0) error stop 'L not lower triangular'
            if (i>j.and.u(i,j)/=0) error stop 'U not upper triangular'
            if (p(i,j)/=real(merge(1,0,j==rows(i)),real64)) error stop 'pivot matrix convention'
            value=0
            do k=1,n
               value=value+l(i,k)*u(k,j)
            end do
            factor_error=max(factor_error,abs(value-saved(rows(i),j))/maxval(abs(saved)))
         end do
      end do
      worst_factor=max(worst_factor,factor_error)
      if (factor_error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'P*A versus L*U mismatch'
      packed_copy=packed
      do r=1,3
         x=solve_lu(packed,ipvt,b(:,r))
         call check_solution(x,truth(:,r),saved,bsave(:,r))
      end do
      many=solve_lu(packed,ipvt,b)
      if (any(shape(many)/=[n,3])) error stop 'matrix solution shape'
      do r=1,3
         call check_solution(many(:,r),truth(:,r),saved,bsave(:,r))
      end do
      if (any(b/=bsave).or.any(packed/=packed_copy)) error stop 'solve input modified'
      solves=solves+4; fixtures=fixtures+1
   end subroutine fixture
   subroutine check_solution(x,truth,a,b)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:),truth(:),a(:,:),b(:)
      real(real64) :: error,residual,value,denominator
      integer :: i,j
      if (size(x)/=size(truth)) error stop 'vector solution shape'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite solution'
      error=maxval(abs(x-truth)/(1+abs(truth)))
      denominator=maxval(sum(abs(a),dim=2))*maxval(abs(x))+maxval(abs(b))
      residual=0
      do i=1,size(x)
         value=-b(i)
         do j=1,size(x)
            value=value+a(i,j)*x(j)
         end do
         residual=max(residual,abs(value)/denominator)
      end do
      worst_solution=max(worst_solution,error); worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual)
      if (error>2e-12_real64.or.residual>2e-12_real64) error stop 'known solution or residual mismatch'
      entries=entries+size(x)
   end subroutine check_solution
   subroutine singular(n,pattern)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,pattern
      real(real64) :: a(n,n),saved(n,n)
      real(real64), allocatable :: packed(:,:),l(:,:),u(:,:),p(:,:)
      integer(int32), allocatable :: ipvt(:)
      integer :: i
      a=0
      if (pattern==2.and.n>1) then
         do i=1,n
            a(i,i)=1
         end do
         a(n,:)=a(1,:)
      end if
      saved=a
      call lu_factor(a,ipvt=ipvt,lu=packed,l=l,u=u,p=p)
      if (any(a/=saved)) error stop 'singular input changed'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_nan(packed)).or..not.all(ieee_is_nan(l)).or. &
          .not.all(ieee_is_nan(u)).or..not.all(ieee_is_nan(p))) error stop 'singular diagnostic missing'
      if (any(ipvt/=0)) error stop 'singular pivot sentinel missing'
      rejections=rejections+1
   end subroutine singular
end program checked_linalg_lu

name: gams-fat-orbit-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/lu-orbits-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_orbital_elements
   use fortran_astrodynamics_toolkit, only: orbital_elements_to_rv,wp=>fat_wp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: pi=acos(-1.0_wp),eccs(5)=[0.0_wp,0.2_wp,0.7_wp,1.0_wp,1.5_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: inclinations(5)=[0.0_wp,0.3_wp,pi/2,pi-0.4_wp,pi]
   real(wp), parameter :: anomalies(4)=[-1.2_wp,0.0_wp,0.8_wp,2.0_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: mus(3)=[1.0_wp,398600.4418_wp,1e6_wp],ps(3)=[2.0_wp,7000.0_wp,2e5_wp]
   real(wp) :: raan,aop,mu,p,e,inc,nu,r(3),v(3),rr(3),vv(3),h(3),ev(3),normal(3)
   real(wp) :: radius,speed_scale,energy,expected_energy,error,worst_components=0,worst_invariants=0
   integer :: ie,ii,ir,ia,it,is,cases=0
   do ie=1,5
      e=eccs(ie)
      do ii=1,5
         inc=inclinations(ii)
         do ir=1,2
            ! Undefined nodes/periapses use canonical zero angles.
            if ((ii==1.or.ii==5).and.ir==2) cycle
            raan=real(ir-1,wp)*1.2_wp
            do ia=1,2
               if (ie==1.and.ia==2) cycle
               aop=real(ia-1,wp)*0.7_wp
               do it=1,4
                  nu=anomalies(it)
                  do is=1,3
                     mu=mus(is); p=ps(is); speed_scale=sqrt(mu/p)
                     if (1+e*cos(nu)<=0) error stop 'nonphysical anomaly fixture'
                     call orbital_elements_to_rv(mu,p,e,inc,raan,aop,nu,r,v)
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(r)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'nonfinite state'
                     radius=p/(1+e*cos(nu))
                     rr=[radius*cos(nu),radius*sin(nu),0.0_wp]
                     vv=speed_scale*[-sin(nu),e+cos(nu),0.0_wp]
                     ! Apply three separate geometric rotations, not the library rotation matrix.
                     call rotate_z(rr,aop); call rotate_x(rr,inc); call rotate_z(rr,raan)
                     call rotate_z(vv,aop); call rotate_x(vv,inc); call rotate_z(vv,raan)
                     error=max(maxval(abs(r-rr))/p,maxval(abs(v-vv))/speed_scale)
                     worst_components=max(worst_components,error)
                     if (error>5e-12_wp) error stop 'Cartesian component reference mismatch'
                     h=cross(r,v)
                     ev=cross(v,h)/mu-r/norm2(r)
                     energy=sum(v*v)/2-mu/norm2(r)
                     expected_energy=mu*(e*e-1)/(2*p)
                     normal=[sin(raan)*sin(inc),-cos(raan)*sin(inc),cos(inc)]
                     error=max(abs(norm2(r)-radius)/p, &
                        abs(sum(h*h)/(mu*p)-1), &
                        abs(norm2(ev)-e)/(1+e), &
                        abs(energy-expected_energy)/(mu/p), &
                        abs(dot_product(r,v)/norm2(r)/speed_scale-e*sin(nu)), &
                        maxval(abs(h/sqrt(mu*p)-normal)))
                     worst_invariants=max(worst_invariants,error)
                     if (error>5e-12_wp) error stop 'orbital invariant mismatch'
                     cases=cases+1
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Orbital state conversions: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Cartesian component references: ',6*cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Scalar invariant/direction checks: ',8*cases
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled component error: ',worst_components
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled invariant error: ',worst_invariants
   print '(a)', 'PASS fat-orbit-reference'
contains
   subroutine rotate_z(x,angle)
      real(wp), intent(inout) :: x(3)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: angle
      real(wp) :: a,b
      a=x(1); b=x(2)
      x(1)=cos(angle)*a-sin(angle)*b
      x(2)=sin(angle)*a+cos(angle)*b
   end subroutine rotate_z
   subroutine rotate_x(x,angle)
      real(wp), intent(inout) :: x(3)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: angle
      real(wp) :: a,b
      a=x(2); b=x(3)
      x(2)=cos(angle)*a-sin(angle)*b
      x(3)=sin(angle)*a+cos(angle)*b
   end subroutine rotate_x
   function cross(a,b) result(c)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: a(3),b(3)
      real(wp) :: c(3)
      c=[a(2)*b(3)-a(3)*b(2),a(3)*b(1)-a(1)*b(3),a(1)*b(2)-a(2)*b(1)]
   end function cross
end program checked_orbital_elements

name: gams-daskr-dae-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/dae-fft-drivers-MIT.txt.
module closed_form_dae
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine residual(t,y,yp,cj,delta,ires,rpar,ipar)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: t,y(*),yp(*),cj
      real(real64), intent(out) :: delta(*)
      integer, intent(inout) :: ires,ipar(*)
      real(real64), intent(inout) :: rpar(*)
      real(real64) :: tau
      tau=t-rpar(6)
      if (ipar(1)==1) then
         delta(1)=yp(1)+rpar(1)*y(1)
         delta(2)=yp(2)+rpar(2)*y(2)-rpar(3)*y(1)
         delta(3)=y(3)-y(1)-y(2)*y(2)
      else
         delta(1)=yp(1)-2*tau
         delta(2)=yp(2)-y(1)
         delta(3)=y(3)-sin(tau)-y(1)*y(2)
      end if
   end subroutine residual
   subroutine jacobian(t,y,yp,pd,cj,rpar,ipar)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: t,y(*),yp(*),cj
      real(real64), intent(out) :: pd(3,3)
      real(real64), intent(inout) :: rpar(*)
      integer, intent(inout) :: ipar(*)
      pd=0
      if (ipar(1)==1) then
         pd(1,1)=rpar(1)+cj; pd(2,1)=-rpar(3); pd(2,2)=rpar(2)+cj
         pd(3,1)=-1; pd(3,2)=-2*y(2); pd(3,3)=1
      else
         pd(1,1)=cj; pd(2,1)=-1; pd(2,2)=cj
         pd(3,1)=-y(2); pd(3,2)=-y(1); pd(3,3)=1
      end if
      ipar(2)=ipar(2)+1
   end subroutine jacobian
   subroutine exact(family,t,rpar,y,yp)
      integer, intent(in) :: family
      real(real64), intent(in) :: t,rpar(6)
      real(real64), intent(out) :: y(3),yp(3)
      real(real64) :: tau,a,b,c,aa,bb,ea,eb
      tau=t-rpar(6); a=rpar(1); b=rpar(2); c=rpar(3); aa=rpar(4); bb=rpar(5)
      if (family==1) then
         ea=exp(-a*tau); eb=exp(-b*tau)
         y(1)=aa*ea
         y(2)=bb*eb+c*aa*(ea-eb)/(b-a)
         y(3)=y(1)+y(2)*y(2)
         yp(1)=-a*aa*ea
         yp(2)=-b*bb*eb+c*aa*(-a*ea+b*eb)/(b-a)
         yp(3)=yp(1)+2*y(2)*yp(2)
      else
         y(1)=tau*tau+aa; y(2)=tau**3/3+aa*tau+bb
         y(3)=sin(tau)+y(1)*y(2)
         yp(1)=2*tau; yp(2)=tau*tau+aa
         yp(3)=cos(tau)+yp(1)*y(2)+y(1)*yp(2)
      end if
   end subroutine exact
   subroutine unused_callback()
      error stop 'unexpected root or Krylov callback'
   end subroutine unused_callback
end module closed_form_dae
program checked_daskr
   use closed_form_dae
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   interface
      subroutine ddaskr(res,neq,t,y,yp,tout,info,rtol,atol,idid,rwork,lrw,iwork,liw,rpar,ipar,jac,psol,rt,nrt,jroot)
         import real64
         external res,jac,psol,rt
         integer :: neq,info(*),idid,lrw,iwork(*),liw,ipar(*),nrt,jroot(*)
         real(real64) :: t,y(*),yp(*),tout,rtol(*),atol(*),rwork(*),rpar(*)
      end subroutine ddaskr
   end interface
   integer :: family,parameter,initial,offset,jacmode,tolmode,direction
   integer :: trajectories=0,points=0,analytic_runs=0
   real(real64) :: worst_state=0,worst_derivative=0,worst_constraint=0,worst_residual=0
   do family=1,2
      do parameter=1,2
         do initial=1,2
            do offset=1,2
               do jacmode=0,1
                  do tolmode=0,1
                     do direction=-1,1,2
                        if (family==1.and.direction==-1) cycle ! Avoid exponentially unstable reverse stiff IVPs.
                        call fixture(family,parameter,initial,offset,jacmode,tolmode,direction)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'DAE trajectories: ',trajectories
   print '(a,i0)', 'Requested checkpoints: ',points
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic state/derivative entries: ',6*points
   print '(a,i0)', 'Trajectories using user Jacobians: ',analytic_runs
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized state error: ',worst_state
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized derivative error: ',worst_derivative
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized constraint error: ',worst_constraint
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS daskr-dae-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(family,parameter,initial,offset,jacmode,tolmode,direction)
      integer, intent(in) :: family,parameter,initial,offset,jacmode,tolmode,direction
      real(real64), parameter :: checkpoints(8)=[0.01_real64,0.02_real64,0.04_real64,0.08_real64, &
         0.16_real64,0.32_real64,0.64_real64,1.0_real64]
      integer :: info(20),idid,iwork(100),ipar(2),jroot(1),j,ires
      real(real64) :: t,tout,y(3),yp(3),ref(3),refp(3),rtol(3),atol(3),rwork(500),rpar(6)
      real(real64) :: state_error,derivative_error,constraint_error,delta(3),scaled,den(3),tau
      info=0; iwork=0; rwork=0; ipar=[family,0]; jroot=0
      rpar=[0.5_real64*parameter,20.0_real64,0.75_real64,1.0_real64,0.25_real64,-0.5_real64]
      if (parameter==2) rpar(2)=100
      if (initial==2) rpar(4:5)=[-0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
      if (family==2) then
         rpar(4)=rpar(4)*parameter; rpar(5)=rpar(5)/parameter
      end if
      if (offset==2) rpar(6)=0.75_real64
      info(5)=jacmode; info(2)=tolmode
      rtol=1e-10_real64; atol=1e-12_real64
      if (tolmode==1) then
         rtol=rtol*[1.0_real64,2.0_real64,4.0_real64]
         atol=atol*[1.0_real64,2.0_real64,4.0_real64]
      end if
      t=rpar(6)
      call exact(family,t,rpar,y,yp) ! Consistent initial states and derivatives are supplied explicitly.
      do j=1,8
         tout=rpar(6)+direction*checkpoints(j)
         call ddaskr(residual,3,t,y,yp,tout,info,rtol,atol,idid,rwork,500,iwork,100, &
            rpar,ipar,jacobian,unused_callback,unused_callback,0,jroot)
         if (idid/=2.and.idid/=3) error stop 'requested-output status not returned'
         if (.not.ieee_is_finite(t)) error stop 'nonfinite returned time'
         if (abs(t-tout)>32*epsilon(t)*max(1.0_real64,abs(tout))) error stop 'checkpoint not reached'
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(yp))) error stop 'nonfinite DAE state'
         call exact(family,tout,rpar,ref,refp)
         state_error=maxval(abs(y-ref)/(1+abs(ref)))
         derivative_error=maxval(abs(yp-refp)/(1+abs(refp)))
         tau=t-rpar(6)
         if (family==1) then
            constraint_error=abs(y(3)-y(1)-y(2)**2)/(1+abs(y(3))+abs(y(1))+y(2)**2)
            den=[1+abs(yp(1))+abs(rpar(1)*y(1)), &
               1+abs(yp(2))+abs(rpar(2)*y(2))+abs(rpar(3)*y(1)), &
               1+abs(y(3))+abs(y(1))+y(2)**2]
         else
            constraint_error=abs(y(3)-sin(tau)-y(1)*y(2))/(1+abs(y(3))+abs(y(1)*y(2)))
            den=[1+abs(yp(1))+2*abs(tau),1+abs(yp(2))+abs(y(1)), &
               1+abs(y(3))+abs(sin(tau))+abs(y(1)*y(2))]
         end if
         ires=0
         call residual(t,y,yp,0.0_real64,delta,ires,rpar,ipar)
         scaled=maxval(abs(delta)/den)
         worst_state=max(worst_state,state_error); worst_derivative=max(worst_derivative,derivative_error)
         worst_constraint=max(worst_constraint,constraint_error); worst_residual=max(worst_residual,scaled)
         if (state_error>5e-7_real64.or.derivative_error>5e-6_real64) error stop 'closed-form mismatch'
         if (constraint_error>5e-9_real64.or.scaled>2e-6_real64) error stop 'DAE residual mismatch'
         points=points+1; info(1)=1 ! Continue with the existing BDF history.
      end do
      if (jacmode==1.and.ipar(2)<1) error stop 'user Jacobian was not invoked'
      if (jacmode==0.and.ipar(2)/=0) error stop 'unexpected user Jacobian invocation'
      analytic_runs=analytic_runs+jacmode; trajectories=trajectories+1
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_daskr

name: gams-nafpack-fft-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/dae-fft-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_nafpack_fft
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use NAFPack_kinds, only: sp
   use NAFPack_Fourier_Transform, only: Fourier_Transform,ALG_RADIX2_DIT,ALG_RADIX2_DIF
   use NAFPack_implementation_type, only: ITERATIVE,recursive
   use NAFPack_loop_method, only: init_loop_method
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: lengths(7)=[2,4,8,16,32,64,128]
   integer :: s,algorithm,pattern,scale,plans=0,transforms=0,coefficients=0
   real(real64) :: worst=0,worst_energy=0
   type(Fourier_Transform) :: transform
   do s=1,size(lengths)
      do algorithm=1,2
         do pattern=1,4
            do scale=1,3
               call fixture(lengths(s),algorithm,pattern,scale)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Plan fixtures: ',plans
   print '(a,i0)', 'FFT calls including repetitions: ',transforms
   print '(a,i0)', 'Direct coefficient references: ',coefficients
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum L1-scaled coefficient error: ',worst
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative Parseval error: ',worst_energy
   print '(a)', 'PASS nafpack-fft-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n,algorithm,pattern,scale)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,algorithm,pattern,scale
      real(sp) :: re(n),im(n),saved_re(n),saved_im(n),out_re(n),out_im(n),first_re(n),first_im(n)
      complex(real64) :: reference(n),value,phase
      real(real64) :: theta,pi,amplitude,normalization,error,energy,expected_energy
      integer :: j,k,implementation,repetition
      pi=acos(-1.0_real64); amplitude=16.0_real64**(scale-2)
      re=0; im=0
      do j=1,n
         theta=2*pi*real(j-1,real64)/n
         select case(pattern)
         case(1)
            if (j==max(1,n/2)) then
               re(j)=real(amplitude,sp); im(j)=real(-amplitude/2,sp)
            end if
         case(2)
            re(j)=real(amplitude,sp); im(j)=real(amplitude/4,sp)
         case(3)
            re(j)=real(amplitude*(cos(3*theta)+0.25_real64*cos(5*theta)),sp)
            im(j)=real(amplitude*(sin(3*theta)+0.25_real64*sin(5*theta)),sp)
         case(4)
            re(j)=real(amplitude*real(mod(7*j,19)-9,real64)/8,sp)
            im(j)=real(amplitude*real(mod(11*j,23)-11,real64)/16,sp)
         end select
      end do
      saved_re=re; saved_im=im
      normalization=sum(abs(cmplx(real(re,real64),real(im,real64),real64)))
      expected_energy=sum(real(re,real64)**2+real(im,real64)**2)
      do k=0,n-1
         value=cmplx(0.0_real64,0.0_real64,real64)
         do j=0,n-1
            theta=-2*pi*real(k*j,real64)/n
            phase=cmplx(cos(theta),sin(theta),real64)
            value=value+cmplx(real(re(j+1),real64),real(im(j+1),real64),real64)*phase
         end do
         reference(k+1)=value
      end do
      if (algorithm==1) then
         call transform%create_fft_plan_sp(n,algorithm=ALG_RADIX2_DIT)
      else
         call transform%create_fft_plan_sp(n,algorithm=ALG_RADIX2_DIF)
      end if
      do implementation=1,2
         do repetition=1,2
            out_re=-huge(1.0_sp); out_im=-huge(1.0_sp)
            if (implementation==1) then
               call transform%execute_fft_plan_sp(re,im,out_re,out_im, &
                  loop_method=init_loop_method(use_do_classic=.true.),implementation_type=ITERATIVE)
            else
               call transform%execute_fft_plan_sp(re,im,out_re,out_im, &
                  loop_method=init_loop_method(use_do_classic=.true.),implementation_type=recursive)
            end if
            if (any(re/=saved_re).or.any(im/=saved_im)) error stop 'input changed'
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(out_re)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(out_im))) error stop 'nonfinite FFT'
            error=maxval(abs(cmplx(real(out_re,real64),real(out_im,real64),real64)-reference))/normalization
            energy=sum(real(out_re,real64)**2+real(out_im,real64)**2)/n
            worst=max(worst,error); worst_energy=max(worst_energy,abs(energy-expected_energy)/expected_energy)
            if (error>64*real(epsilon(1.0_sp),real64)) error stop 'direct DFT mismatch'
            if (abs(energy-expected_energy)/expected_energy>128*real(epsilon(1.0_sp),real64)) &
               error stop 'Parseval mismatch'
            if (repetition==1) then
               first_re=out_re; first_im=out_im
            else
               if (any(out_re/=first_re).or.any(out_im/=first_im)) error stop 'repeated FFT changed'
            end if
            transforms=transforms+1; coefficients=coefficients+n
         end do
      end do
      call transform%destroy_fft_plan_sp()
      plans=plans+1
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_nafpack_fft

name: gams-propack-spectrum-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/propack-fmm-drivers-MIT.txt.
module checked_propack_operator
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   real(real64), allocatable :: matrix(:,:)
contains
   subroutine product(trans,m,n,x,y,dparm,iparm)
      character :: trans
      integer :: m,n,iparm(*)
      real(real64) :: x(*),y(*),dparm(*)
      integer :: i,j
      select case(trans)
      case('n','N')
         y(1:m)=0
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,m
               y(i)=y(i)+matrix(i,j)*x(j)
            end do
         end do
         iparm(1)=iparm(1)+1
      case('t','T')
         y(1:n)=0
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,m
               y(j)=y(j)+matrix(i,j)*x(i)
            end do
         end do
         iparm(2)=iparm(2)+1
      case default
         error stop 'unsupported operator transpose'
      end select
   end subroutine product
end module checked_propack_operator
program checked_propack
   use checked_propack_operator
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   interface
      subroutine dlansvd(jobu,jobv,m,n,k,kmax,aprod,u,ldu,sigma,bnd,v,ldv,tolin, &
                         work,lwork,iwork,liwork,doption,ioption,info,dparm,iparm)
         import real64
         character :: jobu,jobv
         integer :: m,n,k,kmax,ldu,ldv,lwork,liwork,info,iwork(liwork),ioption(*),iparm(*)
         real(real64) :: u(ldu,*),v(ldv,*),sigma(*),bnd(*),tolin,work(lwork),doption(*),dparm(*)
         external :: aprod
      end subroutine dlansvd
   end interface
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[8,12,20]
   integer :: s,shape,rotation,scale,request,solves=0,triplets=0
   real(real64) :: worst_sigma=0,worst_residual=0,worst_orthogonality=0
   do s=1,3
      do shape=-3,3,3
         do rotation=0,1
            do scale=1,3
               do request=1,3,2
                  call fixture(sizes(s)+shape,sizes(s),rotation,scale,request)
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Partial SVD calls: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Checked leading triplets: ',triplets
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum operator-scaled singular-value error: ',worst_sigma
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum operator-scaled triplet residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum orthogonality error: ',worst_orthogonality
   print '(a)', 'PASS propack-spectrum-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(m,n,rotation,scale,wanted)
      integer, intent(in) :: m,n,rotation,scale,wanted
      integer, parameter :: lwork=100000,liwork=2000
      integer :: rank,k,info,i,j,l,r,iwork(liwork),ioptions(2),iparm(2)
      real(real64) :: saved(m,n),amplitude,anorm,angle,c,s,error,value,residual,orthogonality
      real(real64) :: row1(n),row2(n),col1(m),col2(m),av(m),atu(n),options(3),dparm(1),tolerance
      real(real64), allocatable :: u(:,:),v(:,:),sigma(:),bounds(:),work(:)
      rank=min(m,n); amplitude=8.0_real64**(scale-2); anorm=rank*amplitude
      allocate(matrix(m,n),u(m,rank+1),v(n,rank),sigma(rank),bounds(rank),work(lwork))
      matrix=0
      do i=1,rank
         matrix(i,i)=amplitude*(rank-i+1)
      end do
      if (rotation==1) then
         do i=1,m-1
            angle=0.17_real64+0.01_real64*i; c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
            row1=matrix(i,:); row2=matrix(i+1,:)
            matrix(i,:)=c*row1-s*row2; matrix(i+1,:)=s*row1+c*row2
         end do
         do j=1,n-1
            angle=0.31_real64+0.007_real64*j; c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
            col1=matrix(:,j); col2=matrix(:,j+1)
            matrix(:,j)=c*col1-s*col2; matrix(:,j+1)=s*col1+c*col2
         end do
      end if
      saved=matrix
      u=0; v=0; sigma=0; bounds=0; work=0; iwork=0; iparm=0; dparm=0
      u(:,1)=sum(matrix,dim=2) ! Deterministic, nonzero start in the column space.
      options=[-1.0_real64,-1.0_real64,anorm]; ioptions=[1,1]; tolerance=1e-12_real64; k=wanted
      call dlansvd('Y','Y',m,n,k,rank,product,u,m,sigma,bounds,v,n,tolerance, &
         work,lwork,iwork,liwork,options,ioptions,info,dparm,iparm)
      if (info/=0.or.k/=wanted) error stop 'partial SVD convergence/count'
      if (any(iparm<1)) error stop 'both operator directions were not used'
      if (any(matrix/=saved)) error stop 'operator matrix changed'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(sigma(:k))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(bounds(:k)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite singular values/bounds'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(u(:,:k))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(v(:,:k)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite singular vectors'
      if (any(bounds(:k)<0)) error stop 'negative singular-value bound'
      do j=1,k
         error=abs(sigma(j)-amplitude*(rank-j+1))/anorm
         worst_sigma=max(worst_sigma,error)
         if (error>2e-9_real64) error stop 'known leading singular value mismatch'
         ! Independent scalar residuals; do not reuse the APROD callback as the oracle.
         av=0; atu=0
         do l=1,n
            do r=1,m
               av(r)=av(r)+saved(r,l)*v(l,j)
               atu(l)=atu(l)+saved(r,l)*u(r,j)
            end do
         end do
         residual=max(norm2(av-sigma(j)*u(:,j)),norm2(atu-sigma(j)*v(:,j)))/anorm
         worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual)
         if (residual>2e-9_real64) error stop 'singular triplet residual'
         do i=1,k
            value=real(merge(1,0,i==j),real64)
            orthogonality=max(abs(sum(u(:,i)*u(:,j))-value),abs(sum(v(:,i)*v(:,j))-value))
            worst_orthogonality=max(worst_orthogonality,orthogonality)
            if (orthogonality>2e-9_real64) error stop 'singular vector orthogonality'
         end do
      end do
      triplets=triplets+k; solves=solves+1
      deallocate(matrix)
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_propack

name: gams-fmm2d-laplace-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/propack-fmm-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_fmm2d
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   interface
      subroutine rfmm2d_t_c_p(eps,ns,sources,charge,nt,targ,pottarg,ier)
         import real64
         integer :: ns,nt,ier
         real(real64) :: eps,sources(2,ns),charge(ns),targ(2,nt),pottarg(nt)
      end subroutine rfmm2d_t_c_p
   end interface
   integer, parameter :: counts(5)=[1,7,64,257,1024],nt=24
   integer :: s,geometry,pattern,accuracy,order,calls=0,references=0
   real(real64) :: worst(2)=0
   do s=1,5
      do geometry=1,2
         do pattern=1,3
            do accuracy=1,2
               do order=1,2
                  call fixture(counts(s),geometry,pattern,accuracy,order)
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'FMM potential calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Direct target references: ',references
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum cancellation-scaled error at eps=1e-6: ',worst(1)
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum cancellation-scaled error at eps=1e-10: ',worst(2)
   print '(a)', 'PASS fmm2d-laplace-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(ns,geometry,pattern,accuracy,order)
      integer, intent(in) :: ns,geometry,pattern,accuracy,order
      real(real64) :: sources(2,ns),charge(ns),targets(2,nt),potential(nt),direct(nt),magnitude(nt)
      real(real64) :: saved_sources(2,ns),saved_charge(ns),saved_targets(2,nt),eps,bound,x,y,term,error,radius
      integer :: i,j,source,status
      do i=1,ns
         source=i
         if (order==2) source=ns+1-i
         x=real(mod(37*source,2017),real64)/2017
         y=real(mod(113*source,2027),real64)/2027
         if (geometry==2) then
            x=0.01_real64*x+0.75_real64*mod(source,2)
            y=0.01_real64*y+0.75_real64*mod(source,2)
         end if
         sources(:,i)=[x,y]
         select case(pattern)
         case(1)
            charge(i)=1.0_real64/ns
         case(2)
            charge(i)=real((-1)**source,real64)*(1+real(mod(source,5),real64)/8)/ns
         case(3)
            charge(i)=(real(source,real64)-real(ns+1,real64)/2)/real(ns,real64)**2
         end select
      end do
      do i=1,nt
         if (i<=8) then
            targets(:,i)=[0.11_real64+0.07_real64*i,0.23_real64+0.031_real64*i]
         else if (i<=16) then
            targets(:,i)=[0.03_real64+0.001_real64*i,0.02_real64+0.002_real64*i]
         else
            targets(:,i)=[2.0_real64+0.1_real64*i,-1.0_real64+0.03_real64*i]
         end if
      end do
      saved_sources=sources; saved_charge=charge; saved_targets=targets
      eps=1e-6_real64; bound=2e-5_real64
      if (accuracy==2) then
         eps=1e-10_real64; bound=2e-8_real64
      end if
      call rfmm2d_t_c_p(eps,ns,sources,charge,nt,targets,potential,status)
      if (status/=0) error stop 'FMM status'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(potential))) error stop 'nonfinite potential'
      if (any(sources/=saved_sources).or.any(charge/=saved_charge).or.any(targets/=saved_targets)) &
         error stop 'FMM input changed'
      direct=0; magnitude=0
      do i=1,nt
         do j=1,ns
            radius=norm2(saved_targets(:,i)-saved_sources(:,j))
            if (radius<1e-12_real64) error stop 'coincident source/target fixture'
            term=saved_charge(j)*log(radius)
            direct(i)=direct(i)+term
            magnitude(i)=magnitude(i)+abs(term)
         end do
      end do
      ! Scale by unsigned contributions, so cancellation does not make the test ill-defined.
      error=maxval(abs(potential-direct)/max(1e-12_real64,magnitude))
      worst(accuracy)=max(worst(accuracy),error)
      if (error>bound) error stop 'direct Laplace sum mismatch'
      calls=calls+1; references=references+nt
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_fmm2d

name: gams-lightkrylov-gmres-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/gmres-inverse-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_lightkrylov
   use LightKrylov, only: dense_linop_rdp,dense_vector_rdp,dense_vector,gmres,gmres_dp_opts,gmres_dp_metadata
   use LightKrylov_Constants, only: dp
   use LightKrylov_Logger, only: logger_setup
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(4)=[2,5,8,13]
   integer :: s,pattern,rhs,trans,guess,restart,solves=0,entries=0,restarted=0
   real(dp) :: worst_error=0,worst_residual=0
   call logger_setup(log_level=40,log_stdout=.false.,log_timestamp=.false.)
   do s=1,4
      do pattern=1,3
         do rhs=1,3
            do trans=0,1
               do guess=1,2
                  do restart=1,2
                     call fixture(sizes(s),pattern,rhs,trans,guess,restart)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (restarted<1) error stop 'restart cycles not exercised'
   print '(a,i0)', 'GMRES solves: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known solution entries: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Solves requiring multiple outer cycles: ',restarted
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled true residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS lightkrylov-gmres-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n,pattern,rhs,trans,guess,restart)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,pattern,rhs,trans,guess,restart
      type(dense_linop_rdp) :: operator
      type(dense_vector_rdp) :: b,x
      type(gmres_dp_opts) :: options
      type(gmres_dp_metadata) :: meta
      real(dp) :: a(n,n),effective(n,n),truth(n),right(n),start(n),value,error,residual,denominator
      integer :: i,j,info
      a=0
      do i=1,n
         do j=1,n
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               if (i/=j) a(i,j)=real(mod(7*i+3*j,11)-5,dp)/16
            case(2)
               if (j==i+1) a(i,j)=0.5_dp
               if (i==j+1) a(i,j)=-0.125_dp
            case(3)
               if (abs(i-j)==1) a(i,j)=-1
            end select
         end do
         if (pattern==1) a(i,i)=1+sum(abs(a(i,:)))
         if (pattern==2) a(i,i)=1+real(i,dp)/n
         if (pattern==3) a(i,i)=2
         select case(rhs)
         case(1)
            truth(i)=1
         case(2)
            truth(i)=real((-1)**i*i,dp)/8
         case(3)
            truth(i)=real(i*(n+1-i),dp)/4
         end select
      end do
      effective=a
      if (trans==1) then
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,n
               effective(i,j)=a(j,i)
            end do
         end do
      end if
      right=0
      do i=1,n
         do j=1,n
            right(i)=right(i)+effective(i,j)*truth(j)
         end do
      end do
      start=0
      if (guess==2) start=-0.25_dp
      operator%data=a; b=dense_vector(right); x=dense_vector(start)
      options%kdim=n
      if (restart==2) options%kdim=min(3,n)
      options%maxiter=500
      call gmres(operator,b,x,info,rtol=1e-10_dp,atol=1e-12_dp,options=options,transpose=trans==1,meta=meta)
      if (info<0.or..not.meta%converged) error stop 'GMRES convergence status'
      if (.not.allocated(x%data)) error stop 'missing solution'
      if (size(x%data)/=n) error stop 'solution dimension'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x%data))) error stop 'nonfinite solution'
      if (any(operator%data/=a).or.any(b%data/=right)) error stop 'operator or RHS changed'
      error=maxval(abs(x%data-truth)/(1+abs(truth)))
      denominator=maxval(sum(abs(effective),dim=2))*maxval(abs(x%data))+maxval(abs(right))
      residual=0
      do i=1,n
         value=-right(i)
         do j=1,n
            value=value+effective(i,j)*x%data(j)
         end do
         residual=max(residual,abs(value)/denominator)
      end do
      worst_error=max(worst_error,error); worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual)
      if (error>5e-8_dp.or.residual>2e-10_dp) error stop 'known solution/true residual mismatch'
      if (meta%n_outer>1) restarted=restarted+1
      solves=solves+1; entries=entries+n
   end subroutine fixture
end program checked_lightkrylov

name: gams-ntpoly-inverse-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/gmres-inverse-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_ntpoly_inverse
   use mpi, only: MPI_Init_thread,MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED,MPI_Finalize,MPI_Comm_size,MPI_COMM_WORLD,MPI_SUCCESS
   use DataTypesModule, only: NTREAL
   use ProcessGridModule, only: ConstructProcessGrid,DestructProcessGrid
   use PSMatrixModule, only: Matrix_ps,ConstructEmptyMatrix,FillMatrixFromTripletList, &
      GatherMatrixTripletList,DestructMatrix
   use TripletModule, only: Triplet_r
   use TripletListModule, only: TripletList_r,ConstructTripletList,AppendToTripletList,DestructTripletList
   use SolverParametersModule, only: SolverParameters_t,ConstructSolverParameters,DestructSolverParameters
   use InverseSolversModule, only: Invert
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(4)=[2,3,5,8]
   real(NTREAL), parameter :: conditions(3)=[2.0_NTREAL,10.0_NTREAL,50.0_NTREAL]
   integer :: ierr,provided,processes,s,condition,scale,rotation,cases=0,entries=0
   real(NTREAL) :: worst_error=0,worst_left=0,worst_right=0,worst_symmetry=0
   call MPI_Init_thread(MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED,provided,ierr)
   if (ierr/=MPI_SUCCESS.or.provided<MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED) error stop 'MPI initialization/thread support'
   call MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD,processes,ierr)
   if (ierr/=MPI_SUCCESS.or.processes/=1) error stop 'one MPI process required'
   call ConstructProcessGrid(MPI_COMM_WORLD,1,1,1)
   do s=1,4
      do condition=1,3
         do scale=1,2
            do rotation=0,1
               call fixture(sizes(s),conditions(condition),scale,rotation)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   call DestructProcessGrid()
   call MPI_Finalize(ierr)
   if (ierr/=MPI_SUCCESS) error stop 'MPI finalization'
   print '(a,i0)', 'SPD matrix inversions: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic inverse entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized inverse error: ',worst_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum left identity residual: ',worst_left
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum right identity residual: ',worst_right
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized symmetry error: ',worst_symmetry
   print '(a)', 'PASS ntpoly-inverse-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n,condition,scale,rotation)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,scale,rotation
      real(NTREAL), intent(in) :: condition
      type(Matrix_ps) :: matrix,inverse
      type(TripletList_r) :: list
      type(Triplet_r) :: entry
      type(SolverParameters_t) :: parameters
      real(NTREAL) :: q(n,n),a(n,n),expected(n,n),values(n),result(n,n),original(n,n)
      real(NTREAL) :: amplitude,angle,c,s,col1(n),col2(n),value,left,right,error,symmetry
      integer :: i,j,k
      q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (rotation==1) then
         do j=1,n-1
            angle=0.2_NTREAL+0.07_NTREAL*j; c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
            col1=q(:,j); col2=q(:,j+1)
            q(:,j)=c*col1-s*col2; q(:,j+1)=s*col1+c*col2
         end do
      end if
      amplitude=0.25_NTREAL
      if (scale==2) amplitude=4
      values=[(amplitude*(1+(condition-1)*real(i-1,NTREAL)/real(n-1,NTREAL)),i=1,n)]
      a=0; expected=0
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            do k=1,n
               a(i,j)=a(i,j)+q(i,k)*values(k)*q(j,k)
               expected(i,j)=expected(i,j)+q(i,k)*q(j,k)/values(k)
            end do
         end do
      end do
      call ConstructTripletList(list)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            entry%index_row=i; entry%index_column=j; entry%point_value=a(i,j)
            call AppendToTripletList(list,entry)
         end do
      end do
      call ConstructEmptyMatrix(matrix,n)
      call FillMatrixFromTripletList(matrix,list)
      call DestructTripletList(list)
      call ConstructSolverParameters(parameters,converge_diff_in=1e-12_NTREAL,threshold_in=1e-14_NTREAL, &
         max_iterations_in=200,be_verbose_in=.false.)
      call Invert(matrix,inverse,parameters)
      call extract(inverse,result)
      call extract(matrix,original)
      if (maxval(abs(original-a))/maxval(abs(a))>2e-12_NTREAL) error stop 'input matrix changed'
      error=maxval(abs(result-expected)/(1+abs(expected)))
      symmetry=maxval(abs(result-transpose(result)))/(1+maxval(abs(expected)))
      left=0; right=0
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            value=0
            do k=1,n
               value=value+a(i,k)*result(k,j)
            end do
            left=max(left,abs(value-real(merge(1,0,i==j),NTREAL)))
            value=0
            do k=1,n
               value=value+result(i,k)*a(k,j)
            end do
            right=max(right,abs(value-real(merge(1,0,i==j),NTREAL)))
         end do
      end do
      worst_error=max(worst_error,error); worst_left=max(worst_left,left); worst_right=max(worst_right,right)
      worst_symmetry=max(worst_symmetry,symmetry)
      if (error>5e-9_NTREAL.or.symmetry>5e-9_NTREAL.or.max(left,right)>5e-9_NTREAL) &
         error stop 'analytic inverse/two-sided product mismatch'
      call DestructMatrix(inverse); call DestructMatrix(matrix); call DestructSolverParameters(parameters)
      cases=cases+1; entries=entries+n*n
   end subroutine fixture
   subroutine extract(source,dense)
      type(Matrix_ps), intent(in) :: source
      real(NTREAL), intent(out) :: dense(:,:)
      type(TripletList_r) :: list
      integer :: k,i,j,n
      n=size(dense,1)
      call GatherMatrixTripletList(source,list)
      dense=0
      do k=1,list%CurrentSize
         i=list%data(k)%index_row; j=list%data(k)%index_column
         if (min(i,j)<1.or.max(i,j)>n) error stop 'gathered matrix index'
         dense(i,j)=dense(i,j)+list%data(k)%point_value
      end do
      call DestructTripletList(list)
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(dense))) error stop 'nonfinite matrix entries'
   end subroutine extract
end program checked_ntpoly_inverse

name: gams-formal-polynomial-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/periodic-calculus-drivers-MIT.txt.
module polynomial_fields
   implicit none
   integer :: p=0,q=0
   real :: origin=0,length=1
contains
   pure function scalar_field(x) result(f)
      real, intent(in) :: x(:)
      real, allocatable :: f(:)
      f=((x-origin)/length)**p
   end function scalar_field
   pure function vector_field(x) result(v)
      real, intent(in) :: x(:)
      real, allocatable :: v(:)
      v=((x-origin)/length)**q
   end function vector_field
end module polynomial_fields
program checked_formal_polynomials
   use formal_m, only: scalar_1D_t,vector_1D_t,gradient_1D_t,divergence_1D_t, &
      scalar_1D_initializer_i,vector_1D_initializer_i
   use polynomial_fields
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   procedure(scalar_1D_initializer_i), pointer :: fs=>scalar_field
   procedure(vector_1D_initializer_i), pointer :: vs=>vector_field
   integer, parameter :: grids(3)=[32,64,128]
   real, parameter :: origins(3)=[-1.5,0.0,0.75],lengths(3)=[1.0,0.5,2.0]
   integer :: order,grid,domain,fixtures=0,derivatives=0,integrals=0
   real :: worst_derivative=0,worst_quadrature=0,worst_conservation=0
   do order=2,4,2
      do grid=1,3
         do domain=1,3
            origin=origins(domain); length=lengths(domain)
            do p=0,2
               do q=0,2
                  call fixture(order,grids(grid))
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Polynomial field pairs: ',fixtures
   print '(a,i0)', 'Pointwise derivative references: ',derivatives
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic integral references: ',integrals
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized derivative error: ',worst_derivative
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum analytic integral error: ',worst_quadrature
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum conservation residual: ',worst_conservation
   print '(a)', 'PASS formal-polynomial-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(order,n)
      integer, intent(in) :: order,n
      type(scalar_1D_t) :: f
      type(vector_1D_t) :: v
      type(gradient_1D_t) :: gradient
      type(divergence_1D_t) :: divergence
      real, allocatable :: x(:),values(:),reference(:)
      real :: error,vg,fd,boundary,vg_ref,fd_ref,bound_ref,quadrature_bound
      f=scalar_1D_t(fs,order,n,origin,origin+length)
      v=vector_1D_t(vs,order,n,origin,origin+length)
      gradient=.grad.f; divergence=.div.v
      x=gradient%grid(); values=gradient%values(); allocate(reference(size(x)))
      reference=0
      if (p>0) reference=real(p)*((x-origin)/length)**(p-1)/length
      call check_derivative(values,reference)
      deallocate(reference)
      x=divergence%grid(); values=divergence%values(); allocate(reference(size(x)))
      reference=0
      if (q>0) reference=real(q)*((x-origin)/length)**(q-1)/length
      call check_derivative(values,reference)
      vg=.SSS.(v .dot. .grad.f)*f%dV()
      fd=.SSS.(f*.div.v)*f%dV()
      boundary=.SS.(f .x. (v .dot. v%dA()))
      vg_ref=0; fd_ref=0; bound_ref=0
      if (p+q>0) then
         vg_ref=real(p)/real(p+q); fd_ref=real(q)/real(p+q); bound_ref=1
      end if
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite([vg,fd,boundary]))) error stop 'nonfinite integral'
      error=max(abs(vg-vg_ref),abs(fd-fd_ref),abs(boundary-bound_ref))
      quadrature_bound=2e-4
      if (order==2) quadrature_bound=quadrature_bound+2.0/real(n*n)
      worst_quadrature=max(worst_quadrature,error)
      worst_conservation=max(worst_conservation,abs(vg+fd-boundary))
      if (error>quadrature_bound) error stop 'analytic integral mismatch'
      if (abs(vg+fd-boundary)>5e-4) error stop 'mimetic conservation mismatch'
      integrals=integrals+3; fixtures=fixtures+1
   end subroutine fixture
   subroutine check_derivative(values,reference)
      real, intent(in) :: values(:),reference(:)
      real :: error
      if (size(values)/=size(reference)) error stop 'derivative grid shape'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'nonfinite derivative'
      error=maxval(abs(values-reference)/(1+abs(reference)))
      worst_derivative=max(worst_derivative,error)
      if (error>5e-4) error stop 'polynomial derivative mismatch'
      derivatives=derivatives+size(values)
   end subroutine check_derivative
end program checked_formal_polynomials

name: gams-raffle-orthogonal-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/periodic-calculus-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_raffle_distances
   use raffle__constants, only: real32
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use raffle__geom_rw, only: basis_type
   use raffle__dist_calcs, only: get_min_dist,get_min_dist_between_point_and_atom
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(real32), parameter :: atoms(3,5)=reshape([0.,0.,0., 0.25,0.125,0.375, &
      0.75,0.5,0.125, 0.125,0.625,0.875, 0.5,0.75,0.25],[3,5])
   integer, parameter :: shifts(3,3)=reshape([0,0,0,2,-3,1,-2,1,3],[3,3])
   integer :: shape,rotation,queries=0,references=0
   real(real64) :: worst=0
   do shape=1,3
      do rotation=0,1
         call fixture(shape,rotation)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Orthogonal cell queries: ',queries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Periodic distance references: ',references
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum cell-scaled distance error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS raffle-orthogonal-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(shape,rotation)
      integer, intent(in) :: shape,rotation
      type(basis_type) :: cell
      real(real32) :: point(3),base(3),lat(3,3),u(3),v(3),real_vector(3),fractional_vector(3),got
      real(real64) :: expected(5),nearest,cart(3),scale,error,angle,c,s
      integer :: i,j,query,translation,species,atom,k
      cell%nspec=2; cell%natom=5
      allocate(cell%spec(2))
      cell%spec(1)%num=3; cell%spec(2)%num=2
      cell%spec(1)%name='Si'; cell%spec(2)%name='O'
      allocate(cell%spec(1)%atom(3,3),cell%spec(2)%atom(2,3))
      do i=1,3
         cell%spec(1)%atom(i,:)=atoms(:,i)
      end do
      do i=1,2
         cell%spec(2)%atom(i,:)=atoms(:,i+3)
      end do
      lat=0
      select case(shape)
      case(1)
         lat(1,1)=1; lat(2,2)=1; lat(3,3)=1
      case(2)
         lat(1,1)=1; lat(2,2)=2; lat(3,3)=3
      case(3)
         lat(1,1)=0.5; lat(2,2)=1.5; lat(3,3)=2
      end select
      if (rotation==1) then
         angle=0.37_real64; c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
         u=lat(:,1); v=lat(:,2)
         lat(:,1)=real(c*real(u,real64)-s*real(v,real64),real32)
         lat(:,2)=real(s*real(u,real64)+c*real(v,real64),real32)
         angle=0.21_real64; c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
         u=lat(:,2); v=lat(:,3)
         lat(:,2)=real(c*real(u,real64)-s*real(v,real64),real32)
         lat(:,3)=real(s*real(u,real64)+c*real(v,real64),real32)
      end if
      cell%lat=lat
      scale=maxval(sqrt(sum(real(lat,real64)**2,dim=2)))
      do query=1,20
         if (query<=15) then
            base=[real(mod(7*query,17),real32)/17,real(mod(11*query,19),real32)/19, &
               real(mod(13*query,23),real32)/23]
         else
            base=atoms(:,query-15)
         end if
         do translation=1,3
            point=base+real(shifts(:,translation),real32)
            do i=1,5
               expected(i)=image_reference(point,atoms(:,i),lat)
               species=1; atom=i
               if (i>3) then
                  species=2; atom=i-3
               end if
               got=get_min_dist_between_point_and_atom(cell,point,[species,atom])
               if (.not.ieee_is_finite(got)) error stop 'nonfinite atom distance'
               call compare(real(got,real64),expected(i),scale)
            end do
            nearest=minval(expected)
            real_vector=get_min_dist(cell,point,lignore_close=.false.,lreal=.true.)
            fractional_vector=get_min_dist(cell,point,lignore_close=.false.,lreal=.false.)
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real_vector)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(fractional_vector))) &
               error stop 'nonfinite nearest vector'
            call compare(norm2(real(real_vector,real64)),nearest,scale)
            cart=0
            do j=1,3
               do k=1,3
                  cart(k)=cart(k)+real(fractional_vector(j),real64)*real(lat(j,k),real64)
               end do
            end do
            call compare(norm2(cart),nearest,scale)
            queries=queries+1
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine fixture
   function image_reference(point,atom,lat) result(distance)
      real(real32), intent(in) :: point(3),atom(3),lat(3,3)
      real(real64) :: distance,wrapped(3),delta(3),cart(3)
      integer :: a,b,c,j,k
      ! Enumerate images of the rounded inputs; do not use componentwise nearest-integer wrapping.
      wrapped=real(point,real64)-floor(real(point,real64))
      distance=huge(1.0_real64)
      do a=-4,4
         do b=-4,4
            do c=-4,4
               delta=wrapped-real(atom,real64)+real([a,b,c],real64)
               cart=0
               do j=1,3
                  do k=1,3
                     cart(k)=cart(k)+delta(j)*real(lat(j,k),real64)
                  end do
               end do
               distance=min(distance,norm2(cart))
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end function image_reference
   subroutine compare(got,expected,scale)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: got,expected,scale
      real(real64) :: error
      error=abs(got-expected)/scale
      worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>128*real(epsilon(1.0_real32),real64)) error stop 'periodic image minimum mismatch'
      references=references+1
   end subroutine compare
end program checked_raffle_distances

name: gams-feq-expression-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/expressions-sky-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_feq_expressions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use FEQParse, only: EquationParser
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=343
   character(len=80), parameter :: expressions(12)=[character(len=80) :: &
      'f = x + 2*y - z', 'f = (x + 2*y)^2 + z', 'f = x*y + y*z + z*x', &
      'f = (x-y)/(2+z^2)', 'f = exp(-(x^2+y^2+z^2))', 'f = sin(x)+cos(y)-tan(z/4)', &
      'f = sqrt(2+x^2)+log(2+y^2)', 'f = abs(x-y)+abs(z)', 'f = (x^2)^2+(y^2)^2+(z^2)^2', &
      'f = pi*(x^2+y^2)+z', 'f = 2^(x/2)', 'f = exp(sin(x))+sqrt(1+y^2)/(2+z^2)']
