   real(real64) :: points(n,3),reversed(n,3),saved(n,3),expected(n),actual(n),other(n),value,worst=0
   integer :: i,j,k,l,expression,checks=0
   l=0
   do i=-3,3
      do j=-3,3
         do k=-3,3
            l=l+1; points(l,:)=[real(i,real64),real(j,real64),real(k,real64)]/2
         end do
      end do
   end do
   reversed=points(:,3:1:-1); saved=points
   do expression=1,12
      block
         type(EquationParser) :: parser,reverse_parser
         parser=EquationParser(trim(expressions(expression)),['x','y','z'])
         reverse_parser=EquationParser(trim(expressions(expression)),['z','y','x'])
         do i=1,n
            expected(i)=reference(expression,points(i,1),points(i,2),points(i,3))
            value=parser%evaluate(points(i,:))
            call compare(value,expected(i))
         end do
         actual=parser%evaluate(points)
         other=reverse_parser%evaluate(reversed)
         do i=n,1,-1
            call compare(actual(i),expected(i))
            call compare(other(i),expected(i))
            value=reverse_parser%evaluate(reversed(i,:))
            call compare(value,expected(i))
         end do
         if (any(points/=saved).or.any(reversed/=saved(:,3:1:-1))) error stop 'expression inputs changed'
      end block
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Parsed expressions: ',size(expressions)
   print '(a,i0)', 'Scalar/batch formula references: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized evaluation error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS feq-expression-reference'
contains
   function reference(expression,x,y,z) result(f)
      integer, intent(in) :: expression
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x,y,z
      real(real64) :: f
      select case(expression)
      case(1)
         f=x+2*y-z
      case(2)
         f=(x+2*y)**2+z
      case(3)
         f=x*y+y*z+z*x
      case(4)
         f=(x-y)/(2+z*z)
      case(5)
         f=exp(-x*x-y*y-z*z)
      case(6)
         f=sin(x)+cos(y)-tan(z/4)
      case(7)
         f=sqrt(2+x*x)+log(2+y*y)
      case(8)
         f=abs(x-y)+abs(z)
      case(9)
         f=x*x*x*x+y*y*y*y+z*z*z*z
      case(10)
         f=acos(-1.0_real64)*(x*x+y*y)+z
      case(11)
         f=exp(log(2.0_real64)*x/2)
      case(12)
         f=exp(sin(x))+sqrt(1+y*y)/(2+z*z)
      end select
   end function reference
   subroutine compare(got,expected)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: got,expected
      real(real64) :: error
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(got)) error stop 'nonfinite expression value'
      error=abs(got-expected)/(1+abs(expected)); worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'direct expression reference mismatch'
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine compare
end program checked_feq_expressions

name: gams-astro-sky-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/expressions-sky-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_sky_coordinates
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use astro_module, only: G2ICRS,ICRS2G
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(real64), parameter :: pi=acos(-1.0_real64),degree=pi/180
   real(real64), parameter :: pole_ra=192.85948_real64*degree,pole_dec=27.12825_real64*degree
   real(real64), parameter :: node=32.93192_real64*degree
   real(real64), parameter :: latitudes(9)=[-90.0_real64,-75.0_real64,-45.0_real64,-10.0_real64, &
      0.0_real64,10.0_real64,45.0_real64,75.0_real64,90.0_real64]*degree
   integer, parameter :: wraps(3)=[-2,0,3]
   real(real64) :: longitude,latitude,out_lon,out_lat,back_lon,back_lat,input(3),reference(3),output(3),back(3)
   real(real64) :: error,worst_direct=0,worst_roundtrip=0,worst_norm=0
   integer :: frame,i,j,k,samples=0,calls=0
   do frame=1,2
      do i=0,23
         do j=1,9
            do k=1,3
               longitude=2*pi*(real(i,real64)/24+wraps(k)); latitude=latitudes(j)
               input=unit(longitude,latitude); reference=input
               if (frame==1) then
                  ! ICRS -> Galactic, using three separately applied passive rotations.
                  call rotate_z(reference,pi/2+pole_ra)
                  call rotate_x(reference,pi/2-pole_dec)
                  call rotate_z(reference,-node)
                  call ICRS2G(longitude,latitude,out_lon,out_lat)
                  call G2ICRS(out_lon,out_lat,back_lon,back_lat)
               else
                  call rotate_z(reference,node)
                  call rotate_x(reference,pole_dec-pi/2)
                  call rotate_z(reference,-pi/2-pole_ra)
                  call G2ICRS(longitude,latitude,out_lon,out_lat)
                  call ICRS2G(out_lon,out_lat,back_lon,back_lat)
               end if
               call check_angles(out_lon,out_lat); call check_angles(back_lon,back_lat)
               output=unit(out_lon,out_lat); back=unit(back_lon,back_lat)
               error=norm2(output-reference); worst_direct=max(worst_direct,error)
               if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'independent sky rotation mismatch'
               error=norm2(back-input); worst_roundtrip=max(worst_roundtrip,error)
               if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'sky roundtrip vector mismatch'
               error=max(abs(norm2(output)-1),abs(norm2(back)-1)); worst_norm=max(worst_norm,error)
               if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'unit vector normalization'
               samples=samples+1; calls=calls+2
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Sky direction fixtures: ',samples
   print '(a,i0)', 'Forward/inverse conversion calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent rotation vector references: ',samples
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum direct vector discrepancy: ',worst_direct
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum roundtrip vector discrepancy: ',worst_roundtrip
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum unit-norm error: ',worst_norm
   print '(a)', 'PASS astro-sky-reference'
contains
   function unit(longitude,latitude) result(v)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: longitude,latitude
      real(real64) :: v(3)
      v=[cos(latitude)*cos(longitude),cos(latitude)*sin(longitude),sin(latitude)]
   end function unit
   subroutine rotate_z(v,angle)
      real(real64), intent(inout) :: v(3)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: angle
      real(real64) :: x,y
      x=v(1); y=v(2)
      v(1)=cos(angle)*x+sin(angle)*y; v(2)=-sin(angle)*x+cos(angle)*y
   end subroutine rotate_z
   subroutine rotate_x(v,angle)
      real(real64), intent(inout) :: v(3)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: angle
      real(real64) :: y,z
      y=v(2); z=v(3)
      v(2)=cos(angle)*y+sin(angle)*z; v(3)=-sin(angle)*y+cos(angle)*z
   end subroutine rotate_x
   subroutine check_angles(longitude,latitude)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: longitude,latitude
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite([longitude,latitude]))) error stop 'nonfinite sky angles'
      ! Wrapping a tiny negative angle can round to exactly 2*pi.
      if (longitude<(-64*epsilon(pi)).or.longitude>2*pi+64*epsilon(pi)) error stop 'longitude range'
      if (abs(latitude)>pi/2+64*epsilon(pi)) error stop 'latitude range'
   end subroutine check_angles
end program checked_sky_coordinates

name: gams-uint-arithmetic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/unsigned-bitsets-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_unsigned_arithmetic
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use unsigned_m
   use int_m, only: int
   implicit none
   integer :: checks=0,pairs=0
   call check8()
   call check16()
   call check32()
   print '(a,i0)', 'Unsigned operand pairs: ',pairs
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact integer checks: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS uint-arithmetic-reference'
contains
   function fixtures(modulus) result(values)
      integer(int64), intent(in) :: modulus
      integer(int64) :: values(24)
      values=modulo([0_int64,1_int64,2_int64,3_int64,7_int64,15_int64,16_int64,31_int64,63_int64, &
         127_int64,128_int64,255_int64,modulus/2-1,modulus/2,modulus/2+1,modulus-3,modulus-2,modulus-1, &
         modulus/3,modulus/5,modulus/7,modulus/11,modulus/13,modulus/17],modulus)
   end function fixtures
   subroutine check(condition)
      logical, intent(in) :: condition
      if (.not.condition) error stop 'unsigned integer reference mismatch'
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine check
   subroutine check8()
      type(uint8) :: a,b,result
      integer(int64), parameter :: modulus=256_int64
      integer(int64), parameter :: negatives(9)=[-1_int64,-2_int64,-127_int64,-128_int64,-255_int64, &
         -256_int64,-257_int64,-65536_int64,-4294967295_int64]
      integer(int64) :: values(24),x,y
      integer :: i,j
      values=fixtures(modulus)
      do i=1,size(values)
         x=values(i); a=x
         call check(int(a)==x)
         do j=1,size(values)
            y=values(j); b=y
            result=a+b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x+y,modulus))
            result=a-b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x-y,modulus))
            if (y/=0) then
               result=a/b; call check(int(result)==x/y)
            end if
            call check((a==b).eqv.(x==y))
            call check((a/=b).eqv.(x/=y))
            call check((a<b).eqv.(x<y))
            call check((a<=b).eqv.(x<=y))
            call check((a>b).eqv.(x>y))
            call check((a>=b).eqv.(x>=y))
            call check(int(a)==x.and.int(b)==y)
            pairs=pairs+1
         end do
      end do
      do i=1,size(negatives)
         a=negatives(i)
         call check(int(a)==modulo(negatives(i),modulus))
      end do
   end subroutine check8
   subroutine check16()
      type(uint16) :: a,b,result
      integer(int64), parameter :: modulus=65536_int64
      integer(int64), parameter :: negatives(9)=[-1_int64,-2_int64,-127_int64,-128_int64,-255_int64, &
         -256_int64,-257_int64,-65536_int64,-4294967295_int64]
      integer(int64) :: values(24),x,y
      integer :: i,j
      values=fixtures(modulus)
      do i=1,size(values)
         x=values(i); a=x
         call check(int(a)==x)
         do j=1,size(values)
            y=values(j); b=y
            result=a+b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x+y,modulus))
            result=a-b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x-y,modulus))
            if (y/=0) then
               result=a/b; call check(int(result)==x/y)
            end if
            call check((a==b).eqv.(x==y))
            call check((a/=b).eqv.(x/=y))
            call check((a<b).eqv.(x<y))
            call check((a<=b).eqv.(x<=y))
            call check((a>b).eqv.(x>y))
            call check((a>=b).eqv.(x>=y))
            call check(int(a)==x.and.int(b)==y)
            pairs=pairs+1
         end do
      end do
      do i=1,size(negatives)
         a=negatives(i)
         call check(int(a)==modulo(negatives(i),modulus))
      end do
   end subroutine check16
   subroutine check32()
      type(uint32) :: a,b,result
      integer(int64), parameter :: modulus=4294967296_int64
      integer(int64), parameter :: negatives(9)=[-1_int64,-2_int64,-127_int64,-128_int64,-255_int64, &
         -256_int64,-257_int64,-65536_int64,-4294967295_int64]
      integer(int64) :: values(24),x,y
      integer :: i,j
      values=fixtures(modulus)
      do i=1,size(values)
         x=values(i); a=x
         call check(int(a)==x)
         do j=1,size(values)
            y=values(j); b=y
            result=a+b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x+y,modulus))
            result=a-b; call check(int(result)==modulo(x-y,modulus))
            if (y/=0) then
               result=a/b; call check(int(result)==x/y)
            end if
            call check((a==b).eqv.(x==y))
            call check((a/=b).eqv.(x/=y))
            call check((a<b).eqv.(x<y))
            call check((a<=b).eqv.(x<=y))
            call check((a>b).eqv.(x>y))
            call check((a>=b).eqv.(x>=y))
            call check(int(a)==x.and.int(b)==y)
            pairs=pairs+1
         end do
      end do
      do i=1,size(negatives)
         a=negatives(i)
         call check(int(a)==modulo(negatives(i),modulus))
      end do
   end subroutine check32
end program checked_unsigned_arithmetic

name: gams-orbs-bitwise-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/unsigned-bitsets-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_bitsets
   use orbs
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: widths(11)=[1,4,8,31,32,63,64,65,127,128,129]
   type(operable_bitset) :: a,b,c
   character(:), allocatable :: lhs,rhs,expected
   integer :: w,n,i,j,k,amount,carry,digit,borrow,checks=0,pairs=0
   do w=1,size(widths)
      n=widths(w)
      do i=0,15
         lhs=pattern(n,i); a=operable_bitset(lhs)
         do j=0,15
            rhs=pattern(n,j); b=operable_bitset(rhs)
            expected=repeat('0',n)
            do k=1,n
               if (lhs(k:k)=='1'.and.rhs(k:k)=='1') expected(k:k)='1'
            end do
            c=a.and.b; call compare(c,expected)
            do k=1,n
               expected(k:k)='0'
               if (lhs(k:k)=='1'.or.rhs(k:k)=='1') expected(k:k)='1'
            end do
            c=a.or.b; call compare(c,expected)
            do k=1,n
               expected(k:k)='0'
               if (lhs(k:k)/=rhs(k:k)) expected(k:k)='1'
            end do
            c=a.xor.b; call compare(c,expected)
            do k=1,n
               expected(k:k)='0'
               if (lhs(k:k)=='1'.and.rhs(k:k)=='0') expected(k:k)='1'
            end do
            c=a.andnot.b; call compare(c,expected)
            ! Schoolbook base-two arithmetic, independent of bitset and bstrith calls.
            carry=0
            do k=n,1,-1
               digit=merge(1,0,lhs(k:k)=='1')+merge(1,0,rhs(k:k)=='1')+carry
               expected(k:k)=achar(iachar('0')+modulo(digit,2)); carry=digit/2
            end do
            c=a+b; call compare(c,expected)
            borrow=0
            do k=n,1,-1
               digit=merge(1,0,lhs(k:k)=='1')-merge(1,0,rhs(k:k)=='1')-borrow
               expected(k:k)=achar(iachar('0')+modulo(digit,2)); borrow=merge(1,0,digit<0)
            end do
            c=a-b; call compare(c,expected)
            if (a%to_string()/=lhs.or.b%to_string()/=rhs) error stop 'bitset operands changed'
            pairs=pairs+1
         end do
         expected=lhs
         do k=1,n
            expected(k:k)=merge('0','1',lhs(k:k)=='1')
         end do
         c=.not.a; call compare(c,expected)
         ! Stay strictly inside the documented shift domain, including zero.
         do amount=1-n,n-1
            expected=repeat('0',n)
            do k=1,n
               if (k+amount<1.or.k+amount>n) cycle
               expected(k:k)=lhs(k+amount:k+amount)
            end do
            c=a.shift.amount; call compare(c,expected)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Bitset widths: ',size(widths)
   print '(a,i0)', 'Operand pairs: ',pairs
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact binary-string references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS orbs-bitwise-reference'
contains
   function pattern(n,seed) result(text)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,seed
      character(n) :: text
      integer :: k
      text=repeat('0',n)
      select case(seed)
      case(0)
      case(1)
         text=repeat('1',n)
      case(2)
         text(n:n)='1'
      case(3)
         text(1:1)='1'
      case default
         do k=1,n
            if (modulo(k*k+seed*k+seed*seed,17)<8) text(k:k)='1'
         end do
      end select
   end function pattern
   subroutine compare(value,reference)
      type(operable_bitset), intent(in) :: value
      character(*), intent(in) :: reference
      if (value%bits()/=len(reference)) error stop 'bitset width changed'
      if (value%to_string()/=reference) error stop 'independent binary reference mismatch'
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine compare
end program checked_bitsets

name: gams-heatflow-bicg-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/sparse-advection-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_sparse_systems
   use constants, only: real12,int12
   use globe_data, only: ra
   use solver, only: SRSin,linbcg
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(4)=[5,9,17,33]
   real(real12), parameter :: scales(3)=[0.125_real12,1.0_real12,8.0_real12]
   real(real12), allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:),saved(:),x(:),exact(:),residual(:)
   real(real12) :: scale,error,solution_error,residual_error,worst_solution=0,worst_residual=0
   integer(int12) :: iterations
   integer :: s,n,family,q,shape,guess,i,j,solves=0,entries=0,matrices=0
   do s=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(s)
      allocate(a(n,n),b(n),saved(n),x(n),exact(n),residual(n))
      do family=1,3
         do q=1,3
            scale=scales(q); a=0
            do i=1,n
               a(i,i)=scale*(4+real(i,real12)/n)
               if (i>1) a(i,i-1)=-scale
               if (i<n) a(i,i+1)=-scale
               if (family>=2.and.i<n) a(i,i+1)=-0.5_real12*scale
               if (family==3.and.i>2) a(i,i-2)=0.25_real12*scale
               if (family==3.and.i<n-1) a(i,i+2)=-0.125_real12*scale
            end do
            call SRSin(a,0.0_real12,ra)
            if (ra%len/=count(a/=0)) error stop 'sparse storage count'
            matrices=matrices+1
            do shape=1,3
               do i=1,n
                  select case(shape)
                  case(1)
                     exact(i)=1
                  case(2)
                     exact(i)=(-1.0_real12)**i*(0.5_real12+real(i,real12)/n)
                  case(3)
                     exact(i)=0.25_real12+sin(real(3*i,real12)/n)
                  end select
               end do
               b=0
               do i=1,n
                  do j=1,n
                     b(i)=b(i)+a(i,j)*exact(j)
                  end do
               end do
               saved=b
               do guess=1,2
                  x=0
                  if (guess==2) x=[(0.1_real12*cos(real(i,real12)),i=1,n)]
                  iterations=0
                  call linbcg(b,x,1_int12,1e-11_real12,500_int12,iterations,error)
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(error)) error stop 'nonfinite solve'
                  if (iterations<1.or.iterations>500.or.error>1.01e-11_real12) error stop 'solver status'
                  residual=-b
                  do i=1,n
                     do j=1,n
                        residual(i)=residual(i)+a(i,j)*x(j)
                     end do
                  end do
                  solution_error=maxval(abs(x-exact))/(1+maxval(abs(exact)))
                  residual_error=maxval(abs(residual))/(1+maxval(abs(b)))
                  worst_solution=max(worst_solution,solution_error)
                  worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual_error)
                  if (solution_error>2e-9_real12) error stop 'manufactured solution'
                  if (residual_error>2e-10_real12) error stop 'independent residual'
                  if (any(b/=saved)) error stop 'right hand side changed'
                  solves=solves+1; entries=entries+n
               end do
            end do
            deallocate(ra%val,ra%irow,ra%jcol)
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,b,saved,x,exact,residual)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Sparse matrices: ',matrices
   print '(a,i0)', 'BiCG solves: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known solution entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_solution
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized true residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS heatflow-bicg-reference'
end program checked_sparse_systems

name: gams-hrweno-advection-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/sparse-advection-drivers-MIT.txt.
module checked_periodic_operator
   use hrweno_kinds, only: rk
   use hrweno_weno, only: weno
   implicit none
   type(weno) :: reconstruction
   integer :: n
   real(rk) :: dx,speed
contains
   subroutine rhs(t,u,du)
      real(rk), intent(in) :: t,u(:)
      real(rk), intent(out) :: du(:)
      real(rk) :: extended(n+6),left(n+6),right(n+6),flux(0:n)
      integer :: j
      extended(4:n+3)=u
      extended(1:3)=u(n-2:n)
      extended(n+4:n+6)=u(1:3)
      call reconstruction%reconstruct(extended,left,right)
      do j=0,n-1
         if (speed>0) then
            flux(j)=speed*right(j+3)
         else
            flux(j)=speed*left(j+4)
         end if
      end do
      flux(n)=flux(0)
      du=-(flux(1:n)-flux(0:n-1))/dx
   end subroutine rhs
end module checked_periodic_operator

program checked_periodic_advection
   use checked_periodic_operator
   use hrweno_tvdode, only: rktvd
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[64,128,256]
   real(rk), parameter :: pi=acos(-1.0_rk),velocities(2)=[-1.5_rk,0.75_rk]
   real(rk), parameter :: origins(2)=[0.0_rk,0.37_rk],amplitudes(2)=[0.2_rk,-0.3_rk]
   real(rk), parameter :: means(2)=[1.25_rk,-0.5_rk]
   real(rk), allocatable :: centers(:),u(:),exact(:)
   real(rk) :: time,target,dt,amplitude,mean,origin,factor,error,bound,mass_error
   real(rk) :: worst_relative=0,worst_mass=0,worst_fraction=0
   integer :: s,k,mode,v,p,a,i,checkpoint,problems=0,entries=0
   do s=1,3
      n=sizes(s); dx=1.0_rk/n
      allocate(centers(n),u(n),exact(n))
      centers=[((real(i,rk)-0.5_rk)*dx,i=1,n)]
      do k=3,3
         reconstruction=weno(ncells=n+6,k=k,eps=1e-6_rk)
         do mode=0,2
            factor=1
            if (mode>0) factor=sin(pi*mode*dx)/(pi*mode*dx)
            do v=1,2
               speed=velocities(v); dt=0.2_rk*dx/abs(speed)
               do p=1,2
                  origin=origins(p)
                  do a=1,2
                     amplitude=amplitudes(a); mean=means(a)
                     u=mean+amplitude*factor*sin(2*pi*mode*(centers-origin))
                     block
                        type(rktvd) :: integrator
                        integrator=rktvd(rhs,n,order=3)
                        time=0
                        do checkpoint=1,2
                           target=real(checkpoint,rk)*0.0625_rk/abs(speed)
                           call integrator%integrate(u,time,target,dt)
                           if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(u))) error stop 'nonfinite advection'
                           ! This fixed-step API returns the first time beyond tout, not an interpolated output.
                           if (.not.ieee_is_finite(time)) error stop 'nonfinite output time'
                           if (time<target.or.time>target+dt+1e-12_rk) error stop 'advection output time'
                           exact=mean+amplitude*factor*sin(2*pi*mode*(centers-origin-speed*time))
                           error=maxval(abs(u-exact))
                           bound=5e-12_rk
                           if (mode>0) bound=bound+0.002_rk*abs(amplitude)*(real(mode*64,rk)/n)**2
                           if (error>bound) then
                              print *, 'Advection diagnostic: ',n,k,mode,speed,origin,amplitude,error,bound
                              error stop 'analytic cell-average solution'
                           end if
                           mass_error=abs(sum(u)*dx-mean)/(1+abs(mean))
                           if (mass_error>5e-12_rk) error stop 'periodic mass conservation'
                           worst_relative=max(worst_relative,error/abs(amplitude))
                           worst_mass=max(worst_mass,mass_error)
                           worst_fraction=max(worst_fraction,error/bound)
                           entries=entries+n
                        end do
                     end block
                     problems=problems+1
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(centers,u,exact)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Periodic advection problems: ',problems
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic cell-average references: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum amplitude-scaled cell error: ',worst_relative
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error / fixture bound: ',worst_fraction
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized mass error: ',worst_mass
   print '(a)', 'PASS hrweno-advection-reference'
end program checked_periodic_advection

name: gams-formatmul-products-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/products-partitions-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_matrix_products
   use kinds, only: rk
   use formatmul, only: matmul
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dims(3,6)=reshape([1,1,1,1,3,2,2,1,4,2,3,5,5,4,3,7,5,9],[3,6])
   character(2), parameter :: methods(4)=['m1','m2','m3','m4']
   real(rk), allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:,:),saved_a(:,:),saved_b(:,:),expected(:,:),scale(:,:),c(:,:),v(:)
   real(rk) :: worst=0
   integer :: fixture,family,method,branch,m,k,n,i,j,l,products=0,entries=0
   do fixture=1,6
      m=dims(1,fixture); k=dims(2,fixture); n=dims(3,fixture)
      allocate(a(m,k),b(k,n),saved_a(m,k),saved_b(k,n),expected(m,n),scale(m,n))
      do family=1,3
         do j=1,k
            do i=1,m
               select case(family)
               case(1)
                  a(i,j)=0
               case(2)
                  a(i,j)=real(modulo(3*i+7*j,11)-5,rk)/4
               case(3)
                  a(i,j)=sin(real(2*i+3*j,rk))+(-1.0_rk)**i/4
               end select
            end do
         end do
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,k
               select case(family)
               case(1)
                  b(i,j)=real(i-j,rk)
               case(2)
                  b(i,j)=real(modulo(5*i+2*j,13)-6,rk)/8
               case(3)
                  b(i,j)=cos(real(3*i-j,rk))-real(i,rk)/(j+1)
               end select
            end do
         end do
         saved_a=a; saved_b=b; expected=0; scale=0
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,m
               do l=1,k
                  expected(i,j)=expected(i,j)+a(i,l)*b(l,j)
                  scale(i,j)=scale(i,j)+abs(a(i,l)*b(l,j))
               end do
            end do
         end do
         do method=1,4
            do branch=1,5
               select case(branch)
               case(1)
                  c=matmul(a,b,option=methods(method))
               case(2)
                  c=matmul(a,b,transA=.false.,transB=.false.,option=methods(method))
               case(3)
                  c=matmul(transpose(a),b,transA=.true.,transB=.false.,option=methods(method))
               case(4)
                  c=matmul(a,transpose(b),transA=.false.,transB=.true.,option=methods(method))
               case(5)
                  c=matmul(transpose(a),transpose(b),transA=.true.,transB=.true.,option=methods(method))
               end select
               if (any(shape(c)/=[m,n])) error stop 'matrix product shape'
               call compare(reshape(c,[m*n]),reshape(expected,[m*n]),reshape(scale,[m*n]))
            end do
            do branch=1,3
               select case(branch)
               case(1)
                  v=matmul(a,b(:,1),option=methods(method))
               case(2)
                  v=matmul(a,b(:,1),transA=.false.,option=methods(method))
               case(3)
                  v=matmul(transpose(a),b(:,1),transA=.true.,option=methods(method))
               end select
               if (size(v)/=m) error stop 'matrix vector shape'
               call compare(v,expected(:,1),scale(:,1))
            end do
            if (any(a/=saved_a).or.any(b/=saved_b)) error stop 'product inputs changed'
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,b,saved_a,saved_b,expected,scale)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Matrix/matrix-vector calls: ',products
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent scalar product entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sum-absolute-product scaled error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS formatmul-products-reference'
contains
   subroutine compare(actual,reference,sumabs)
      real(rk), intent(in) :: actual(:),reference(:),sumabs(:)
      real(rk) :: error
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite product'
      error=maxval(abs(actual-reference)/(1+sumabs)); worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>128*epsilon(1.0_rk)*k) error stop 'independent scalar product'
      if (family<3.and.any(actual/=reference)) error stop 'exact dyadic product'
      products=products+1; entries=entries+size(actual)
   end subroutine compare
end program checked_matrix_products

name: gams-metis-kway-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/products-partitions-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_graph_partitions
   use metis_c_interface
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[12,24,48],seeds(3)=[1,42,93]
   integer(idx_t), allocatable :: weights(:,:),xadj(:),adjncy(:),adjwgt(:),part(:)
   integer(idx_t), allocatable :: saved_x(:),saved_adj(:),saved_w(:)
   integer(idx_t) :: options(0:METIS_NOPTIONS-1),nvtxs,ncon,nparts,edgecut,status,reference
   integer :: s,n,family,weighted,i,j,next,parts,seed,population,partition,calls=0,vertices=0
   integer :: smallest=huge(0),largest=0
   logical :: edge
   do s=1,3
      n=sizes(s); nvtxs=int(n,idx_t); ncon=1_idx_t
      allocate(weights(n,n),xadj(n+1),part(n))
      do family=1,3
         do weighted=1,2
            weights=0
            do i=1,n
               do j=i+1,n
                  select case(family)
                  case(1)
                     edge=j-i==1.or.j-i==n-1
                  case(2)
                     edge=(j-i==1.and.(i-1)/4==(j-1)/4).or.j-i==4
                  case(3)
                     edge=(i-1)/(n/3)==(j-1)/(n/3)
                     edge=edge.or.(j==i+1.and.modulo(i,n/3)==0)
                  end select
                  if (.not.edge) cycle
                  weights(i,j)=1_idx_t
                  if (weighted==2) weights(i,j)=int(1+modulo(3*i+5*j,7),idx_t)
                  weights(j,i)=weights(i,j)
               end do
            end do
            allocate(adjncy(count(weights/=0)),adjwgt(count(weights/=0)))
            next=1
            do i=1,n
               xadj(i)=int(next-1,idx_t)
               do j=1,n
                  if (weights(i,j)==0) cycle
                  adjncy(next)=int(j-1,idx_t); adjwgt(next)=weights(i,j); next=next+1
               end do
            end do
            xadj(n+1)=int(next-1,idx_t)
            saved_x=xadj; saved_adj=adjncy; saved_w=adjwgt
            do parts=2,3
               nparts=int(parts,idx_t)
               do seed=1,3
                  status=METIS_SetDefaultOptions(options)
                  if (status/=METIS_OK) error stop 'METIS defaults'
                  options(METIS_OPTION_SEED)=int(seeds(seed),idx_t)
                  ! Pinned Fortran NUMBERING/UFACTOR indices disagree with the bundled C enum.
                  ! Keep default zero-based numbering; supply the imbalance through the typed API.
                  status=METIS_PartGraphKway(nvtxs,ncon,xadj,adjncy,adjwgt=adjwgt,nparts=nparts, &
                     ubvec=[1.1_real_t],options=options,edgecut=edgecut,part=part)
                  if (status/=METIS_OK) error stop 'METIS kway status'
                  if (any(part<0).or.any(part>=nparts)) error stop 'invalid part number'
                  do partition=0,parts-1
                     population=count(part==partition)
                     if (population<1.or.2*population*parts>3*n) error stop 'partition population'
                     smallest=min(smallest,population); largest=max(largest,population)
                  end do
                  reference=0_idx_t
                  ! Count each undirected edge once from the original dense graph, not returned CSR.
                  do i=1,n
                     do j=i+1,n
                        if (part(i)/=part(j)) reference=reference+weights(i,j)
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (edgecut/=reference.or.edgecut<0) error stop 'independent weighted edge cut'
                  if (any(xadj/=saved_x).or.any(adjncy/=saved_adj).or.any(adjwgt/=saved_w)) &
                     error stop 'graph inputs changed'
                  calls=calls+1; vertices=vertices+n
               end do
            end do
            deallocate(adjncy,adjwgt,saved_x,saved_adj,saved_w)
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(weights,xadj,part)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'K-way graph partitions: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Assigned vertices checked: ',vertices
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent weighted-cut references: ',calls
   print '(a,2i6)', 'Smallest/largest observed part: ',smallest,largest
   print '(a)', 'PASS metis-kway-reference'
end program checked_graph_partitions

name: gams-dtfft-2d-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/multidimensional-fft-drivers-MIT.txt.
module independent_fourier_reference
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(real64), parameter :: pi=acos(-1.0_real64)
contains
   subroutine make_data(nx,ny,nz,fixture,data)
      integer, intent(in) :: nx,ny,nz,fixture
      complex(real64), intent(out) :: data(nx,ny,nz)
      integer :: i,j,k
      real(real64) :: angle
      data=0
      do k=0,nz-1
         do j=0,ny-1
            do i=0,nx-1
               select case(fixture)
               case(1)
               case(2)
                  data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=cmplx(1.25_real64,-0.75_real64,real64)
               case(3)
                  if (i==0.and.j==0.and.k==0) data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=1
               case(4)
                  if (i==nx-2.and.j==1.and.k==nz-1) &
                     data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=cmplx(0.5_real64,-0.25_real64,real64)
               case(5:6)
                  angle=2*pi*(real(i,real64)/nx+2*real(j,real64)/ny+real(k,real64)/nz)
                  if (fixture==6) angle=2*pi*(2*real(i,real64)/nx-real(j,real64)/ny-real(k,real64)/nz)
                  data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=cmplx(cos(angle),sin(angle),real64)
               case(7)
                  data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=cmplx(real(modulo(3*i+5*j+7*k,11)-5,real64)/4, &
                     real(modulo(7*i+2*j+3*k,13)-6,real64)/8,real64)
               case(8)
                  data(i+1,j+1,k+1)=cmplx(sin(0.7_real64*(i+2*j+3*k))+0.2_real64, &
                     cos(0.3_real64*(3*i-j+2*k))-0.4_real64,real64)
               end select
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine make_data
   subroutine direct_transform(data,reference)
      complex(real64), intent(in) :: data(:,:,:)
      complex(real64), intent(out) :: reference(:,:,:)
      integer :: i,j,k,a,b,c,nx,ny,nz
      real(real64) :: angle
      nx=size(data,1); ny=size(data,2); nz=size(data,3)
      reference=0
      do c=0,nz-1
         do b=0,ny-1
            do a=0,nx-1
               do k=0,nz-1
                  do j=0,ny-1
                     do i=0,nx-1
                        angle=-2*pi*(real(a*i,real64)/nx+real(b*j,real64)/ny+real(c*k,real64)/nz)
                        reference(a+1,b+1,c+1)=reference(a+1,b+1,c+1) &
                           +data(i+1,j+1,k+1)*cmplx(cos(angle),sin(angle),real64)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine direct_transform
   subroutine compare(actual,reference,scale,worst)
      complex(real64), intent(in) :: actual(:),reference(:)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: scale
      real(real64), intent(inout) :: worst
      real(real64) :: error
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(actual))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(actual)))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite Fourier result'
      error=maxval(abs(actual-reference))/(1+scale); worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'independent Fourier reference mismatch'
   end subroutine compare
end module independent_fourier_reference

program checked_dtfft
   use independent_fourier_reference
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int32,int64
   use mpi_f08
   use dtfft
   implicit none
   integer(int32), parameter :: dims(2,3)=reshape([4,6,5,7,8,8],[2,3])
   complex(real64), pointer :: input(:,:),output(:,:)
   complex(real64), allocatable :: original(:,:,:),reference(:,:,:),forward(:,:,:)
   integer(int32) :: in_counts(2),out_counts(2),in_starts(2),out_starts(2),code,processes
   integer(int64) :: allocation_size
   integer :: shape_id,nx,ny,nz,count,fixture,fixtures=0,entries=0
   real(real64) :: worst_forward=0,worst_inverse=0,worst_roundtrip=0,worst_energy=0,energy_error
   call MPI_Init(code); call check()
   call MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD,processes,code); call check()
   if (processes/=1) error stop 'one MPI process required'
   do shape_id=1,3
      block
      type(dtfft_plan_c2c_t) :: plan
      nx=dims(1,shape_id); ny=dims(2,shape_id); nz=1; count=nx*ny
      allocate(original(nx,ny,1),reference(nx,ny,1),forward(nx,ny,1))
      call plan%create(dims(:,shape_id),effort=DTFFT_ESTIMATE,executor=DTFFT_EXECUTOR_FFTW3,error_code=code)
      call check()
      call plan%get_local_sizes(in_counts=in_counts,out_counts=out_counts,in_starts=in_starts, &
         out_starts=out_starts,alloc_size=allocation_size,error_code=code)
      call check()
      ! Fourier output is a Y-aligned pencil: its Fortran storage axes are reversed.
      if (any(in_counts/=[nx,ny]).or.any(out_counts/=[ny,nx])) error stop 'unexpected FFT layout'
      if (any(in_starts/=0).or.any(out_starts/=0)) error stop 'unexpected local starts'
      call plan%mem_alloc(allocation_size,input,in_counts,error_code=code); call check()
      call plan%mem_alloc(allocation_size,output,out_counts,error_code=code); call check()
      do fixture=1,8
         call make_data(nx,ny,nz,fixture,original)
         call direct_transform(original,reference)
         input=original(:,:,1)
         call plan%execute(input,output,DTFFT_EXECUTE_FORWARD,error_code=code); call check()
         forward(:,:,1)=transpose(output)
         call compare(reshape(forward,[count]),reshape(reference,[count]),sum(abs(original)),worst_forward)
         energy_error=abs(sum(abs(forward)**2)-count*sum(abs(original)**2))/(1+count*sum(abs(original)**2))
         worst_energy=max(worst_energy,energy_error)
         if (energy_error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'Parseval energy mismatch'
         ! Feed independently calculated Fourier coefficients to test the inverse separately.
         output=transpose(reference(:,:,1))/real(count,real64)
         call plan%execute(output,input,DTFFT_EXECUTE_BACKWARD,error_code=code); call check()
         call compare(reshape(input,[count]),reshape(original,[count]),maxval(abs(original)),worst_inverse)
         output=transpose(forward(:,:,1))/real(count,real64)
         call plan%execute(output,input,DTFFT_EXECUTE_BACKWARD,error_code=code); call check()
         call compare(reshape(input,[count]),reshape(original,[count]),maxval(abs(original)),worst_roundtrip)
         fixtures=fixtures+1; entries=entries+3*count
      end do
      call plan%mem_free(input,code); call check()
      call plan%mem_free(output,code); call check()
      call plan%destroy(error_code=code); call check()
      deallocate(original,reference,forward)
      end block
   end do
   call MPI_Finalize(code); call check()
   print '(a,i0)', 'Complex data fixtures: ',fixtures
   print '(a,i0)', 'Forward/inverse/roundtrip entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized forward error: ',worst_forward
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized independent inverse error: ',worst_inverse
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized roundtrip error: ',worst_roundtrip
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized Parseval error: ',worst_energy
   print '(a)', 'PASS dtfft-2d-reference'
contains
   subroutine check()
      if (code/=0) then
         print '(a,i0)', 'MPI/dtFFT status: ',code
         error stop 'MPI or dtFFT operation failed'
      end if
   end subroutine check
end program checked_dtfft
