program checked_decomp_fft
   use independent_fourier_reference
   use mpi
   use decomp_2d, only: decomp_2d_init,decomp_2d_finalize,decomp_log,decomp_info,alloc_x,alloc_z
   use decomp_2d_fft
   use decomp_2d_constants, only: D2D_LOG_QUIET,DECOMP_2D_FFT_FORWARD,DECOMP_2D_FFT_BACKWARD,PHYSICAL_IN_X
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dims(3,3)=reshape([4,3,2,5,4,3,6,5,4],[3,3])
   type(decomp_info), pointer :: physical
   complex(real64), allocatable :: input(:,:,:),output(:,:,:),original(:,:,:),reference(:,:,:),forward(:,:,:)
   integer :: code,processes,shape_id,nx,ny,nz,count,fixture,p_row,p_col,fixtures=0,entries=0
   real(real64) :: worst_forward=0,worst_inverse=0,worst_roundtrip=0,worst_energy=0,energy_error
   call MPI_Init(code); call check()
   call MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD,processes,code); call check()
   if (processes/=1) error stop 'one MPI process required'
   do shape_id=1,3
      nx=dims(1,shape_id); ny=dims(2,shape_id); nz=dims(3,shape_id); count=nx*ny*nz
      decomp_log=D2D_LOG_QUIET; p_row=1; p_col=1
      call decomp_2d_init(nx,ny,nz,p_row,p_col,complex_pool=.true.)
      call decomp_2d_fft_init(PHYSICAL_IN_X)
      physical=>decomp_2d_fft_get_ph()
      call alloc_x(input,physical,.true.); call alloc_z(output,physical,.true.)
      if (any(shape(input)/=[nx,ny,nz]).or.any(shape(output)/=[nx,ny,nz])) &
         error stop 'unexpected single-process FFT layout'
      allocate(original(nx,ny,nz),reference(nx,ny,nz),forward(nx,ny,nz))
      do fixture=1,8
         call make_data(nx,ny,nz,fixture,original)
         call direct_transform(original,reference)
         input=original
         call decomp_2d_fft_3d(input,output,DECOMP_2D_FFT_FORWARD)
         forward=output
         call compare(reshape(forward,[count]),reshape(reference,[count]),sum(abs(original)),worst_forward)
         energy_error=abs(sum(abs(forward)**2)-count*sum(abs(original)**2))/(1+count*sum(abs(original)**2))
         worst_energy=max(worst_energy,energy_error)
         if (energy_error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'Parseval energy mismatch'
         ! Feed independently calculated Fourier coefficients to test the inverse separately.
         output=reference/real(count,real64)
         call decomp_2d_fft_3d(output,input,DECOMP_2D_FFT_BACKWARD)
         call compare(reshape(input,[count]),reshape(original,[count]),maxval(abs(original)),worst_inverse)
         output=forward/real(count,real64)
         call decomp_2d_fft_3d(output,input,DECOMP_2D_FFT_BACKWARD)
         call compare(reshape(input,[count]),reshape(original,[count]),maxval(abs(original)),worst_roundtrip)
         fixtures=fixtures+1; entries=entries+3*count
      end do
      deallocate(input,output,original,reference,forward)
      nullify(physical)
      call decomp_2d_fft_finalize()
      call decomp_2d_finalize()
   end do
   call MPI_Finalize(code); call check()
   print '(a,i0)', 'Complex data fixtures: ',fixtures
   print '(a,i0)', 'Forward/inverse/roundtrip entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized forward error: ',worst_forward
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized independent inverse error: ',worst_inverse
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized roundtrip error: ',worst_roundtrip
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized Parseval error: ',worst_energy
   print '(a)', 'PASS decomp-3d-reference'
contains
   subroutine check()
      if (code/=MPI_SUCCESS) error stop 'MPI operation failed'
   end subroutine check
end program checked_decomp_fft

name: gams-lusol-update-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/sparse-spectra-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_sparse_updates
   use lusol, only: lu1fac,lu6sol,lu8rpc
   use lusol_precision, only: ip,wp=>rp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(ip), parameter :: sizes(4)=[2_ip,3_ip,5_ip,8_ip],capacity=10000_ip
   real(wp), parameter :: scales(2)=[0.25_wp,2.0_wp]
   integer(ip) :: indc(capacity),indr(capacity),luparm(30),status,n,i,j,k,column
   integer(ip), allocatable :: p(:),q(:),lenc(:),lenr(:),locc(:),locr(:),iploc(:),iqloc(:),ipinv(:),iqinv(:),rows(:)
   real(wp) :: a(capacity),parmlu(30),diag,vnorm,solution_error,residual_error
   real(wp) :: worst_solution=0,worst_residual=0
   real(wp), allocatable :: base(:,:),dense(:,:),work(:),v(:),x(:),exact(:),rhs(:),residual(:)
   integer :: s,family,scale_id,permutation,stage,pattern,direction,factors=0,updates=0,solves=0,entries=0
   do s=1,4
      n=sizes(s)
      allocate(p(n),q(n),lenc(n),lenr(n),locc(n),locr(n),iploc(n),iqloc(n),ipinv(n),iqinv(n),rows(n))
      allocate(base(n,n),dense(n,n),work(n),v(n),x(n),exact(n),rhs(n),residual(n))
      do family=1,2
         do scale_id=1,2
            do permutation=1,2
               base=0
               do i=1,n
                  base(i,i)=4+real(i,wp)/n
                  if (i>1) base(i,i-1)=-0.5_wp
                  if (i<n) base(i,i+1)=-1
                  if (family==2.and.i>2) base(i,i-2)=0.25_wp
                  if (family==2.and.i<n-1) base(i,i+2)=-0.125_wp
               end do
               rows=[(i,i=1,n)]
               if (permutation==2) then
                  rows(1)=n; rows(n)=1
               end if
               dense=scales(scale_id)*base(rows,:)
               a=0; indc=0; indr=0; k=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     if (dense(i,j)==0) cycle
                     k=k+1; a(k)=dense(i,j); indc(k)=i; indr(k)=j
                  end do
               end do
               ! Public parameter defaults documented by the upstream EZ wrapper.
               luparm=0; luparm(1)=6; luparm(3)=5; luparm(8)=1
               parmlu=0
               parmlu(1:8)=[100.0_wp,10.0_wp,epsilon(1.0_wp)**0.8_wp,epsilon(1.0_wp)**0.67_wp, &
                  epsilon(1.0_wp)**0.67_wp,3.0_wp,0.3_wp,0.5_wp]
               call lu1fac(n,n,k,capacity,luparm,parmlu,a,indc,indr,p,q,lenc,lenr,locc,locr, &
                  iploc,iqloc,ipinv,iqinv,work,status)
               if (status/=0) error stop 'sparse LU factorization status'
               factors=factors+1
               do stage=0,1
                  if (stage>0) then
                     column=1
                     do i=1,n
                        base(i,column)=0.125_wp*sin(real(i+2*stage,wp))
                     end do
                     base(column,column)=6+real(column,wp)/8
                     dense=scales(scale_id)*base(rows,:); v=dense(:,column)
                     call lu8rpc(1_ip,1_ip,n,n,column,v,work,capacity,luparm,parmlu,a,indc,indr,p,q, &
                        lenc,lenr,locc,locr,status,diag,vnorm)
                     if (status/=0) error stop 'column replacement status'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite([diag,vnorm]))) error stop 'nonfinite update diagnostics'
                     updates=updates+1
                  end if
                  do pattern=1,3
                     do i=1,n
                        select case(pattern)
                        case(1)
                           exact(i)=1
                        case(2)
                           exact(i)=(-1.0_wp)**i*(1+real(i,wp)/n)
                        case(3)
                           exact(i)=0.25_wp+sin(real(2*i,wp)/n)
                        end select
                     end do
                     do direction=1,2
                        rhs=0
                        do i=1,n
                           do j=1,n
                              if (direction==1) rhs(i)=rhs(i)+dense(i,j)*exact(j)
                              if (direction==2) rhs(i)=rhs(i)+dense(j,i)*exact(j)
                           end do
                        end do
                        if (direction==1) then
                           v=rhs; x=0
                           call lu6sol(5_ip,n,n,v,x,capacity,luparm,parmlu,a,indc,indr,p,q,lenc,lenr,locc,locr,status)
                        else
                           x=rhs; v=0
                           call lu6sol(6_ip,n,n,v,x,capacity,luparm,parmlu,a,indc,indr,p,q,lenc,lenr,locc,locr,status)
                           x=v
                        end if
                        if (status/=0.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'sparse solve status'
                        residual=-rhs
                        do i=1,n
                           do j=1,n
                              if (direction==1) residual(i)=residual(i)+dense(i,j)*x(j)
                              if (direction==2) residual(i)=residual(i)+dense(j,i)*x(j)
                           end do
                        end do
                        solution_error=maxval(abs(x-exact))/(1+maxval(abs(exact)))
                        residual_error=maxval(abs(residual))/(1+maxval(abs(rhs)))
                        worst_solution=max(worst_solution,solution_error); worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual_error)
                        if (solution_error>5e-12_wp.or.residual_error>5e-12_wp) then
                           print *, 'Solve fixture: ',n,family,scale_id,permutation,stage,pattern,direction
                           print *, 'Errors: ',solution_error,residual_error
                           print *, 'Actual: ',x
                           print *, 'Expected: ',exact
                           error stop 'known sparse solution'
                        end if
                        solves=solves+1; entries=entries+int(n)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(p,q,lenc,lenr,locc,locr,iploc,iqloc,ipinv,iqinv,rows,base,dense,work,v,x,exact,rhs,residual)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Sparse LU factorizations: ',factors
   print '(a,i0)', 'Single column replacements: ',updates
   print '(a,i0)', 'Normal/transpose solves: ',solves
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known solution entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_solution
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized true residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS lusol-update-reference'
end program checked_sparse_updates

name: gams-scalapackfx-eigen-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/sparse-spectra-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_symmetric_spectra
   use libscalapackfx_module
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite,ieee_value,ieee_quiet_nan
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(4)=[2,3,5,8]
   real(dp), parameter :: scales(2)=[0.125_dp,4.0_dp],shifts(2)=[-2.0_dp,0.75_dp]
   type(blacsgrid) :: grid
   real(dp), allocatable :: a(:,:),vectors(:,:),original(:,:),q(:,:),eigenvalues(:),expected(:)
   real(dp) :: angle,c,s,temp,eigen_error,residual,orthogonality,value,norm_a
   real(dp) :: worst_eigen=0,worst_residual=0,worst_orthogonality=0
   integer :: desca(DLEN_),descz(DLEN_),rank,processes,info,n,shape_id,spectrum,basis,scale_id,shift_id
   integer :: triangle,blocksize,i,j,k,l,systems=0,entries=0
   character(1) :: uplo
   call blacsfx_pinfo(rank,processes)
   if (processes/=1) error stop 'one MPI process required'
   call grid%initgrid(1,1)
   do shape_id=1,4
      n=sizes(shape_id)
      allocate(original(n,n),q(n,n),eigenvalues(n),expected(n))
      do spectrum=1,3
         do basis=1,2
            q=0
            do i=1,n
               q(i,i)=1
            end do
            if (basis==2) then
               do l=1,2
                  do k=1,n-1
                     angle=0.17_dp*(k+2*l); c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
                     do i=1,n
                        temp=q(i,k)
                        q(i,k)=c*temp-s*q(i,k+1); q(i,k+1)=s*temp+c*q(i,k+1)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end if
            do scale_id=1,2
               do shift_id=1,2
                  do i=1,n
                     select case(spectrum)
                     case(1)
                        expected(i)=real(i,dp)-real(n+1,dp)/2
                     case(2)
                        expected(i)=1+real(i*i,dp)/n
                     case(3)
                        expected(i)=real((i-1)/2-1,dp)
                     end select
                  end do
                  expected=scales(scale_id)*expected+shifts(shift_id)
                  original=0
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,n
                        do k=1,n
                           original(i,j)=original(i,j)+q(i,k)*expected(k)*q(j,k)
                        end do
                     end do
                  end do
                  norm_a=maxval(sum(abs(original),dim=2))
                  do triangle=1,2
                     uplo='L'
                     if (triangle==2) uplo='U'
                     do blocksize=1,2
                        call scalafx_creatematrix(grid,n,n,blocksize,blocksize,a,desca,info=info)
                        if (info/=0) error stop 'matrix descriptor'
                        call scalafx_creatematrix(grid,n,n,blocksize,blocksize,vectors,descz,info=info)
                        if (info/=0) error stop 'eigenvector descriptor'
                        if (any(shape(a)/=[n,n]).or.any(shape(vectors)/=[n,n])) error stop 'local matrix shape'
                        a=original
                        do j=1,n
                           do i=1,n
                              if ((triangle==1.and.i<j).or.(triangle==2.and.i>j)) &
                                 a(i,j)=ieee_value(0.0_dp,ieee_quiet_nan)
                           end do
                        end do
                        call scalafx_psyev(a,desca,eigenvalues,vectors,descz,jobz='V',uplo=uplo,info=info)
                        if (info/=0) error stop 'symmetric eigensolver status'
                        if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(eigenvalues)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) &
                           error stop 'nonfinite eigensystem'
                        eigen_error=maxval(abs(eigenvalues-expected))/(1+maxval(abs(expected)))
                        residual=0; orthogonality=0
                        do j=1,n
                           do i=1,n
                              value=-eigenvalues(j)*vectors(i,j)
                              do k=1,n
                                 value=value+original(i,k)*vectors(k,j)
                              end do
                              residual=max(residual,abs(value)/(1+norm_a))
                              value=0
                              if (i==j) value=-1
                              do k=1,n
                                 value=value+vectors(k,i)*vectors(k,j)
                              end do
                              orthogonality=max(orthogonality,abs(value))
                           end do
                        end do
                        worst_eigen=max(worst_eigen,eigen_error); worst_residual=max(worst_residual,residual)
                        worst_orthogonality=max(worst_orthogonality,orthogonality)
                        if (max(eigen_error,residual,orthogonality)>5e-12_dp) error stop 'independent spectral reference'
                        systems=systems+1; entries=entries+n
                        deallocate(a,vectors)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(original,q,eigenvalues,expected)
   end do
   call grid%destruct()
   call blacsfx_exit(keepmpi=.false.)
   print '(a,i0)', 'Symmetric eigensystems: ',systems
   print '(a,i0)', 'Prescribed eigenvalue references: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized eigenvalue error: ',worst_eigen
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized eigenpair residual: ',worst_residual
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum orthogonality residual: ',worst_orthogonality
   print '(a)', 'PASS scalapackfx-eigen-reference'
end program checked_symmetric_spectra

name: gams-psqp-projection-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/projection-lbfgs-drivers-MIT.txt.
module projection_problem
   use psqp_module, only: psqp_class,wp=>psqp_wp
   implicit none
   real(wp), allocatable :: center(:),target(:)
   real(wp) :: radius,height
   integer :: objective_gradients=0,constraint_gradients=0
contains
   subroutine objective(me,nf,x,f)
      class(psqp_class), intent(inout) :: me
      integer :: nf
      real(wp) :: x(nf),f
      f=0.5_wp*sum((x-center-target)**2)
   end subroutine objective
   subroutine objective_gradient(me,nf,x,g)
      class(psqp_class), intent(inout) :: me
      integer :: nf
      real(wp) :: x(nf),g(nf)
      g=x-center-target
      objective_gradients=objective_gradients+1
   end subroutine objective_gradient
   subroutine constraint(me,nf,kc,x,c)
      class(psqp_class), intent(inout) :: me
      integer :: nf,kc
      real(wp) :: x(nf),c
      select case(kc)
      case(1)
         c=x(1)-center(1)-height
      case(2)
         c=radius**2-sum((x-center)**2)
      case default
         error stop 'constraint index'
      end select
   end subroutine constraint
   subroutine constraint_gradient(me,nf,kc,x,g)
      class(psqp_class), intent(inout) :: me
      integer :: nf,kc
      real(wp) :: x(nf),g(nf)
      select case(kc)
      case(1)
         g=0; g(1)=1
      case(2)
         g=-2*(x-center)
      case default
         error stop 'constraint gradient index'
      end select
      constraint_gradients=constraint_gradients+1
   end subroutine constraint_gradient
end module projection_problem

program checked_projections
   use projection_problem
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[2,3,5]
   real(wp), parameter :: radii(2)=[0.5_wp,2.0_wp]
   real(wp), allocatable :: x(:),exact(:),y(:),xl(:),xu(:),stationarity(:)
   integer, allocatable :: ix(:)
   real(wp) :: cf(3),cl(2),cu(2),rpar(5),f,gmax,cmax,free_radius,mu,nu,exact_f,calculated_f
   real(wp) :: solution_error,objective_error,violation,kkt,worst_solution=0,worst_objective=0
   real(wp) :: worst_violation=0,worst_kkt=0
   integer :: ic(2),ipar(6),status,n,s,r,translation,pattern,start,i,cases=0,entries=0
   do s=1,3
      n=sizes(s)
      allocate(center(n),target(n),x(n),exact(n),y(n),xl(n),xu(n),stationarity(n),ix(n))
      do r=1,2
         radius=radii(r); height=0.25_wp*radius; free_radius=sqrt(radius**2-height**2)
         do translation=0,1
            center=[(real(translation,wp)*(0.25_wp*i-0.75_wp),i=1,n)]
            do pattern=1,2
               target(1)=0.7_wp*radius
               do i=2,n
                  target(i)=real(i,wp)
                  if (pattern==2) target(i)=target(i)*(-1.0_wp)**i
               end do
               target(2:)=2*radius*target(2:)/norm2(target(2:))
               exact(1)=height
               exact(2:)=free_radius*target(2:)/norm2(target(2:))
               exact_f=0.5_wp*sum((exact-target)**2)
               mu=(norm2(target(2:))/free_radius-1)/2
               nu=target(1)-(1+2*mu)*height
               do start=1,2
                  block
                     type(psqp_class) :: solver
                     x=center+0.25_wp*target
                     if (start==2) x=center+1.25_wp*target
                     x(1)=center(1)+height
                     ix=0; xl=0; xu=0; ic=[5,1]; cl=0; cu=0
                     ipar=[500,5000,0,0,1,1]
                     rpar=[0.0_wp,1e-10_wp,1e-10_wp,1e-8_wp,0.0_wp]
                     objective_gradients=0; constraint_gradients=0
                     call solver%psqpn(n,0,2,x,ix,xl,xu,cf,ic,cl,cu,ipar,rpar,f,gmax,cmax,0,status, &
                        objective,objective_gradient,constraint,constraint_gradient)
                     if (status<1.or.status>4) then
                        print *, 'Projection status: ',n,r,translation,pattern,start,status
                        error stop 'PSQP convergence status'
                     end if
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite([f,gmax,cmax]))) &
                        error stop 'nonfinite projection'
                     if (objective_gradients<1.or.constraint_gradients<1) error stop 'analytic gradients not called'
                     y=x-center; calculated_f=0.5_wp*sum((y-target)**2)
                     solution_error=maxval(abs(y-exact))/(1+maxval(abs(exact)))
                     objective_error=abs(calculated_f-exact_f)/(1+exact_f)
                     violation=max(abs(y(1)-height)/(1+radius), &
                        max(0.0_wp,sum(y**2)-radius**2)/(1+radius**2))
                     stationarity=(1+2*mu)*y-target; stationarity(1)=stationarity(1)+nu
                     kkt=maxval(abs(stationarity))/(1+norm2(target))
                     worst_solution=max(worst_solution,solution_error); worst_objective=max(worst_objective,objective_error)
                     worst_violation=max(worst_violation,violation); worst_kkt=max(worst_kkt,kkt)
                     if (solution_error>2e-5_wp.or.objective_error>5e-8_wp.or.violation>2e-7_wp.or.kkt>5e-5_wp) &
                        error stop 'analytic projection certificate'
                     if (abs(f-calculated_f)/(1+calculated_f)>5e-8_wp) error stop 'reported objective mismatch'
                     cases=cases+1; entries=entries+n
                  end block
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(center,target,x,exact,y,xl,xu,stationarity,ix)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Ball-and-plane projection problems: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic optimizer entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized optimizer error: ',worst_solution
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized objective error: ',worst_objective
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized constraint violation: ',worst_violation
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum analytic-multiplier stationarity residual: ',worst_kkt
   print '(a)', 'PASS psqp-projection-reference'
end program checked_projections

name: gams-seiscope-lbfgs-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/projection-lbfgs-drivers-MIT.txt.
program checked_lbfgs_quadratics
   use seiscope_optimization_toolbox
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[2,3,5],conditions(3)=[1,5,25]
   real(real64), parameter :: scales(2)=[0.25_real64,2.0_real64]
   real, allocatable :: h(:,:),center(:),x(:),gradient(:)
   real(real64), allocatable :: q(:,:),diagonal(:),h_reference(:,:),delta(:),true_gradient(:)
   real :: cost
   real(real64) :: angle,c,s,temp,initial_cost,true_cost,norm_h,solution_error,objective_error,gradient_error
   real(real64) :: worst_solution=0,worst_objective=0,worst_gradient=0,worst_callback=0,callback_error
   integer :: shape_id,n,conditioning,basis,scale_id,start,i,j,k,flag,calls,cases=0,entries=0
   do shape_id=1,3
      n=sizes(shape_id)
      allocate(h(n,n),center(n),x(n),gradient(n),q(n,n),diagonal(n),h_reference(n,n),delta(n),true_gradient(n))
      do conditioning=1,3
         do basis=1,2
            center=0
            if (basis==2) center=[(real(i-2)/4,i=1,n)]
            q=0
            do i=1,n
               q(i,i)=1
               diagonal(i)=1+real(conditions(conditioning)-1,real64)*(i-1)/(n-1)
            end do
            if (basis==2) then
               do k=1,n-1
                  angle=0.23_real64*(k+1); c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
                  do i=1,n
                     temp=q(i,k)
                     q(i,k)=c*temp-s*q(i,k+1); q(i,k+1)=s*temp+c*q(i,k+1)
                  end do
               end do
            end if
            do scale_id=1,2
               h_reference=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     do k=1,n
                        h_reference(i,j)=h_reference(i,j)+scales(scale_id)*q(i,k)*diagonal(k)*q(j,k)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               h=real(h_reference)
               h=0.5*(h+transpose(h))
               h_reference=real(h,real64)
               norm_h=maxval(sum(abs(h_reference),dim=2))
               do start=1,3
                  block
                     type(optim_type) :: solver
                     do i=1,n
                        select case(start)
                        case(1)
                           x(i)=center(i)+real(i)/n
                        case(2)
                           x(i)=center(i)-(-1.0)**i*(1+real(i)/n)
                        case(3)
                           x(i)=center(i)+0.5*cos(real(i))
                        end select
                     end do
                     call evaluate()
                     initial_cost=real(cost,real64)
                     call set_inputs(solver,cost,1000,conv=1e-12,l=10,print_flag=0)
                     flag=0; calls=0
                     do while (flag/=2.and.flag/=4)
                        calls=calls+1
                        if (calls>20000) error stop 'LBFGS request limit'
                        call LBFGS(n,x,cost,gradient,solver,flag)
                        if (flag==1) call evaluate()
                        if (flag<1.or.flag>4) error stop 'unexpected LBFGS request'
                     end do
                     if (flag/=2.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) then
                        print *, 'LBFGS fixture status: ',n,conditioning,basis,scale_id,start,flag
                        error stop 'LBFGS convergence status'
                     end if
                     call evaluate()
                     delta=real(x,real64)-real(center,real64); true_gradient=0
                     do i=1,n
                        do j=1,n
                           true_gradient(i)=true_gradient(i)+h_reference(i,j)*delta(j)
                        end do
                     end do
                     true_cost=0
                     do i=1,n
                        true_cost=true_cost+0.5_real64*delta(i)*true_gradient(i)
                     end do
                     solution_error=maxval(abs(delta))/(1+maxval(abs(real(center,real64))))
                     objective_error=abs(true_cost)/(1+initial_cost)
                     gradient_error=maxval(abs(true_gradient))/(1+norm_h)
                     worst_solution=max(worst_solution,solution_error); worst_objective=max(worst_objective,objective_error)
                     worst_gradient=max(worst_gradient,gradient_error)
                     if (solution_error>2e-3_real64.or.objective_error>2e-7_real64.or.gradient_error>2e-4_real64) &
                        error stop 'known quadratic optimizer'
                     callback_error=max(abs(real(cost,real64)-true_cost)/(1+abs(true_cost)), &
                        maxval(abs(real(gradient,real64)-true_gradient))/(1+norm_h*maxval(abs(delta))))
                     worst_callback=max(worst_callback,callback_error)
                     if (callback_error>64*epsilon(1.0)) error stop 'independent callback audit'
                     cases=cases+1; entries=entries+n
                  end block
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(h,center,x,gradient,q,diagonal,h_reference,delta,true_gradient)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'SPD quadratic minimizations: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known minimizer entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized minimizer error: ',worst_solution
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum initial-cost-scaled objective: ',worst_objective
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum Hessian-scaled gradient: ',worst_gradient
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum independent real64 callback discrepancy: ',worst_callback
   print '(a)', 'PASS seiscope-lbfgs-reference'
contains
   subroutine evaluate()
      integer :: i,j
      real :: displacement(n)
      displacement=x-center; gradient=0
      do i=1,n
         do j=1,n
            gradient(i)=gradient(i)+h(i,j)*displacement(j)
         end do
      end do
      cost=0.5*sum(displacement*gradient)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(cost).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(gradient))) error stop 'nonfinite callback'
   end subroutine evaluate
end program checked_lbfgs_quadratics

name: gams-fortimize-gradient-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/gradient-swarm-drivers-MIT.txt.
module quadratic_gradient_problem
   use ForTimize, only: pr
   implicit none
   real(pr), allocatable :: h(:,:),center(:)
   integer :: gradient_calls=0
contains
   subroutine objective(x,f,df,data)
      real(pr), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(pr), intent(out) :: f
      real(pr), optional, intent(out) :: df(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: data
      real(pr) :: displacement(size(x)),gradient(size(x))
      integer :: i,j
      displacement=x-center; gradient=0
      do i=1,size(x)
         do j=1,size(x)
            gradient(i)=gradient(i)+h(i,j)*displacement(j)
         end do
      end do
      f=0.5_pr*sum(displacement*gradient)
      if (present(df)) then
         df=gradient; gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
      end if
   end subroutine objective
end module quadratic_gradient_problem

program checked_fixed_gradient_steps
   use ForTimize, only: GradientDescent,minimize
   use quadratic_gradient_problem
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(3)=[2,3,5],counts(5)=[1,2,5,25,100],conditions(2)=[1,5]
   real(pr), allocatable :: q(:,:),lambda(:),initial(:),x(:),expected(:),previous(:),coefficients(:)
   real(pr) :: angle,c,s,temp,step,f,endpoint,initial_f,expected_f,previous_f,error,objective_error
   real(pr) :: worst_point=0,worst_return=0,worst_endpoint=0,worst_final_ratio=0
   integer :: shape_id,n,conditioning,basis,step_id,count_id,iterations,start,i,j,k,cases=0,entries=0
   do shape_id=1,3
      n=sizes(shape_id)
      allocate(h(n,n),center(n),q(n,n),lambda(n),initial(n),x(n),expected(n),previous(n),coefficients(n))
      center=[(real(i-2,pr)/4,i=1,n)]
      do conditioning=1,2
         lambda=[(1+real(conditions(conditioning)-1,pr)*(i-1)/(n-1),i=1,n)]
         do basis=1,2
            q=0
            do i=1,n
               q(i,i)=1
            end do
            if (basis==2) then
               do k=1,n-1
                  angle=0.31_pr*(k+1); c=cos(angle); s=sin(angle)
                  do i=1,n
                     temp=q(i,k); q(i,k)=c*temp-s*q(i,k+1); q(i,k+1)=s*temp+c*q(i,k+1)
                  end do
               end do
            end if
            h=0
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,n
                  do k=1,n
                     h(i,j)=h(i,j)+q(i,k)*lambda(k)*q(j,k)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            h=0.5_pr*(h+transpose(h))
            do step_id=1,2
               step=0.5_pr/maxval(lambda)
               if (step_id==2) step=1.5_pr/maxval(lambda)
               do count_id=1,5
                  iterations=counts(count_id)
                  do start=1,2
                     block
                        type(GradientDescent) :: solver
                        initial=center+[(real(i,pr)/n,i=1,n)]
                        if (start==2) initial=center+[(-(-1.0_pr)**i*(1+real(i,pr)/n),i=1,n)]
                        coefficients=0
                        do k=1,n
                           do i=1,n
                              coefficients(k)=coefficients(k)+q(i,k)*(initial(i)-center(i))
                           end do
                        end do
                        expected=center; previous=center
                        do k=1,n
                           do i=1,n
                              expected(i)=expected(i)+q(i,k)*(1-step*lambda(k))**iterations*coefficients(k)
                              previous(i)=previous(i)+q(i,k)*(1-step*lambda(k))**(iterations-1)*coefficients(k)
                           end do
                        end do
                        initial_f=0.5_pr*sum(lambda*coefficients**2)
                        expected_f=0.5_pr*sum(lambda*((1-step*lambda)**iterations*coefficients)**2)
                        previous_f=0.5_pr*sum(lambda*((1-step*lambda)**(iterations-1)*coefficients)**2)
                        solver%step=step; solver%max_iters=iterations
                        solver%convergence_tolerance=1e-12_pr
                        x=initial; gradient_calls=0
                        call minimize(objective,x,f,solver)
                        if (gradient_calls/=iterations) error stop 'fixed iteration gradient count'
                        if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(f)) error stop 'nonfinite gradient result'
                        error=maxval(abs(x-expected))/(1+maxval(abs(initial-center)))
                        worst_point=max(worst_point,error)
                        if (error>2e-12_pr) error stop 'analytic gradient iterate'
                        ! At this pin returned F is evaluated BEFORE the final position update.
                        objective_error=abs(f-previous_f)/(1+initial_f)
                        worst_return=max(worst_return,objective_error)
                        if (objective_error>2e-12_pr) error stop 'preceding-iterate objective'
                        call objective(x,endpoint)
                        objective_error=abs(endpoint-expected_f)/(1+initial_f)
                        worst_endpoint=max(worst_endpoint,objective_error)
                        if (objective_error>2e-12_pr) error stop 'recomputed endpoint objective'
                        if (endpoint>initial_f*(1+2e-12_pr)) error stop 'quadratic cost increased'
                        if (iterations==100) then
                           worst_final_ratio=max(worst_final_ratio,endpoint/initial_f)
                           if (endpoint/initial_f>1e-8_pr) error stop 'long-run quadratic contraction'
                        end if
                        cases=cases+1; entries=entries+n
                        if (cases==1) print '(a,2es14.5)', 'First returned / endpoint objective: ',f,endpoint
                     end block
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(h,center,q,lambda,initial,x,expected,previous,coefficients)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Fixed-step quadratic runs: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic iterate entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized iterate discrepancy: ',worst_point
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized returned-objective discrepancy: ',worst_return
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized endpoint-objective discrepancy: ',worst_endpoint
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum final / initial cost after 100 steps: ',worst_final_ratio
   print '(a)', 'Returned objective is for the preceding iterate; endpoint objective is recomputed.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortimize-gradient-reference'
end program checked_fixed_gradient_steps

name: gams-opti-rastrigin-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/gradient-swarm-drivers-MIT.txt.
module shifted_rastrigin_problem
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   real(real64), allocatable :: center(:)
   real(real64) :: amplitude
   integer :: evaluations=0
contains
   function objective(x,n) result(f)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(real64) :: f,d
      integer :: i
      f=0
      do i=1,n
         d=x(i)-center(i)
         f=f+d*d+amplitude*(1-cos(2*acos(-1.0_real64)*d))
      end do
      evaluations=evaluations+1
   end function objective
end module shifted_rastrigin_problem

program checked_particle_swarm
   use shifted_rastrigin_problem
   use psomod, only: optimizer
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(2)=[2,3],seeds(3)=[314159,271828,161803]
   real(real64), parameter :: amplitudes(2)=[1.0_real64,10.0_real64]
   real(real64), allocatable :: lower(:),upper(:),x(:)
   integer, allocatable :: seed(:)
   real(real64) :: value,reference,distance,worst_objective=0,worst_distance=0
   integer :: n,s,a,seed_id,seed_size,i,cases=0,entries=0,total_evaluations=0
   call random_seed(size=seed_size)
   allocate(seed(seed_size))
   do s=1,2
      n=sizes(s)
      allocate(center(n),lower(n),upper(n),x(n))
      center=[(real(i-2,real64)/4,i=1,n)]
      lower=center-3; upper=center+3
      do a=1,2
         amplitude=amplitudes(a)
         do seed_id=1,3
            seed=[(seeds(seed_id)+37*i,i=1,seed_size)]
            call random_seed(put=seed)
            x=huge(1.0_real64); evaluations=0
            call optimizer(80,1200,n,lower,upper,1e-10_real64,objective,x,topo=2)
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite swarm result'
            if (any(x<lower).or.any(x>upper)) error stop 'swarm result outside bounds'
            if (evaluations<1.or.evaluations>2*80*(1200+2)) error stop 'swarm evaluation budget'
            total_evaluations=total_evaluations+evaluations
            ! Independent identity: 1-cos(2*pi*d) = 2*sin(pi*d)**2.
            reference=sum((x-center)**2+2*amplitude*sin(acos(-1.0_real64)*(x-center))**2)
            value=objective(x,n); distance=maxval(abs(x-center))
            if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value).or..not.ieee_is_finite(reference)) error stop 'nonfinite swarm objective'
            if (abs(value-reference)>2e-12_real64*(1+reference)) error stop 'objective identity mismatch'
            if (reference>1e-5_real64.or.distance>1e-3_real64) then
               print *, 'Swarm fixture: ',n,amplitude,seeds(seed_id),reference,distance
               error stop 'known global Rastrigin minimum'
            end if
            worst_objective=max(worst_objective,reference); worst_distance=max(worst_distance,distance)
            cases=cases+1; entries=entries+n
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(center,lower,upper,x)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Swarm verification summary:'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Seeded shifted-Rastrigin problems: ',cases
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known global-minimizer entries: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Optimizer callback evaluations: ',total_evaluations
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum independently evaluated objective: ',worst_objective
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum coordinate error from known global optimum: ',worst_distance
   print '(a)', 'These seeded successes do not guarantee global convergence or portability of the RNG sequence.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS opti-rastrigin-reference'
end program checked_particle_swarm

name: gams-optgra-halfspace-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/projection-training-drivers-MIT.txt.
module halfspace_fixture
   use optgra_module, only: optgra, wp => optgra_wp
   implicit none
   real(wp), allocatable :: center(:), normal(:), diagonal(:)
   real(wp) :: height
   integer :: value_calls, derivative_calls
contains
   subroutine values(me,x,c,flag)
      class(optgra), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: c(:)
      integer, intent(in) :: flag
      value_calls=value_calls+1
      c(1)=sum(normal*(x-center))-height
      c(2)=0.5_wp*sum(diagonal*(x-center)**2)
   end subroutine
   subroutine derivatives(me,x,c,jac)
      class(optgra), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: c(:),jac(:,:)
      derivative_calls=derivative_calls+1
      call values(me,x,c,0)
      jac(1,:)=normal
      jac(2,:)=diagonal*(x-center)
   end subroutine
end module

program reference_halfspace
   use halfspace_fixture
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(optgra) :: solver
   integer, parameter :: dims(3)=[2,3,5]
   integer :: dn,n,cond,ih,shift,start,i,status,iterations,units(3),runs,entries,calls
   real(wp), allocatable :: x(:),exact(:),offset(:),scales(:),perturb(:)
   integer, allocatable :: lengths(:),types(:)
   character(len=80), allocatable :: names(:)
   character(len=80) :: cnames(2)
   real(wp) :: c(2),den,multiplier,fstar,point_error,objective_error,feasibility,kkt,identity
   real(wp) :: max_point,max_objective,max_feasibility,max_kkt,max_identity
   runs=0; entries=0; calls=0
   max_point=0; max_objective=0; max_feasibility=0; max_kkt=0; max_identity=0
   cnames=[character(len=80) :: 'halfspace','objective']
   do i=1,3
      open(newunit=units(i),status='scratch',action='readwrite')
   end do
   do dn=1,size(dims)
      n=dims(dn)
      allocate(center(n),normal(n),diagonal(n),x(n),exact(n),offset(n),scales(n),perturb(n))
      allocate(lengths(n),types(n),names(n))
      scales=1; perturb=1e-5_wp; lengths=1; types=0; names='x'
      do cond=1,5,4
         do i=1,n
            diagonal(i)=1+real(cond-1,wp)*real(i-1,wp)/real(n-1,wp)
            normal(i)=(-1.0_wp)**i*(1+real(i,wp)/4)
         end do
         den=sum(normal**2/diagonal)
         do ih=1,2
            height=0.5_wp
            if (ih==2) height=2.0_wp
            multiplier=height/den
            offset=multiplier*normal/diagonal
            fstar=height**2/(2*den)
            do shift=0,1
               center=[(real(shift*(i-2),wp)/4,i=1,n)]
               exact=center+offset
               do start=0,1
                  x=center+2*real(start,wp)*offset
                  value_calls=0; derivative_calls=0
                  ! Consca contains stopping thresholds, not unit scale factors.
                  call solver%initialize(n,1,values,derivatives,[1e-5_wp,1e-5_wp],[1,1], &
                     [1e-9_wp,1e-11_wp],cnames,[9,9],[1,-1],1,perturb,1.0_wp,1.0_wp, &
                     300,30,20,20,20,units(1),0,0,scales,names,lengths,types,units(2),0,0,units(3),0,2)
                  call solver%solve(x,c,status,iterations)
                  if (status/=1) then
                     print *, 'Failure n,condition,height,shift,start,status:',n,cond,height,shift,start,status
                     error stop 'Optgra did not report a feasible optimum'
                  end if
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(c))) error stop 'nonfinite result'
                  if (derivative_calls<=0 .or. value_calls<=0) error stop 'callbacks not exercised'
                  point_error=maxval(abs(x-exact))/(1+maxval(abs(exact)))
                  objective_error=abs(0.5_wp*sum(diagonal*(x-center)**2)-fstar)/(1+fstar)
                  feasibility=max(0.0_wp,height-sum(normal*(x-center)))/(1+height)
                  kkt=maxval(abs(diagonal*(x-center)-multiplier*normal))/(1+maxval(abs(multiplier*normal)))
                  identity=max(abs(c(1)-(sum(normal*(x-center))-height))/(1+height), &
                     abs(c(2)-0.5_wp*sum(diagonal*(x-center)**2))/(1+fstar))
                  if (point_error>2e-4_wp .or. objective_error>1e-7_wp) error stop 'analytic optimum mismatch'
                  if (feasibility>2e-7_wp .or. kkt>2e-4_wp) error stop 'independent KKT check failed'
                  if (identity>1e-8_wp) error stop 'returned values disagree with direct evaluation'
                  max_point=max(max_point,point_error); max_objective=max(max_objective,objective_error)
                  max_feasibility=max(max_feasibility,feasibility); max_kkt=max(max_kkt,kkt)
                  max_identity=max(max_identity,identity)
                  calls=calls+derivative_calls; runs=runs+1; entries=entries+n
                  call solver%destroy()
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(center,normal,diagonal,x,exact,offset,scales,perturb,lengths,types,names)
   end do
   do i=1,3
      close(units(i))
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Halfspace projections: ',runs,'; analytic coordinates: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytic derivative callbacks: ',calls
   print '(a,5es14.5)', 'Max point, objective, feasibility, KKT, returned-value errors: ', &
      max_point,max_objective,max_feasibility,max_kkt,max_identity
   print '(a)', 'PASS optgra-halfspace-reference'
end program

name: gams-neural-affine-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/projection-training-drivers-MIT.txt.
program reference_affine_training
   use nf, only: network,input,dense,linear,sgd
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: seeds(3)=[42,1729,314159]
   integer :: n,map,sd,batch_mode,batch,nsamples,nseed,i,j,k,idx,runs,entries
   integer, allocatable :: seed(:)
   real, allocatable :: samples(:,:),targets(:,:),point(:)
   real :: prediction(2)
   real(real64) :: w(2,2),bias(2),expected(2),initial_mse,final_mse,err,max_err,max_mse,max_ratio
   runs=0; entries=0; max_err=0; max_mse=0; max_ratio=0
   call random_seed(size=nseed)
   allocate(seed(nseed))
   do n=1,2
      nsamples=3**n
      allocate(samples(n,nsamples),targets(2,nsamples),point(n))
      do i=1,nsamples
         idx=i-1
         do j=1,n
            samples(j,i)=real(mod(idx,3)-1)
            idx=idx/3
         end do
      end do
      do map=1,2
         w(1,:)=[0.75_real64,-0.5_real64]*real(map,real64)
         w(2,:)=[-0.25_real64,1.0_real64]/real(map,real64)
         bias=[0.5_real64,-0.75_real64]*real(map,real64)
         do i=1,nsamples
            targets(:,i)=real(reference(real(samples(:,i),real64)))
         end do
         do sd=1,size(seeds)
            do batch_mode=1,2
               block
                  type(network) :: net
                  seed=[(seeds(sd)+37*i,i=1,nseed)]
                  call random_seed(put=seed)
                  net=network([input(n),dense(2,activation=linear())])
                  initial_mse=training_mse(net)
                  batch=1
                  if (batch_mode==2) batch=nsamples
                  call net%train(samples,targets,batch_size=batch,epochs=400,optimizer=sgd(learning_rate=0.1))
                  final_mse=training_mse(net)
                  if (.not.ieee_is_finite(final_mse)) error stop 'nonfinite training loss'
                  if (final_mse>1e-8_real64 .or. final_mse>1e-5_real64*initial_mse) &
                     error stop 'training loss did not approach the known zero minimum'
                  ! Test 11-point Cartesian grids, including points absent from training.
                  do i=0,10
                     point(1)=real(i-5)/5
                     do k=0,merge(0,10,n==1)
                        if (n==2) point(2)=real(k-5)/5
                        prediction=net%predict(point)
                        expected=reference(real(point,real64))
                        if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(prediction))) error stop 'nonfinite held-out prediction'
                        err=maxval(abs(real(prediction,real64)-expected))/(1+maxval(abs(expected)))
                        if (err>2e-4_real64) error stop 'independent affine prediction differs'
                        max_err=max(max_err,err); entries=entries+2
                     end do
                  end do
                  max_mse=max(max_mse,final_mse); max_ratio=max(max_ratio,final_mse/initial_mse)
                  runs=runs+1
               end block
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(samples,targets,point)
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Affine training runs: ',runs,'; test prediction entries: ',entries
   print '(a,3es14.5)', 'Max normalized prediction error, final MSE, final/initial MSE: ',max_err,max_mse,max_ratio
   print '(a)', 'PASS neural-affine-reference'
contains
   function reference(x) result(y)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(real64) :: y(2)
      integer :: a,b
      y=bias
      do a=1,2
         do b=1,size(x)
            y(a)=y(a)+w(a,b)*x(b)
         end do
      end do
   end function
   function training_mse(net) result(mse)
      type(network), intent(in out) :: net
      real(real64) :: mse,r(2)
      integer :: a
      mse=0
      do a=1,nsamples
         r=real(net%predict(samples(:,a)),real64)-reference(real(samples(:,a),real64))
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(r))) error stop 'nonfinite training prediction'
         mse=mse+sum(r*r)
      end do
      mse=mse/real(2*nsamples,real64)
   end function
end program

name: gams-conmin-ball-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/directions-fitting-drivers-MIT.txt.
program reference_feasible_directions
   use conmin_module, only: conmin_class,wp => conmin_wp
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dims(3)=[2,3,5]
   integer :: dn,n,rad,shift,direction,start,runs,entries,gradient_calls,total_gradients
   real(wp), allocatable :: center(:),target(:),exact(:),d(:)
   real(wp) :: radius,point_error,objective_error,feasibility,kkt,identity
   real(wp) :: max_point,max_objective,max_feasibility,max_kkt,max_identity
   runs=0; entries=0; total_gradients=0
   max_point=0; max_objective=0; max_feasibility=0; max_kkt=0; max_identity=0
   do dn=1,size(dims)
      n=dims(dn)
      allocate(center(n),target(n),exact(n),d(n))
      do rad=1,2
         radius=0.5_wp
         if (rad==2) radius=2.0_wp
         do shift=0,1
            block
               integer :: j
               center=[(real(shift*(j-2),wp)/4,j=1,n)]
            end block
            do direction=1,2
               block
                  integer :: j
                  d=[((-1.0_wp)**(direction*j)*real(j,wp),j=1,n)]
               end block
               d=d/sqrt(sum(d*d))
               target=center+2*radius*d
               exact=center+radius*d
               do start=0,1
                  call solve_fixture()
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(center,target,exact,d)
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Ball projections: ',runs,'; analytic coordinates: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'User-gradient requests: ',total_gradients
   print '(a,5es14.5)', 'Max point, objective, feasibility, KKT, returned-objective errors: ', &
      max_point,max_objective,max_feasibility,max_kkt,max_identity
   print '(a)', 'PASS conmin-ball-reference'
contains
   subroutine solve_fixture()
      type(conmin_class) :: solver
      integer :: n1,n2,n3,n4,n5,request
      real(wp) :: x(n+2),lower(n+2),upper(n+2),g(1+2*n),scal(n+2),df(n+2),a(n+2,n+2)
      real(wp) :: s(n+2),g1(1+2*n),g2(1+2*n),b(n+2,n+2),c(n+2),y(n),actual_f,actual_g
      integer :: isc(1+2*n),ic(n+2),ms1(2*(n+2))
      n1=n+2; n2=1+2*n; n3=n+2; n4=n+2; n5=2*n4
      x=0; lower=-100; upper=100; scal=1; g=0; df=0; a=0
      s=0; g1=0; g2=0; b=0; c=0; isc=0; ic=0; ms1=0
      ! Add a perpendicular component so neither start lies on the target ray.
      x(1:n)=center+(0.25_wp+real(start,wp))*radius*d
      y=-d(1)*d; y(1)=y(1)+1
      x(1:n)=x(1:n)+0.1_wp*radius*y/sqrt(sum(y*y))
      solver%ndv=n; solver%ncon=1; solver%nside=0
      solver%infog=0; solver%info=0; solver%nfdg=1; solver%iprint=0
      solver%itmax=300; solver%icndir=0; solver%nscal=0; solver%itrm=3
      solver%ct=-0.01_wp*radius**2; solver%ctmin=1e-9_wp*radius**2
      solver%delfun=1e-12_wp; solver%dabfun=1e-12_wp
      solver%igoto=0; gradient_calls=0
      do request=1,10000
         call solver%solve(x,lower,upper,g,scal,df,a,s,g1,g2,b,c,isc,ic,ms1,n1,n2,n3,n4,n5)
         if (solver%igoto==0) exit
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x(1:n)))) error stop 'nonfinite callback coordinates'
         y=x(1:n)-center
         select case(solver%info)
         case(1)
            solver%obj=0.5_wp*sum((x(1:n)-target)**2)
            g(1)=sum(y*y)-radius**2
         case(2)
            gradient_calls=gradient_calls+1
            solver%obj=0.5_wp*sum((x(1:n)-target)**2)
            df(1:n)=x(1:n)-target
            solver%nac=0
            if (g(1)>=solver%ct) then
               solver%nac=1; ic(1)=1; a(1:n,1)=2*y
            end if
         case default
            error stop 'unexpected reverse-communication request'
         end select
      end do
      if (solver%igoto/=0 .or. solver%iter>=solver%itmax) error stop 'iteration/request limit reached'
      if (gradient_calls<=0) error stop 'analytic derivatives not requested'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x(1:n))) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(solver%obj)) error stop 'nonfinite result'
      y=x(1:n)-center
      actual_f=0.5_wp*sum((x(1:n)-target)**2); actual_g=sum(y*y)-radius**2
      point_error=maxval(abs(x(1:n)-exact))/(1+maxval(abs(exact)))
      objective_error=abs(actual_f-0.5_wp*radius**2)/(1+0.5_wp*radius**2)
      feasibility=max(0.0_wp,actual_g)/(1+radius**2)
      ! The exact multiplier for g=norm(y)**2-R**2 <=0 is 1/2.
      kkt=maxval(abs((x(1:n)-target)+y))/(1+2*radius)
      identity=abs(solver%obj-actual_f)/(1+actual_f)
      print '(a,6i5,5es12.3)', 'Case: ',n,rad,shift,direction,start,solver%iter, &
         point_error,objective_error,feasibility,kkt,identity
      if (point_error>2e-4_wp .or. objective_error>2e-7_wp) error stop 'analytic minimizer mismatch'
      if (feasibility>2e-7_wp .or. kkt>2e-4_wp) error stop 'independent KKT check failed'
      if (identity>1e-8_wp) error stop 'returned objective differs'
      max_point=max(max_point,point_error); max_objective=max(max_objective,objective_error)
      max_feasibility=max(max_feasibility,feasibility); max_kkt=max(max_kkt,kkt); max_identity=max(max_identity,identity)
      total_gradients=total_gradients+gradient_calls; runs=runs+1; entries=entries+n
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-annealing-rastrigin-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/directions-fitting-drivers-MIT.txt.
module annealing_fixture
   use simulated_annealing_module, only: simulated_annealing_type,wp => simann_wp
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), allocatable :: center(:)
   real(wp) :: amplitude
   integer :: callback_calls
contains
   subroutine objective(me,x,f,status)
      class(simulated_annealing_type), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: f
      integer, intent(out) :: status
      real(wp) :: y(size(x)),pi
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite trial point'
      if (any(abs(x-center)>3.0_wp)) error stop 'trial outside declared bounds'
      callback_calls=callback_calls+1
      y=x-center; pi=acos(-1.0_wp)
      f=sum(y*y+amplitude*(1-cos(2*pi*y)))
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(f)) error stop 'nonfinite objective'
      status=0
   end subroutine
end module

program reference_annealing
   use annealing_fixture
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: output_unit
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: seeds(2,3)=reshape([1,2,1234,5678,91,2718],[2,3])
   type(simulated_annealing_type) :: solver
   real(wp), allocatable :: x(:),best(:),step(:)
   real(wp) :: temperature,value,reference_value,point_error,identity,max_value,max_point,max_identity
   integer :: n,amp,sd,i,accepted,evaluations,status,runs,entries,total_evaluations
   runs=0; entries=0; total_evaluations=0
   max_value=0; max_point=0; max_identity=0
   do n=2,2
      allocate(center(n),x(n),best(n),step(n))
      center=[(real(i-2,wp)/4,i=1,n)]
      do amp=1,10,9
         amplitude=real(amp,wp)
         do sd=1,size(seeds,2)
            x=center+[(2.5_wp*(-1.0_wp)**i,i=1,n)]
            step=1; temperature=20; callback_calls=0
            call solver%initialize(objective,n,center-3,center+3,maximize=.false.,eps=1e-9_wp, &
               ns=20,nt=10,neps=4,maxevl=600000,iprint=0,iseed1=seeds(1,sd),iseed2=seeds(2,sd), &
               step_mode=1,iunit=output_unit,use_initial_guess=.true.,n_resets=1,optimal_f_specified=.false.)
            call solver%optimize(x,0.9_wp,temperature,step,best,value,accepted,evaluations,status)
            if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(best)) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite best point'
            ! Independent nonnegative identity: z**2+A*(1-cos(2*pi*z)) = z**2+2*A*sin(pi*z)**2.
            reference_value=sum((best-center)**2+2*amplitude*sin(acos(-1.0_wp)*(best-center))**2)
            point_error=maxval(abs(best-center))
            identity=abs(reference_value-value)/(1+reference_value)
            print '(a,4i9,3es14.5)', 'Case dimension, amplitude, seed pair, objective/point/identity: ', &
               n,amp,seeds(:,sd),reference_value,point_error,identity
            if (status/=0) error stop 'annealing did not meet its termination criteria'
            if (evaluations/=callback_calls .or. evaluations>600000) error stop 'callback count/budget mismatch'
            if (accepted<0 .or. accepted>evaluations) error stop 'invalid acceptance count'
            if (any(abs(best-center)>3.0_wp)) error stop 'returned point outside bounds'
            if (reference_value>1e-5_wp .or. point_error>1e-3_wp) error stop 'known global minimum differs'
            if (identity>2e-12_wp) error stop 'returned objective disagrees with independent identity'
            max_value=max(max_value,reference_value); max_point=max(max_point,point_error)
            max_identity=max(max_identity,identity); total_evaluations=total_evaluations+evaluations
            runs=runs+1; entries=entries+n
            call solver%destroy()
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(center,x,best,step)
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Seeded annealing runs: ',runs,'; global minimizer coordinates: ',entries
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independently counted objective callbacks: ',total_evaluations
   print '(a,3es14.5)', 'Max independent objective, point error, objective identity error: ', &
      max_value,max_point,max_identity
   print '(a)', 'PASS annealing-rastrigin-reference'
end program

name: gams-rndgen-kiss-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/random-references-drivers-MIT.txt.
program reference_kiss_streams
   use rndgen_mod, only: rndgen,rndSeed
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int32,int64,real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: streams=7,count=4096,continuation=257
   integer(int32), parameter :: seeds(streams)=[0,1,-1,12345,-67890,294727492,2147483646]
! BEGIN REFERENCE CONSTANTS
   integer(int64), parameter :: prefix(8,streams)=reshape([ &
      1761119782_int64, 1258461758_int64, 957194328_int64, 1842507483_int64, &
      1208524783_int64, 1652857723_int64, 2053757388_int64, 879438213_int64, &
      215227806_int64, 1405642535_int64, 1146595842_int64, 277176711_int64, &
      1818037016_int64, 2015763050_int64, 833496322_int64, 892211371_int64, &
      215227806_int64, 1405642535_int64, 1146595842_int64, 277176711_int64, &
      1818037016_int64, 2015763050_int64, 833496322_int64, 892211371_int64, &
      119035902_int64, 801032792_int64, 1351668714_int64, 1510475862_int64, &
      2107887406_int64, 1946816441_int64, 1708277923_int64, 1563380222_int64, &
      1390243629_int64, 736091383_int64, 159624430_int64, 1721960888_int64, &
      661694071_int64, 1548385597_int64, 1694887988_int64, 1408673621_int64, &
      1460433475_int64, 1552770090_int64, 1995302543_int64, 462454171_int64, &
      74143359_int64, 1453442776_int64, 1718954354_int64, 797438472_int64, &
      2126337207_int64, 1607088900_int64, 195281517_int64, 2146981700_int64, &
      1821595793_int64, 157919299_int64, 1601524667_int64, 1536048808_int64 &
      ],[8,streams])
   integer(int64), parameter :: expected_checksums(streams)=[ &
      34213082_int64, 1007654948_int64, 1007654948_int64, 1924117522_int64, &
      359022780_int64, 1855872359_int64, 1855580040_int64]
! END REFERENCE CONSTANTS
   type(rndgen) :: generators(streams)
   type(rndSeed) :: snapshot
   integer :: i,j
   integer(int32) :: seed
   integer(int64) :: checksum(streams),code
   real(real64) :: values(count,streams),tail(continuation),u
   checksum=0
   do j=1,streams
      seed=seeds(j)
      call generators(j)%init(seed)
   end do
   ! Interleave all objects, so shared-state contamination changes their exact vectors.
   do i=1,count
      do j=1,streams
         u=generators(j)%rnd()
         if (.not.ieee_is_finite(u) .or. u<0 .or. u>=1) error stop 'invalid uniform value'
         code=floor(u*2147483648.0_real64,kind=int64)
         if (u/=real(code,real64)/2147483648.0_real64) error stop 'value is not on the 31-bit grid'
         if (i<=8) then
            if (code/=prefix(i,j)) error stop 'independent integer prefix differs'
         end if
         checksum(j)=modulo(65599_int64*checksum(j)+code,2147483647_int64)
         values(i,j)=u
      end do
   end do
   if (any(checksum/=expected_checksums)) error stop 'independent whole-stream checksum differs'
   do j=1,streams
      call generators(j)%reset()
      do i=1,count
         if (generators(j)%rnd()/=values(i,j)) error stop 'reset replay differs'
      end do
      call generators(j)%save_seed(snapshot)
      do i=1,continuation
         tail(i)=generators(j)%rnd()
      end do
      call generators(j)%read_seed(snapshot)
      do i=1,continuation
         if (generators(j)%rnd()/=tail(i)) error stop 'in-memory state replay differs'
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Interleaved streams: ',streams,'; uniform outputs: ',streams*count
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Exact independent prefix entries: ',8*streams,'; whole-stream checksums: ',streams
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Exact reset replays: ',streams*count,'; saved-state continuations: ',streams*continuation
   print '(a)', 'GNU 16 wraparound convention checked; no statistical-quality or cross-compiler guarantee.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rndgen-kiss-reference'
end program

name: gams-pointsets-random-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/random-references-drivers-MIT.txt.
program reference_random_spacing
   use pointsets, only: random_spacing
   use select_precision, only: wp
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(*)=[0,1,2,3,9,33,129],seeds(*)=[42,1729,314159],draws=20000
   integer :: nseed,sd,interval,sz,n,i,j,runs,entries,noops,cdf_cases,lower_count,upper_count
   integer, allocatable :: seed(:)
   real(wp), allocatable :: x(:),raw(:),replay(:)
   real(wp) :: left,right,next_actual,next_expected,sample(3)
   real(real64) :: expected,den,error,max_error,limit,p_lower,p_upper,cdf_error,max_cdf,average
   call random_seed(size=nseed)
   allocate(seed(nseed))
   runs=0; entries=0; noops=0; cdf_cases=0; max_error=0; max_cdf=0
   do sd=1,size(seeds)
      seed=[(seeds(sd)+37*i,i=1,nseed)]
      do interval=1,3
         left=0; right=1
         if (interval==2) then
            left=-3.5_wp; right=2.25_wp
         else if (interval==3) then
            left=0.25_wp; right=left
         end if
         do sz=1,size(sizes)
            n=sizes(sz)
            allocate(x(n),raw(n),replay(n)); x=-99
            call random_seed(put=seed)
            call random_spacing(x,left,right)
            call random_number(next_actual)
            call random_seed(put=seed)
            if (n>1) call random_number(raw)
            call random_number(next_expected)
            if (next_actual/=next_expected) error stop 'unexpected random-state consumption'
            if (n<=1) then
               if (any(x/=-99)) error stop 'empty/singleton input should remain unchanged'
               noops=noops+1
            else
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite random coordinates'
               if (any(x(2:)<x(:n-1))) error stop 'coordinates not nondecreasing'
               limit=8*real(n,real64)*real(epsilon(left),real64)
               den=sum(real(raw(2:),real64))
               if (den<=0) error stop 'fixture has zero increment sum'
               do i=1,n
                  expected=real(left,real64)+real(right-left,real64)*sum(real(raw(2:i),real64))/den
                  error=abs(real(x(i),real64)-expected)/(1+max(abs(real(left,real64)),abs(real(right,real64))))
                  if (error>limit) error stop 'independent normalized-increment reference differs'
                  max_error=max(max_error,error); entries=entries+1
               end do
               if (abs(x(1)-left)>limit .or. abs(x(n)-right)>limit) error stop 'interval endpoint differs'
            end if
            call random_seed(put=seed)
            replay=-99
            call random_spacing(replay,left,right)
            if (any(replay/=x)) error stop 'seeded replay differs'
            runs=runs+1
            deallocate(x,raw,replay)
         end do
      end do
      ! With three points, the interior coordinate is U/(U+V), not uniform.
      call random_seed(put=seed)
      lower_count=0; upper_count=0; average=0
      do j=1,draws
         call random_spacing(sample,0.0_wp,1.0_wp)
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(sample))) error stop 'nonfinite CDF sample'
         if (sample(2)<0 .or. sample(2)>1) error stop 'CDF sample outside interval'
         if (sample(2)<=0.25_wp) lower_count=lower_count+1
         if (sample(2)<=0.75_wp) upper_count=upper_count+1
         average=average+real(sample(2),real64)
      end do
      p_lower=real(lower_count,real64)/draws; p_upper=real(upper_count,real64)/draws
      cdf_error=max(abs(p_lower-1.0_real64/6),abs(p_upper-5.0_real64/6))
      if (cdf_error>0.015_real64 .or. abs(average/draws-0.5_real64)>0.015_real64) &
         error stop 'normalized-uniform-increment law smoke check failed'
      if (abs(p_lower-0.25_real64)<0.04_real64) error stop 'fixture fails to distinguish uniform interior point'
      max_cdf=max(max_cdf,cdf_error); cdf_cases=cdf_cases+1
      print '(a,i8,a,3f12.7)', 'Seed ',seeds(sd),'; empirical CDF at 1/4,3/4 and mean: ', &
         p_lower,p_upper,average/draws
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0)', 'Spacing fixtures: ',runs,'; reference coordinates: ',entries,'; no-op fixtures: ',noops
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Three-point law samples: ',cdf_cases*draws,'; seed groups: ',cdf_cases
   print '(a,2es14.5)', 'Max normalized coordinate and CDF errors: ',max_error,max_cdf
   print '(a)', 'Normalized uniform increments are not uniform order statistics; no randomness certification.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS pointsets-random-reference'
end program

name: gams-fatode-tangent-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/tangents-blocks-drivers-MIT.txt.
module tangent_fixture
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer :: rhs_calls,jacobian_calls
contains
   subroutine rhs(n,t,y,f)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(real64), intent(in) :: t,y(n)
      real(real64), intent(out) :: f(n)
      if (n/=4 .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'invalid RHS callback state'
      rhs_calls=rhs_calls+1
      f=[-y(3)*y(1)+y(4)*y(2),-y(3)*y(2),0.0_real64,0.0_real64]
   end subroutine
   subroutine jacobian(n,t,y,jac)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(real64), intent(in) :: t,y(n)
      real(real64), intent(out) :: jac(n,n)
      if (n/=4 .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'invalid Jacobian callback state'
      jacobian_calls=jacobian_calls+1
      jac=0
      jac(1,:)=[-y(3),y(4),-y(1),y(2)]
      jac(2,2)=-y(3); jac(2,3)=-y(2)
   end subroutine
end module

program reference_tangent_flow
   use tangent_fixture
   use erk_tlm_f90_integrator, only: integrate_tlm
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: methods(*)=[4,6]
   real(real64), parameter :: rates(*)=[0.25_real64,2.0_real64,8.0_real64]
   real(real64), parameter :: couplings(*)=[-1.5_real64,0.0_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64), parameter :: durations(*)=[-1.0_real64,-0.125_real64,0.125_real64,1.0_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64), parameter :: initials(2,3)=reshape([1.0_real64,0.5_real64,-0.75_real64,1.25_real64, &
      0.0_real64,0.0_real64],[2,3])
   real(real64) :: y(4),tangent(4,4),reference(4),derivative(4,4),rtol(4),atol(4),rtol_tlm(4,4),atol_tlm(4,4)
   real(real64) :: t0,t1,tau,e,a,b,k,c,state_error,tangent_error,max_state,max_tangent,stats(20)
   integer :: method,rate,coupling,time,initial,origin,i,status,controls(20),work(20),runs,total_rhs,total_jac
   runs=0; total_rhs=0; total_jac=0; max_state=0; max_tangent=0
   do method=1,size(methods)
      do rate=1,size(rates)
         k=rates(rate)
         do coupling=1,size(couplings)
            c=couplings(coupling)
            do time=1,size(durations)
               tau=durations(time); e=exp(-k*tau)
               do initial=1,size(initials,2)
                  a=initials(1,initial); b=initials(2,initial)
                  reference=[e*(a+c*b*tau),e*b,k,c]
                  derivative=0
                  derivative(1,:)=[e,c*tau*e,-tau*reference(1),b*tau*e]
                  derivative(2,:)=[0.0_real64,e,-tau*reference(2),0.0_real64]
                  derivative(3,3)=1; derivative(4,4)=1
                  do origin=0,1
                     t0=0.75_real64*origin; t1=t0+tau
                     y=[a,b,k,c]; tangent=0
                     do i=1,4
                        tangent(i,i)=1
                     end do
                     atol=1e-12_real64; rtol=1e-10_real64
                     atol_tlm=1e-12_real64; rtol_tlm=1e-10_real64
                     controls=0; controls(3)=methods(method); controls(4)=10000
                     controls(5)=1; controls(12)=1
                     rhs_calls=0; jacobian_calls=0
                     call integrate_tlm(t0,t1,4,4,y,tangent,atol_tlm,rtol_tlm,atol,rtol,rhs,jacobian, &
                        icntrl_u=controls,istatus_u=work,rstatus_u=stats,ierr_u=status)
                     if (status/=1) error stop 'FATODE did not return successful status 1'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y)) .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(tangent))) &
                        error stop 'nonfinite state or tangent'
                     if (.not.ieee_is_finite(stats(1))) error stop 'nonfinite exit time'
                     if (abs(stats(1)-t1)>64*epsilon(t1)*max(1.0_real64,abs(t1))) error stop 'wrong exit time'
                     if (rhs_calls<=0 .or. jacobian_calls<=0 .or. work(4)<=0) error stop 'callbacks/steps absent'
                     state_error=maxval(abs(y-reference)/(1+abs(reference)))
                     tangent_error=maxval(abs(tangent-derivative)/(1+abs(derivative)))
                     if (state_error>2e-7_real64 .or. tangent_error>2e-7_real64) &
                        error stop 'analytic flow or flow derivative differs'
                     if (any(y(3:)/=reference(3:))) error stop 'constant parameter states changed'
                     max_state=max(max_state,state_error); max_tangent=max(max_tangent,tangent_error)
                     total_rhs=total_rhs+rhs_calls; total_jac=total_jac+jacobian_calls; runs=runs+1
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0)', 'Tangent integrations: ',runs,'; state entries: ',4*runs,'; derivative entries: ',16*runs
   print '(a,2i12)', 'Actual RHS and analytic-Jacobian callbacks: ',total_rhs,total_jac
   print '(a,2es14.5)', 'Maximum normalized state and tangent errors: ',max_state,max_tangent
   print '(a)', 'Dopri5/Dopri853, forward/backward time, full initial-state/parameter derivatives checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fatode-tangent-reference'
end program

name: gams-dbcsr-products-reference
source:
! Independent MIT-licensed driver; see licenses/tangents-blocks-drivers-MIT.txt.
module sparse_block_fixture
   use dbcsr_api
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   type :: matrix_handle
      type(dbcsr_type) :: matrix
      type(dbcsr_distribution_type) :: distribution
      integer, pointer :: row_sizes(:)=>null(),col_sizes(:)=>null(),rows(:)=>null(),cols(:)=>null()
   end type
contains
   subroutine make_matrix(handle,row_parts,col_parts,dense)
      type(matrix_handle), intent(out) :: handle
      integer, intent(in) :: row_parts(:),col_parts(:)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: dense(:,:)
      integer :: i,j,r,s,nr,nc
      real(real64), allocatable :: block_copy(:,:)
      allocate(handle%row_sizes(size(row_parts)),handle%col_sizes(size(col_parts)))
      allocate(handle%rows(size(row_parts)),handle%cols(size(col_parts)))
      handle%row_sizes=row_parts; handle%col_sizes=col_parts; handle%rows=0; handle%cols=0
      call dbcsr_distribution_new(handle%distribution,group=0,row_dist=handle%rows,col_dist=handle%cols)
      call dbcsr_create(handle%matrix,'fixture',handle%distribution,dbcsr_type_no_symmetry, &
         handle%row_sizes,handle%col_sizes,data_type=dbcsr_type_real_8)
      s=1
      do j=1,size(col_parts)
         nc=col_parts(j); r=1
         do i=1,size(row_parts)
            nr=row_parts(i)
            if (any(dense(r:r+nr-1,s:s+nc-1)/=0)) then
               block_copy=dense(r:r+nr-1,s:s+nc-1)
               call dbcsr_put_block(handle%matrix,i,j,block_copy)
            end if
            r=r+nr
         end do
         s=s+nc
      end do
      call dbcsr_finalize(handle%matrix)
   end subroutine
   subroutine unpack(handle,dense)
      type(matrix_handle), intent(inout) :: handle
      real(real64), intent(out) :: dense(:,:)
      real(real64), pointer :: block(:,:)
      logical :: transposed,found
      integer :: i,j,r,s,nr,nc
      dense=0; s=1
      do j=1,size(handle%col_sizes)
         nc=handle%col_sizes(j); r=1
         do i=1,size(handle%row_sizes)
            nr=handle%row_sizes(i)
            call dbcsr_get_block_p(handle%matrix,i,j,block,transposed,found)
            if (found) then
               if (transposed) then
                  dense(r:r+nr-1,s:s+nc-1)=transpose(block)
               else
                  dense(r:r+nr-1,s:s+nc-1)=block
               end if
            end if
            r=r+nr
         end do
         s=s+nc
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine release_matrix(handle)
      type(matrix_handle), intent(inout) :: handle
      call dbcsr_release(handle%matrix)
      call dbcsr_distribution_release(handle%distribution)
      deallocate(handle%row_sizes,handle%col_sizes,handle%rows,handle%cols)
   end subroutine
end module

program reference_block_products
   use sparse_block_fixture
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(real64), parameter :: alphas(*)=[1.0_real64,-1.25_real64,0.0_real64,2.0_real64,0.0_real64,0.5_real64]
   real(real64), parameter :: betas(*)=[0.0_real64,0.5_real64,-1.0_real64,0.0_real64,0.0_real64,1.0_real64]
   character, parameter :: flags(2)=['N','T']
   type(matrix_handle) :: ah,bh,ch
   integer, allocatable :: mp(:),kp(:),np(:),row_block(:),col_block(:)
   real(real64), allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:,:),c(:,:),result(:,:)
   real(real64) :: da,db,dc,expected,scale,error,max_error
   integer :: shape,pattern,ta,tb,pair,m,k,n,i,j,h,runs,entries
   runs=0; entries=0; max_error=0
   call dbcsr_init_lib(0)
   do shape=1,2
      select case(shape)
      case(1)
         mp=[1,2,1]; kp=[2,1]; np=[1,3]
      case(2)
         mp=[2,1]; kp=[1,3,2]; np=[2,1,2]
      case(3)
         mp=[1,1]; kp=[1,2]; np=[2,1]
      end select
      m=sum(mp); k=sum(kp); n=sum(np)
      allocate(a(m,k),b(k,n),c(m,n),result(m,n))
      do pattern=1,4
         da=8; db=8; dc=8
         if (pattern==3) then
            da=7; db=11; dc=13
         end if
         do j=1,k
            do i=1,m
               a(i,j)=real(2*i-3*j+1,real64)/da
            end do
         end do
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,k
               b(i,j)=real(3*i+j-2,real64)/db
            end do
            do i=1,m
               c(i,j)=real(i-2*j+3,real64)/dc
            end do
         end do
         if (pattern==2) then
            row_block=block_indices(mp); col_block=block_indices(kp)
            do j=1,k
               do i=1,m
                  if (modulo(row_block(i)+col_block(j),2)/=0) a(i,j)=0
               end do
            end do
            row_block=block_indices(kp); col_block=block_indices(np)
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,k
                  if (modulo(2*row_block(i)+col_block(j),3)==0) b(i,j)=0
               end do
            end do
         else if (pattern==4) then
            a=0
         end if
         do ta=1,2
            do tb=1,2
               block
                  ! Cycle scalar pairs across fixtures; do not take their full Cartesian product.
                  pair=1+modulo((shape-1)*16+(pattern-1)*4+(ta-1)*2+tb-1,size(alphas))
                  if (ta==1) then
                     call make_matrix(ah,mp,kp,a)
                  else
                     call make_matrix(ah,kp,mp,transpose(a))
                  end if
                  if (tb==1) then
                     call make_matrix(bh,kp,np,b)
                  else
                     call make_matrix(bh,np,kp,transpose(b))
                  end if
                  call make_matrix(ch,mp,np,c)
                  call dbcsr_multiply(flags(ta),flags(tb),alphas(pair),ah%matrix,bh%matrix, &
                     betas(pair),ch%matrix,filter_eps=0.0_real64)
                  call unpack(ch,result)
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(result))) error stop 'nonfinite sparse product'
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,m
                        expected=betas(pair)*c(i,j); scale=1+abs(expected)
                        do h=1,k
                           expected=expected+alphas(pair)*a(i,h)*b(h,j)
                           scale=scale+abs(alphas(pair)*a(i,h)*b(h,j))
                        end do
                        error=abs(result(i,j)-expected)/scale
                        if (error>128*epsilon(error)*(k+2)) error stop 'scalar-loop product reference differs'
                        max_error=max(max_error,error); entries=entries+1
                     end do
                  end do
                  call release_matrix(ah); call release_matrix(bh); call release_matrix(ch)
                  runs=runs+1
               end block
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,b,c,result)
   end do
   call dbcsr_finalize_lib()
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Block-sparse products: ',runs,'; scalar reference entries: ',entries
   print '(a,es14.5)', 'Maximum normalized product error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'All N/T flag pairs, irregular blocks, sparse/empty inputs and alpha/beta accumulation checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Serial real64 CPU build only; MPI, accelerators and symmetry storage unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS dbcsr-products-reference'
contains
   function block_indices(parts) result(indices)
      integer, intent(in) :: parts(:)
      integer :: indices(sum(parts)),i,j,pos
      pos=0
      do i=1,size(parts)
         do j=1,parts(i)
            pos=pos+1; indices(pos)=i
         end do
      end do
   end function
end program
