program dictionary_reference
   use dictionary
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   type(dictionary_t) :: table
   integer :: cycle,i,value,array(3),checks
   real(real64) :: real_value
   character(32) :: key,text,expected
   logical :: found
   checks=0
   do cycle=1,8
      table=('base'.kv.cycle)
      do i=1,48
         write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',i
         select case(modulo(i,4))
         case(0)
            table=table//(trim(key).kv.(i-100*cycle))
         case(1)
            table=table//(trim(key).kv.(real(i-cycle,real64)/8))
         case(2)
            write(text,'(a,i0,a,i0)') 'value_',cycle,'_',i
            table=table//(trim(key).kv.trim(text))
         case(3)
            array=[i,cycle,-i]; table=table//(trim(key).kv.array); array=999
         end select
      end do
      do i=48,1,-1
         write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',i
         select case(modulo(i,4))
         case(0)
            call assign(value,table,trim(key),success=found)
            if (.not.found .or. value/=i-100*cycle) error stop 'dictionary integer reference'
         case(1)
            call assign(real_value,table,trim(key),success=found)
            if (.not.found .or. real_value/=real(i-cycle,real64)/8) error stop 'dictionary real reference'
         case(2)
            call assign(text,table,trim(key))
            write(expected,'(a,i0,a,i0)') 'value_',cycle,'_',i
            if (text/=expected) error stop 'dictionary text reference'
         case(3)
            call assign(array,table,trim(key),success=found)
            if (.not.found .or. any(array/=[i,cycle,-i])) error stop 'dictionary owned array reference'
         end select
         checks=checks+1
      end do
      do i=2,48,2
         write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',i
         call delete(table,trim(key))
      end do
      ! Odd keys survive deletions elsewhere in the hash-linked structure.
      do i=1,48,4
         write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',i
         call assign(real_value,table,trim(key),success=found)
         if (.not.found .or. real_value/=real(i-cycle,real64)/8) error stop 'dictionary survivor reference'
         checks=checks+1
      end do
      call assign(value,table,'base',success=found)
      if (.not.found .or. value/=cycle) error stop 'dictionary base reference'
      checks=checks+1
      call delete(table)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Eight 49-key dictionaries; exact typed lookup references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'Integer/REAL64/text/array values, owned array copies, reverse lookup order and deletion survivors.'
   print '(a)', 'Missing/type-mismatched lookups, duplicate-key policy, dictionary copying and all hash collisions unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fdict-values-reference'
end program

name: gams-qcontainers-state-reference
source:
! Independent MIT API consumer; see licenses/state-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program containers_reference
   use qvector_m, only: qvector_t,QVECTOR_RESIZE_LINEAR
   use qhashtbl_m, only: qhashtbl_t
   implicit none
   integer :: cycle,i,j,n,value,reference(96),mapped(17),checks
   logical :: found,present(17)
   character(16) :: key
   checks=0
   do cycle=1,8
      block
         type(qvector_t) :: vector
         type(qhashtbl_t) :: table
         call vector%new(2,storage_size(value)/8,QVECTOR_RESIZE_LINEAR)
         call table%new(range=3,size_data=storage_size(value)/8)
         present=.false.; mapped=0; n=0
         do i=1,96
            value=modulo(i*(cycle+2),31)-15
            call vector%addlast(value,found)
            if (.not.found) error stop 'C vector append'
            n=n+1; reference(n)=value
            if (modulo(i,7)==0) then
               j=1+modulo(i*3,n); reference(j)=-i
               call vector%setat(j,reference(j),found)
               if (.not.found) error stop 'C vector edit'
            end if
            do j=1,n
               call vector%getat(j,value,found)
               if (.not.found .or. value/=reference(j)) error stop 'C vector indexed reference'
               checks=checks+1
            end do
            j=1+modulo(i*5,17); write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',j
            mapped(j)=i-100*cycle; present(j)=.true.
            call table%put(trim(key),mapped(j),success=found)
            if (.not.found) error stop 'C map insertion'
            do j=1,17
               write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key_',j
               call table%get(trim(key),value,found)
               if (found .neqv. present(j)) error stop 'C map presence reference'
               if (found) then
                  if (value/=mapped(j)) error stop 'C map replacement reference'
               end if
               checks=checks+1
            end do
         end do
         do i=1,96
            call vector%popfirst(value,found)
            if (.not.found .or. value/=reference(i)) error stop 'C vector pop reference'
            if (vector%size()/=96-i) error stop 'C vector pop size'
            checks=checks+1
         end do
         call vector%clear(); call table%clear()
         if (vector%size()/=0 .or. table%size()/=0) error stop 'C containers clear'
         ! clear resets the C vector's element size; append-after-clear is not supported here.
         call table%put('reused',cycle,success=found)
         if (.not.found) error stop 'C map reuse'
         call table%get('reused',value,found)
         if (.not.found .or. value/=cycle) error stop 'C map reused value'
         checks=checks+1
      end block
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Eight vector/map traces; exact value/presence references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'C-backed growth, indexed edits, FIFO removal, map replacement/presence, vector clear and map clear/reuse.'
   print '(a)', 'Vector append-after-clear has a retained failure; iterator order, copying and thread safety unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS qcontainers-state-reference'
end program

name: gams-sqlite-transactions-reference
source:
! Independent MIT API consumer; see licenses/state-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program sqlite_reference
   use sqliteff
   use iso_varying_string, only: varying_string
   implicit none
   type(SqliteDatabase_t) :: database
   type(SqliteStatement_t) :: statement
   type(varying_string) :: message,remaining
   integer :: i,rows,status
   call check(sqliteff_open(':memory:',database),SQLITE_OK)
   call execute('create table samples(k integer primary key, v real); begin;')
   call check(sqliteff_prepare(database,'insert into samples values(?,?);',statement,remaining),SQLITE_OK)
   do i=-32,31
      call check(sqliteff_bind_int(statement,1,i),SQLITE_OK)
      call check(sqliteff_bind_double(statement,2,dble(i)/8),SQLITE_OK)
      call check(sqliteff_step(statement),SQLITE_DONE)
      call check(sqliteff_reset(statement),SQLITE_OK)
   end do
   call check(sqliteff_finalize(statement),SQLITE_OK)
   call execute('commit; begin; update samples set v=v+100; insert into samples values(999,999); rollback;')
   call check(sqliteff_prepare(database,'select count(*),sum(v),avg(v),min(v),max(v) from samples;', &
      statement,remaining),SQLITE_OK)
   call check(sqliteff_step(statement),SQLITE_ROW)
   if (sqliteff_column_int(statement,0)/=64) error stop 'SQLite rollback row count'
   if (sqliteff_column_double(statement,1)/=-4.d0) error stop 'SQLite sum reference'
   if (sqliteff_column_double(statement,2)/=-0.0625d0) error stop 'SQLite average reference'
   if (sqliteff_column_double(statement,3)/=-4.d0) error stop 'SQLite minimum reference'
   if (sqliteff_column_double(statement,4)/=3.875d0) error stop 'SQLite maximum reference'
   call check(sqliteff_step(statement),SQLITE_DONE); call check(sqliteff_finalize(statement),SQLITE_OK)
   call execute('delete from samples where k%3=0;')
   call check(sqliteff_prepare(database,'select k,v from samples order by k;',statement,remaining),SQLITE_OK)
   rows=0
   do i=-32,31
      if (modulo(i,3)==0) cycle
      call check(sqliteff_step(statement),SQLITE_ROW)
      if (sqliteff_column_int(statement,0)/=i) error stop 'SQLite ordered key reference'
      if (sqliteff_column_double(statement,1)/=dble(i)/8) error stop 'SQLite ordered value reference'
      rows=rows+1
   end do
   if (rows/=43) error stop 'SQLite remaining rows'
   call check(sqliteff_step(statement),SQLITE_DONE); call check(sqliteff_finalize(statement),SQLITE_OK)
   call check(sqliteff_close(database),SQLITE_OK)
   print '(a)', '64 prepared/bound inserts; rollback restores five exact aggregates; 43 ordered rows after deletion.'
   print '(a)', 'In-memory database, commit/rollback, statement reset/finalize and independent integer/dyadic references.'
   print '(a)', 'Disk persistence, concurrent transactions, text/NULL values and database error recovery unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS sqlite-transactions-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      integer, intent(in) :: actual,expected
      if (actual/=expected) error stop 'unexpected SQLite status'
   end subroutine
   subroutine execute(sql)
      character(*), intent(in) :: sql
      call check(sqliteff_exec(database,sql,message),SQLITE_OK)
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-shunting-yard-reference
source:
! Independent MIT API consumer; see licenses/state-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
module integer_expression_callbacks
   use parser_module, only: parser_t,token_t
   implicit none
contains
   function read_operand(parser,token) result(output)
      class(parser_t) :: parser
      type(token_t) :: token,output
      integer :: number,status
      read(token%string,*,iostat=status) number
      if (status/=0) error stop 'invalid integer token'
      output%object=number
   end function
   function binary(parser,left,operation,right) result(output)
      class(parser_t) :: parser
      type(token_t) :: left,operation,right,output
      integer :: a,b,value
      select type(number=>left%object)
      type is (integer)
         a=number
      class default
         error stop 'unexpected left operand type'
      end select
      select type(number=>right%object)
      type is (integer)
         b=number
      class default
         error stop 'unexpected right operand type'
      end select
      select case(operation%string)
      case('+')
         value=a+b
      case('-')
         value=a-b
      case('*')
         value=a*b
      case('/')
         if (b==0) error stop 'unexpected zero divisor'
         value=a/b
      case('^')
         value=a**b
      case default
         error stop 'unexpected binary operator'
      end select
      output%object=value
   end function
end module
program expression_reference
   use integer_expression_callbacks
   implicit none
   type(parser_t) :: parser
   integer :: a,b,c,cases
   character(:), allocatable :: x,y,z
   call parser%register_operator(['^'],is_right_assoc=.true.)
   call parser%register_operator(['+','-','*','/'])
   call parser%ignore_tokens([' '])
   parser%on_operand=>read_operand; parser%on_binary=>binary
   cases=0
   do a=1,6
      x=decimal(a)
      do b=1,4
         y=decimal(b)
         do c=1,3
            z=decimal(c)
            call check(x//'+'//y//'*'//z,a+b*c)
            call check('('//x//'+'//y//')*'//z,(a+b)*c)
            call check(x//'-'//y//'-'//z,a-b-c)
            call check('(0-'//x//')+'//y//'*'//z,-a+b*c)
            call check('('//x//'*'//y//')/'//y,a)
            call check(x//'+'//y//'*('//z//'+1)',a+b*(c+1))
         end do
      end do
   end do
   call check('2^3^2',512); call check('(2^3)^2',64)
   call check('3+2^3*4',35); call check('(0-(2+3))*4',-20); call check(' 2 + 3 * 4 ',14)
   if (cases/=437) error stop 'expression reference counts'
   print '(a)', '437 exact integer expression references; six generated templates and five precedence/associativity fixtures.'
   print '(a)', 'Nested parentheses, binary subtraction, exact integer division, right-associative powers and ignored spaces.'
   print '(a)', 'Valid bounded integers only; unary registration, syntax errors, real functions and overflow unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS shunting-yard-reference'
contains
   function decimal(value) result(text)
      integer, intent(in) :: value
      character(:), allocatable :: text
      character(20) :: buffer
      write(buffer,'(i0)') value; text=trim(buffer)
   end function
   subroutine check(expression,expected)
      character(*), intent(in) :: expression
      integer, intent(in) :: expected
      type(token_t) :: result
      result=parser%parse(expression)
      select type(value=>result%object)
      type is (integer)
         if (value/=expected) then
            print *, 'expression: ',expression,' actual/expected: ',value,expected
            error stop 'integer expression reference differs'
         end if
      class default
         error stop 'unexpected parsed result type'
      end select
      cases=cases+1
   end subroutine
end program

program constants_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use CODATA_2022_constants, only: h=>Planck_constant,c=>speed_of_light_in_vacuum,e=>elementary_charge
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: wavelengths(*)=[1,2,10,121,250,400,500,656,800,1064,10000,1000000]
   real(real64), parameter :: joules(*)=[ &
      1.98644585714892867e-16_real64, &
      9.93222928574464333e-17_real64, &
      1.98644585714892873e-17_real64, &
      1.64169079103217242e-18_real64, &
      7.94578342859571445e-19_real64, &
      4.96611464287232201e-19_real64, &
      3.97289171429785723e-19_real64, &
      3.02811868467824485e-19_real64, &
      2.48305732143616101e-19_real64, &
      1.86696039205726385e-19_real64, &
      1.98644585714892855e-20_real64, &
      1.98644585714892862e-22_real64 &
      ]
   real(real64), parameter :: ev(*)=[ &
      1.23984198433200254e+03_real64, &
      6.19920992166001270e+02_real64, &
      1.23984198433200262e+02_real64, &
      1.02466279696859726e+01_real64, &
      4.95936793732801018e+00_real64, &
      3.09960496083000647e+00_real64, &
      2.47968396866400509e+00_real64, &
      1.89000302489634553e+00_real64, &
      1.54980248041500324e+00_real64, &
      1.16526502286842359e+00_real64, &
      1.23984198433200257e-01_real64, &
      1.23984198433200262e-03_real64 &
      ]
   real(real64) :: wavelength,energy,error,worst
   integer :: i
   if (h/=6.62607015e-34_real64 .or. c/=299792458.0_real64 .or. e/=1.602176634e-19_real64) &
      error stop 'SI defining constant value'
   worst=0
   do i=1,size(wavelengths)
      wavelength=real(wavelengths(i),real64)*1.e-9_real64
      energy=h*c/wavelength
      error=max(abs(energy/joules(i)-1),abs((energy/e)/ev(i)-1))
      if (error>2.e-15_real64) error stop 'exact rational photon reference'
      worst=max(worst,error)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Three exact SI constant literals and 24 rational-derived photon-energy references.'
   print '(a,es14.5)', 'Maximum relative photon-energy discrepancy: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'Wavelengths 1..1000000 nm; joules and electron volts checked with independent Python Fraction vectors.'
   print '(a)', 'Selected exact constants only; uncertain CODATA values and the complete constants collection unverified.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS codata-photon-reference'
end program

name: gams-rojff-json-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use rojff
   implicit none
   type(fallible_json_value_t) :: document, restored, invalid
   character(200) :: source
   integer :: i
   do i = -24, 24
      write(source,'(a,i0,a,f10.3,a,i0,a)') '{"count":', i, ',"dt":', real(i,real64)/8, &
         ',"label":"case', i, '"}'
      document = parse_json_from_string(trim(source))
      call verify(document,i)
      restored = parse_json_from_string(document%value_%to_compact_string())
      call verify(restored,i)
   end do
   invalid = parse_json_from_string('{"count": }')
   if (.not. invalid%failed()) error stop 'Accepted missing value'
   invalid = parse_json_from_string('{"count":1')
   if (.not. invalid%failed()) error stop 'Accepted unclosed object'
   print '(a)', '49 objects; 294 independent typed references; two malformed inputs rejected'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rojff-json-reference'
contains
   subroutine verify(doc,n)
      type(fallible_json_value_t), intent(in) :: doc
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      type(fallible_json_value_t) :: field
      character(20) :: label
      if (doc%failed()) error stop 'JSON parse failed'
      write(label,'(a,i0)') 'case',n
      select type(obj => doc%value_)
      type is(json_object_t)
         field = obj%get('count')
         if (field%failed()) error stop 'Missing count'
         select type(value => field%value_)
         type is(json_integer_t)
            if (value%number /= n) error stop 'Integer mismatch'
         class default
            error stop 'Integer type mismatch'
         end select
         field = obj%get('dt')
         if (field%failed()) error stop 'Missing dt'
         select type(value => field%value_)
         type is(json_number_t)
            if (value%number /= real(n,real64)/8) error stop 'Real mismatch'
         class default
            error stop 'Real type mismatch'
         end select
         field = obj%get('label')
         if (field%failed()) error stop 'Missing label'
         select type(value => field%value_)
         type is(json_string_t)
            if (value%string /= trim(label)) error stop 'String mismatch'
         class default
            error stop 'String type mismatch'
         end select
         field = obj%get('absent')
         if (.not. field%failed()) error stop 'Absent key found'
      class default
         error stop 'Object type mismatch'
      end select
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-erloff-filter-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/interop-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use erloff, only: error_list_t, fatal_t, module_t, procedure_t, message_type_t, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, INPUTS, size
   use iso_varying_string, only: char
   implicit none
   type(error_list_t) :: errors, snapshot, bounds, inputs_only
   character(24) :: message
   character(:), allocatable :: text, filtered
   integer :: i,j
   type(message_type_t) :: kind
   do i=1,48
      snapshot=errors
      kind=INPUTS
      if (mod(i,2)==0) kind=OUT_OF_BOUNDS
      write(message,'(a,i3.3,a)') '[diagnostic-',i,']'
      errors=errors%with_error_appended(fatal_t(kind,module_t('fixture'),procedure_t('check'),trim(message)))
      if (size(snapshot)/=i-1 .or. size(errors)/=i) error stop 'Immutable size'
      bounds=errors.ofType.OUT_OF_BOUNDS
      inputs_only=errors.ofType.INPUTS
      if (size(bounds)/=i/2 .or. size(inputs_only)/=(i+1)/2) error stop 'Filtered counts'
      text=char(errors%to_string())
      filtered=char(bounds%to_string())
      do j=1,i
         write(message,'(a,i3.3,a)') '[diagnostic-',j,']'
         if (index(text,trim(message))==0) error stop 'Lost diagnostic'
         if ((index(filtered,trim(message))>0) .neqv. (mod(j,2)==0)) error stop 'Filter contents'
      end do
      write(message,'(a,i3.3,a)') '[diagnostic-',i,']'
      if (index(char(snapshot%to_string()),trim(message))/=0) error stop 'Snapshot changed'
   end do
   print '(a)', '48 immutable append steps; exact parity-filter membership and snapshot preservation'
   print '(a)', 'PASS erloff-filter-reference'
end program

   use iso_fortran_env, only: int32,real64
   use m_npy, only: save_npy
   implicit none
   real(real64), allocatable :: matrix(:,:),payload(:,:)
   character(:), allocatable :: header
   character(8) :: magic
   character(40) :: shape
   integer(int32) :: length
   integer :: rows,cols,i,j,unit,bytes,checks,p
   checks=0
   do rows=1,5
      do cols=1,7
         allocate(matrix(rows,cols),payload(rows,cols))
         do j=1,cols
            do i=1,rows
               matrix(i,j)=real(19*i-7*j,real64)/8
            end do
         end do
         call save_npy('fixture.npy',matrix)
         open(newunit=unit,file='fixture.npy',status='old',access='stream',form='unformatted')
         read(unit) magic,length
         if (magic/=achar(147)//'NUMPY'//achar(2)//achar(0)) error stop 'NPY version/magic'
         if (length<1 .or. length>4096) error stop 'Header length'
         allocate(character(length)::header)
         read(unit) header
         if (index(header,"'<f8'")==0 .or. index(header,'True')==0) error stop 'dtype/order'
         ! Ignore whitespace only when checking the exact expected shape text.
         do
            p=index(header,' ')
            if(p==0) exit
            header=header(:p-1)//header(p+1:)
         end do
         write(shape,'(a,i0,a,i0,a)') "'shape':(",rows,',',cols,')'
         if (index(header,trim(shape))==0) then
            write(shape,'(a,i0,a,i0,a)') "'shape':(",rows,',',cols,',)'
            if (index(header,trim(shape))==0) error stop 'Shape header'
         end if
         read(unit) payload
         inquire(unit=unit,size=bytes)
         if (bytes/=12+length+8*rows*cols) error stop 'NPY byte length'
         do j=1,cols
            do i=1,rows
               if(payload(i,j)/=real(19*i-7*j,real64)/8) error stop 'Raw payload'
               checks=checks+1
            end do
         end do
         close(unit,status='delete')
         deallocate(matrix,payload,header)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '35 NPY headers and independently read REAL64 payload values: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS npy-payload-reference'
end program

name: gams-ftl-state-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/interop-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use ftlDynArrayIntModule, only: ftlDynArrayInt
   use ftlHashMapStringIntModule, only: ftlHashMapStringInt
   implicit none
   type(ftlDynArrayInt) :: array
   type(ftlHashMapStringInt) :: map
   integer :: oracle(128),values(17),n,step,k,j,removed,trial,counted,checks
   logical :: present(17)
   character(12) :: key
   checks=0
   do trial=1,8
      call array%New()
      call map%New(10)
      n=0
      present=.false.
      values=0
      do step=1,128
         n=n+1
         oracle(n)=trial*step-37
         call array%PushBack(oracle(n))
         if(mod(step,3)==0) then
            removed=array%PopBack()
            if(removed/=oracle(n)) error stop 'Pop value'
            n=n-1
         end if
         if(array%Size()/=n) error stop 'Array size'
         if(any(array%data/=oracle(:n))) error stop 'Array oracle'
         k=mod(step*7,17)+1
         write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key-',k
         values(k)=trial*1000-step
         present(k)=.true.
         call map%Set(trim(key),values(k))
         if(mod(step,4)==0) then
            k=mod(step*3,17)+1
            write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key-',k
            if(present(k)) call map%Erase(trim(key))
            present(k)=.false.
         end if
         counted=0
         do j=1,17
            write(key,'(a,i0)') 'key-',j
            if(map%Has(trim(key)).neqv.present(j)) error stop 'Map presence'
            if(present(j)) then
               counted=counted+1
               if(map%Get(trim(key))/=values(j)) error stop 'Map value'
            end if
         end do
         if(map%Size()/=counted) error stop 'Map size'
         checks=checks+1
      end do
      do while(n>0)
         removed=array%PopBack()
         if(removed/=oracle(n)) error stop 'Drain order'
         n=n-1
      end do
      if(array%Size()/=0) error stop 'Drain size'
      call map%Delete()
      call array%Delete()
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent array/map state checkpoints: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS ftl-state-reference'
end program

name: gams-os-path-reference

program main
   use os, only: mkdir,rmdir,rename,unlink
   use os_path, only: join,exists,isdir,isfile,getsize,basename,dirname,normpath
   implicit none
   character(:),allocatable :: folder,path,moved
   character(32) :: payload,readback
   integer :: status,n,unit
   call mkdir('os-fixture',stat=status)
   if(status/=0 .or. .not.isdir('os-fixture')) error stop 'mkdir root'
   folder=join('os-fixture','nested')
   call mkdir(folder,stat=status)
   if(status/=0 .or. .not.isdir(folder)) error stop 'mkdir nested'
   if(normpath('os-fixture/./nested/../nested')/=folder) error stop 'Relative normalization'
   if(normpath('/alpha/./beta/../gamma')/='/alpha/gamma') error stop 'Absolute normalization'
   path=join(folder,'input.bin')
   moved=join(folder,'output.bin')
   if(basename(path)/='input.bin' .or. dirname(path)/=folder) error stop 'Path parts'
   do n=0,32
      payload=repeat(achar(65+mod(n,26)),32)
      open(newunit=unit,file=path,status='new',access='stream',form='unformatted')
      write(unit) payload(:n)
      close(unit)
      if(.not.isfile(path) .or. getsize(path)/=n) error stop 'File size'
      call rename(path,moved,stat=status)
      if(status/=0 .or. exists(path) .or. .not.isfile(moved)) error stop 'Rename'
      if(getsize(moved)/=n) error stop 'Renamed size'
      open(newunit=unit,file=moved,status='old',access='stream',form='unformatted')
      if(n>0) read(unit) readback(:n)
      close(unit)
      if(n>0) then
         if(readback(:n)/=payload(:n)) error stop 'Renamed content'
      end if
      call unlink(moved,stat=status)
      if(status/=0 .or. exists(moved)) error stop 'Unlink'
   end do
   call rmdir(folder,stat=status)
   if(status/=0 .or. exists(folder)) error stop 'rmdir nested'
   call rmdir('os-fixture',stat=status)
   if(status/=0 .or. exists('os-fixture')) error stop 'rmdir root'
   print '(a)', '33 Linux file lifecycle traces and exact path normalization/parts'
   print '(a)', 'PASS os-path-reference'
end program

name: gams-lua53-stack-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/interop-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_ptr,c_associated
   use lua
   implicit none
   type(c_ptr) :: state
   integer :: status,i
   integer(kind=lua_integer) :: actual
   real(kind=lua_number) :: x,y
   state=lual_newstate()
   if(.not.c_associated(state)) error stop 'Lua state'
   call lual_openlibs(state)
   status=lual_loadstring(state,'function calculate(n,x) return n*n-3*n+7, 2.5*x-0.125 end')
   if(status/=0) error stop 'Lua load'
   status=lua_pcall(state,0,0,0)
   if(status/=0) error stop 'Lua define'
   do i=-64,64
      if(lua_gettop(state)/=0) error stop 'Initial stack depth'
      status=lua_getglobal(state,'calculate')
      if(lua_isfunction(state,-1)/=1) error stop 'Not callable'
      call lua_pushinteger(state,int(i,lua_integer))
      x=real(i,lua_number)/8
      call lua_pushnumber(state,x)
      status=lua_pcall(state,2,2,0)
      if(status/=0 .or. lua_gettop(state)/=2) error stop 'Call/stack'
      actual=lua_tointeger(state,-2)
      y=lua_tonumber(state,-1)
      if(actual/=i*i-3*i+7) error stop 'Integer polynomial'
      if(y/=real(20*i-8,lua_number)/64) error stop 'Dyadic affine value'
      call lua_pop(state,2)
      if(lua_gettop(state)/=0) error stop 'Stack cleanup'
   end do
   status=lual_loadstring(state,'function broken(')
   if(status==0) error stop 'Syntax accepted'
   call lua_pop(state,1)
   if(lua_gettop(state)/=0) error stop 'Error stack cleanup'
   call lua_close(state)
   print '(a)', '129 Lua calls; 258 exact numeric references, stack balance and syntax rejection'
   print '(a)', 'PASS lua53-stack-reference'
end program

name: gams-forpy-numpy-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use forpy_mod
   implicit none
   type(module_py) :: numpy,linalg
   type(ndarray) :: array
   type(tuple) :: arguments
   type(object) :: result
   real(real64),allocatable :: values(:,:)
   real(real64) :: total,squares,maximum,v,actual
   integer :: rows,cols,i,j,count
   count=0
   call check(forpy_initialize())
   call check(import_py(numpy,'numpy'))
   call check(import_py(linalg,'numpy.linalg'))
   do rows=1,5
      do cols=1,7
         allocate(values(rows,cols))
         total=0
         squares=0
         maximum=-huge(maximum)
         do j=1,cols
            do i=1,rows
               v=real(17*i-11*j,real64)/8
               values(i,j)=v
               total=total+v
               squares=squares+v*v
               maximum=max(maximum,v)
            end do
         end do
         call check(ndarray_create(array,values))
         call check(tuple_create(arguments,1))
         call check(arguments%setitem(0,array))
         call check(call_py(result,numpy,'sum',arguments))
         call check(cast(actual,result))
         if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual) .or. actual/=total) error stop 'NumPy sum'
         call result%destroy()
         call check(call_py(result,numpy,'max',arguments))
         call check(cast(actual,result))
         if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual) .or. actual/=maximum) error stop 'NumPy maximum'
         call result%destroy()
         call check(call_py(result,linalg,'norm',arguments))
         call check(cast(actual,result))
         if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'Nonfinite norm'
         if(abs(actual-sqrt(squares))>1.e-13_real64*max(1._real64,sqrt(squares))) error stop 'NumPy norm'
         call result%destroy()
         call arguments%destroy()
         call array%destroy()
         deallocate(values)
         count=count+3
      end do
   end do
   call linalg%destroy()
   call numpy%destroy()
   call forpy_finalize()
   print '(a,i0)', '35 embedded NumPy arrays; scalar-loop sum/max/Frobenius references: ',count
   print '(a)', 'PASS forpy-numpy-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(code)
      integer,intent(in) :: code
      if(code/=0) then
         call err_print()
         error stop 'Python API failure'
      end if
   end subroutine
end program

contains
   subroutine fixture(t)
      integer,intent(in) :: t
      type(Parser) :: reader
      class(YAML_Node),allocatable :: document
      integer,allocatable :: samples(:)
      integer :: unit,n,j,rc,value
      logical :: enabled
      character(:),allocatable :: title
      character(20) :: expected

      open(newunit=unit,file='fixture.yaml',status='new',action='write')
      write(unit,'(a)') 'title: "'//trim(expected)//'"'
      write(unit,'(a,i0)') 'iterations: ',t-17
      if(mod(t,2)==0) then
         write(unit,'(a)') 'enabled: true'
      else
         write(unit,'(a)') 'enabled: false'
      end if
      write(unit,'(a)',advance='no') 'samples: ['
      do j=1,n
         if(j>1) write(unit,'(a)',advance='no') ', '
         write(unit,'(i0)',advance='no') 3*j-t
      end do
      write(unit,'(a)') ']'
      close(unit)
      reader=Parser('core')
      document=reader%load('fixture.yaml')
      call document%get(value,'iterations',rc=rc)
      if(rc/=YAFYAML_SUCCESS .or. value/=t-17) error stop 'YAML integer'
      call document%get(enabled,'enabled',rc=rc)
      if(rc/=YAFYAML_SUCCESS) error stop 'YAML logical type'
      if(enabled.neqv.(mod(t,2)==0)) error stop 'YAML logical value'
      call document%get(title,'title',rc=rc)
      if(rc/=YAFYAML_SUCCESS) error stop 'YAML text type'
      if(title/=trim(expected)) error stop 'YAML text value'
      call document%get(samples,'samples',rc=rc)
      if(rc/=YAFYAML_SUCCESS) error stop 'YAML sequence type'
      if(size(samples)/=n) error stop 'YAML sequence shape'
      if(any(samples/=[(3*j-t,j=1,n)])) error stop 'YAML sequence values'
      if(document%has('absent')) error stop 'YAML absent key'
      open(newunit=unit,file='fixture.yaml',status='old')
      close(unit,status='delete')
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-flook-table-reference

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use flook
   implicit none
   type(luaState),target :: state
   type(luaTbl) :: table
   integer :: n,k,status,total,count
   real(real64) :: alpha,beta,answer,expected
   character(:),allocatable :: message
   call lua_init(state)
   count=0
   do n=0,16
      do k=-4,4
         alpha=real(k,real64)/8
         beta=real(n-8,real64)/4
         call lua_run(state,code='parameters = {}',error=status,message=message)
         if(status/=0) error stop 'Lua table creation'
         table=lua_table(state,'parameters')
         call lua_set(table,'alpha',alpha)
         call lua_set(table,'beta',beta)
         call lua_set(table,'n',n)
         call lua_close(table)
         call lua_run(state,code='results = {answer=parameters.alpha*parameters.n+parameters.beta,total=0}; '// &
            'for i=1,parameters.n do results.total=results.total+i end',error=status,message=message)
         if(status/=0) error stop 'Lua computation'
         table=lua_table(state,'results')
         call lua_get(table,'answer',answer)
         call lua_get(table,'total',total)
         call lua_close(table)
         expected=real(k*n+2*n-16,real64)/8
         if(answer/=expected .or. total/=n*(n+1)/2) error stop 'Lua analytic reference'
         count=count+2
      end do
   end do
   call lua_close(state)
   print '(a,i0)', '153 Lua table traces; exact affine and triangular-sum references: ',count
   print '(a)', 'PASS flook-table-reference'
end program

program main
   implicit none

   end do
   print '(a)', '12 dense undirected graphs; every adjacency index, degree, feature and edge weight'
   print '(a)', 'PASS graph-storage-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n)
      use graphstruc, only: graph_type
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      type(graph_type) :: graph
      integer :: oracle(n,n),degree(n),i,j,k
      real :: feature(2)
      oracle=0
      degree=0
      do i=1,n
         feature=[real(i),real(-i)/4]
         call graph%add_vertex(feature=feature,id=100+i)
         feature=0
      end do
      k=0
      do j=2,n
         do i=1,j-1
            if(mod(i+2*j,3)/=0) cycle
            k=k+1
            oracle(i,j)=k
            oracle(j,i)=k
            degree(i)=degree(i)+1
            degree(j)=degree(j)+1
            call graph%add_edge(index=[i,j],weight=real(3*i-j)/8)
            if(any(graph%edge(k)%index/=[i,j])) error stop 'Edge endpoints'
            if(graph%edge(k)%weight/=real(3*i-j)/8) error stop 'Edge weight'
            if(graph%num_edges/=k) error stop 'Edge count'
            if(any(graph%adjacency/=oracle)) error stop 'Incremental adjacency'
         end do
      end do
      if(graph%num_vertices/=n) error stop 'Vertex count'
      do i=1,n
         if(graph%vertex(i)%degree/=degree(i)) error stop 'Degree oracle'
         if(graph%vertex(i)%id/=100+i) error stop 'Vertex identity'
         if(any(graph%vertex(i)%feature/=[real(i),real(-i)/4])) error stop 'Owned features'
      end do
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-smart-lifetime-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/storage-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
module checked_resource
   use smart_pointer_m, only: sp_smart_pointer_t
   implicit none
   integer :: cleaned=0,checksum=0
   type,extends(sp_smart_pointer_t) :: resource
      integer,pointer :: data(:)=>null()
   contains
      procedure :: free
   end type
contains
   impure elemental subroutine free(self)
      class(resource),intent(inout) :: self
      if(associated(self%data)) then
         checksum=checksum+sum(self%data)
         cleaned=cleaned+1
         deallocate(self%data)
         nullify(self%data)
      end if
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use checked_resource
   implicit none
   integer :: n,expected
   expected=0
   do n=1,64
      call fixture(n)
      expected=expected+n*n*(n+1)/2
      if(cleaned/=n .or. checksum/=expected) error stop 'Exactly-once resource cleanup'
   end do
   print '(a)', '64 owned-array lifetimes; nested aliases, shared mutation and exactly-once cleanup'
   print '(a)', 'PASS smart-lifetime-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(n)
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      type(resource) :: owner
      integer :: i
      allocate(owner%data(n))
      owner%data=[(i,i=1,n)]
      call owner%start_counter()
      if(owner%reference_count()/=1) error stop 'Owner count'
      call alias_scope(owner,n)
      if(owner%reference_count()/=1) error stop 'Alias release'
      if(any(owner%data/=[(n*i,i=1,n)])) error stop 'Shared mutations'
      if(cleaned/=n-1) error stop 'Premature cleanup'
   end subroutine
   subroutine alias_scope(owner,n)
      type(resource),intent(in) :: owner
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      type(resource) :: alias
      alias=owner
      if(owner%reference_count()/=2) error stop 'Two aliases'
      if(.not.associated(owner%data,alias%data)) error stop 'Shared target'
      call third_scope(alias,n)
      if(owner%reference_count()/=2) error stop 'Third alias release'
   end subroutine
   subroutine third_scope(owner,n)
      type(resource),intent(in) :: owner
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      type(resource) :: alias
      alias=owner
      if(owner%reference_count()/=3) error stop 'Three aliases'
      alias%data=alias%data*n
   end subroutine
end program

         integer(c_int),value :: id,var

         real(c_double),intent(out) :: value
      end function
   end interface
   type(netcdf_file) :: file
   real(real64),allocatable :: values(:,:),loaded(:,:)
   real(c_double) :: cell
   integer :: rows,cols,i,j,unit,checks
   integer(c_int) :: id,var,dims(2),xdim,ydim
   integer(c_size_t) :: length
   character(20) :: units
   checks=0
   do rows=1,4

            end do

         call file%open('nc4-fixture.nc',action='w')
         call file%write('field',values,['x','y'])
         call file%write_attribute('field','units','dyadic')
         call file%close()
         ! Cross the wrapper with the C API: reversed axes and zero-based indices.
         call check(nc_open('nc4-fixture.nc'//c_null_char,0_c_int,id))
         call check(nc_inq_varid(id,'field'//c_null_char,var))
         call check(nc_inq_dimid(id,'x'//c_null_char,xdim))
         call check(nc_inq_dimid(id,'y'//c_null_char,ydim))
         call check(nc_inq_dimlen(id,xdim,length))
         if(length/=rows) error stop 'x metadata'
         call check(nc_inq_dimlen(id,ydim,length))
         if(length/=cols) error stop 'y metadata'
         call check(nc_inq_vardimid(id,var,dims))
         if(any(dims/=[ydim,xdim])) error stop 'Native C axis order'
         do j=1,cols
            do i=1,rows
               call check(nc_get_var1_double(id,var,int([j-1,i-1],c_size_t),cell))
               if(cell/=real(31*i-7*j,real64)/8) error stop 'Indexed native value'
               checks=checks+1
            end do
         end do
         call check(nc_close(id))
         call file%open('nc4-fixture.nc',action='r')
         call file%read('field',loaded)
         call file%read_attribute('field','units',units)
         call file%close()
         if(trim(units)/='dyadic') error stop 'Units'
         do j=1,cols
            do i=1,rows
               if(loaded(i,j)/=real(31*i-7*j,real64)/8) error stop 'Wrapper value'
            end do
         end do
         open(newunit=unit,file='nc4-fixture.nc',status='old')
         close(unit,status='delete')
         deallocate(values,loaded)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '24 NetCDF4 datasets; native indexed values and wrapper values each: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS nc4-layout-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(rc)
      integer,intent(in) :: rc
      if(rc/=0) error stop 'Native NetCDF API'
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-regex-language-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/storage-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use regex, only: re_match
   implicit none
   character(4),parameter :: alphabet='01a.'
   character(4) :: text
   integer :: n,k,j,q,point,count
   logical :: decimal,identifier
   count=0
   do n=1,4
      do k=0,4**n-1
         q=k
         do j=1,n
            text(j:j)=alphabet(mod(q,4)+1:mod(q,4)+1)
            q=q/4
         end do
         ! A direct character-state grammar, independent of regex machinery.
         point=0
         decimal=.true.
         do j=1,n
            if(text(j:j)=='.') then
               if(point/=0) decimal=.false.
               point=j
            else if(index('01',text(j:j))==0) then
               decimal=.false.
            end if
         end do
         decimal=decimal.and.point>1.and.point<n
         identifier=text(1:1)=='a'
         do j=2,n
            if(index('01a',text(j:j))==0) identifier=.false.
         end do
         if(re_match('^\d+\.\d+$',text(:n)).neqv.decimal) error stop 'Decimal grammar'
         if(re_match('^a[01a]*$',text(:n)).neqv.identifier) error stop 'Identifier grammar'
         count=count+2
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '340 exhaustive strings; independent decimal/identifier grammar comparisons: ',count
   print '(a)', 'PASS regex-language-reference'
end program

name: gams-lmdb-rollback-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/storage-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_c_binding
   use lmdb
   implicit none
   type(c_ptr) :: env,txn
   type(mdb_val_type) :: key,value,found
   character(8),target :: key_text,value_text
   character(:),allocatable :: text
   integer :: db,i,unit,rc
   call check(mdb_env_create(env))
   call check(mdb_env_set_mapsize(env,1048576_c_size_t))
   call check(mdb_env_set_maxdbs(env,1))
   call check(mdb_env_open(env,'checked.mdb',MDB_NOSUBDIR,int(o'0600')))
   key%mv_size=8
   key%mv_data=c_loc(key_text)
   value%mv_size=8
   value%mv_data=c_loc(value_text)
   call check(mdb_txn_begin(env,c_null_ptr,0,txn))
   call check(mdb_dbi_open(txn,'numbers',MDB_CREATE,db))
   do i=1,64
      call select_key(i)
      write(value_text,'(i8.8)') i*i
      call check(mdb_put(txn,db,key,value,0))
   end do
   call check(mdb_txn_commit(txn))
   call verify(0)
   call check(mdb_txn_begin(env,c_null_ptr,0,txn))
   do i=1,64
      call select_key(i)
      value_text='99999999'
      call check(mdb_put(txn,db,key,value,0))
   end do
   call mdb_txn_abort(txn)
   call verify(0)
   call check(mdb_txn_begin(env,c_null_ptr,0,txn))
   do i=1,64
      call select_key(i)
      if(mod(i,3)==0) then
         call check(mdb_del(txn,db,key,c_null_ptr))
      else
         write(value_text,'(i8.8)') i*i+7
         call check(mdb_put(txn,db,key,value,0))
      end if
   end do
   call check(mdb_txn_commit(txn))
   call verify(1)
   call mdb_dbi_close(env,db)
   call mdb_env_close(env)
   open(newunit=unit,file='checked.mdb',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   open(newunit=unit,file='checked.mdb-lock',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   print '(a)', '192 key-state references: committed inserts, full rollback, updates and 21 deletions'
   print '(a)', 'PASS lmdb-rollback-reference'
contains
   subroutine select_key(n)
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      write(key_text,'(a,i6.6)') 'k-',n
   end subroutine
   subroutine check(code)
      integer,intent(in) :: code
      if(code/=MDB_SUCCESS) error stop 'LMDB API'
   end subroutine
   subroutine verify(phase)
      integer,intent(in) :: phase
      integer :: n,expected
      character(8) :: oracle
      call check(mdb_txn_begin(env,c_null_ptr,MDB_RDONLY,txn))
      do n=64,1,-1
         call select_key(n)
         rc=mdb_get(txn,db,key,found)
         if(phase==1.and.mod(n,3)==0) then
            if(rc/=MDB_NOTFOUND) error stop 'Deleted key found'
         else
            call check(rc)
            expected=n*n+7*phase
            write(oracle,'(i8.8)') expected
            call c_f_str_ptr(found%mv_data,text,found%mv_size)
            if(text/=oracle) error stop 'Committed value oracle'
         end if
      end do
      call mdb_txn_abort(txn)
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-aotus-config-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/storage-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   implicit none
   integer :: t
   do t=1,32
      call fixture(t)
   end do
   print '(a)', '32 Lua configurations; exact computed scalar/table values and missing defaults'
   print '(a)', 'PASS aotus-config-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(t)
      use aotus_module, only: flu_State,open_config_file,close_config,aot_get_val,aoterr_Fatal,aoterr_NonExistent
      use aot_table_module, only: aot_table_open,aot_table_close,aot_table_length
      use flu_kinds_module, only: double_k
      integer,intent(in) :: t
      type(flu_State) :: state
      integer :: unit,status,steps,nx,ny,table,default_value
      real(double_k) :: scale
      open(newunit=unit,file='checked.lua',status='new')
      write(unit,'(a,i0)') 'n=',t
      write(unit,'(a)') 'steps=n*(n+1)/2', 'scale=(n-17)/8', 'mesh={nx=n+2,ny=3*n-4}'
      close(unit)
      call open_config_file(L=state,filename='checked.lua',ErrCode=status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'Configuration load'
      call aot_get_val(L=state,key='steps',val=steps,ErrCode=status)
      if(btest(status,aoterr_Fatal).or.steps/=t*(t+1)/2) error stop 'Computed integer'
      call aot_get_val(L=state,key='scale',val=scale,ErrCode=status)
      if(btest(status,aoterr_Fatal).or.scale/=real(t-17,double_k)/8) error stop 'Computed real'
      call aot_table_open(L=state,thandle=table,key='mesh')
      if(table==0) error stop 'Nested table'
      if(aot_table_length(L=state,thandle=table)/=2) error stop 'Table length'
      call aot_get_val(L=state,thandle=table,key='nx',val=nx,ErrCode=status)
      if(btest(status,aoterr_Fatal).or.nx/=t+2) error stop 'nx'
      call aot_get_val(L=state,thandle=table,key='ny',val=ny,ErrCode=status)
      if(btest(status,aoterr_Fatal).or.ny/=3*t-4) error stop 'ny'
      call aot_table_close(L=state,thandle=table)
      call aot_get_val(L=state,key='absent',val=default_value,ErrCode=status,default=-t)
      if(btest(status,aoterr_Fatal).or..not.btest(status,aoterr_NonExistent)) error stop 'Default flags'
      if(default_value/=-t) error stop 'Default value'
      call close_config(L=state)
      open(newunit=unit,file='checked.lua',status='old')
      close(unit,status='delete')
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-log-filter-reference
source:

program main
   use pflogger
   implicit none
   class(Logger),pointer :: log
   character(512) :: line
   character(40) :: message
   integer :: unit,status,i,record,expected_i
   open(newunit=unit,file='checked-logging.yaml',status='new')
   write(unit,'(a)') 'schema_version: 1', 'formatters:', '  basic:', '    class: Formatter', &
      "    format: '%(name)a~: %(levelName)a~: %(message)a'", &
      'handlers:', '  file:', '    class: FileHandler', '    filename: checked.log', &
      '    formatter: basic', '    level: WARNING', 'loggers:', '  main:', &
      '    handlers: [file]', '    level: DEBUG'
   close(unit)
   call initialize()
   call logging%load_file('checked-logging.yaml',rc=status)
   if(status/=0) error stop 'Logger configuration'
   log=>logging%get_logger('main')
   do i=1,32
      write(message,'(a,i3.3)') 'record-',i
      call log%debug('hidden-debug')
      call log%info('hidden-info')
      call log%warning(trim(message))
      call log%error(trim(message))
   end do
   call logging%free()
   call finalize()
   open(newunit=unit,file='checked.log',status='old')
   record=0
   do
      read(unit,'(a)',iostat=status) line
      if(status<0) exit
      if(status/=0) error stop 'Log read'
      record=record+1
      expected_i=(record+1)/2
      write(message,'(a,i3.3)') 'record-',expected_i
      if(mod(record,2)==1) then
         if(trim(line)/='main: WARNING: '//trim(message)) error stop 'Warning record oracle'
      else
         if(trim(line)/='main: ERROR: '//trim(message)) error stop 'Error record oracle'
      end if
   end do
   if(record/=64) error stop 'Severity count'
   close(unit,status='delete')
   open(newunit=unit,file='checked-logging.yaml',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   print '(a)', '128 log calls; exact 64 ordered warning/error records, debug/info filtered'
   print '(a)', 'PASS log-filter-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_ptr,c_associated,c_null_ptr
   use curl
   implicit none
   type(c_ptr) :: handle
   character(40) :: host,port,path,query,newpath
   character(:),allocatable :: url,part
   integer :: n
   do n=1,64
      write(host,'(a,i0,a)') 'node',n,'.example.org'
      write(port,'(i0)') 8000+n
      write(path,'(a,i0,a)') '/data/',n,'/input.csv'
      write(query,'(a,i0)') 'sample=',3*n
      write(newpath,'(a,i0,a)') '/output/',n,'.dat'
      url='https://'//trim(host)//':'//trim(port)//trim(path)//'?'//trim(query)
      handle=curl_url()
      if(.not.c_associated(handle)) error stop 'URL handle'
      call check(curl_url_set(handle,CURLUPART_URL,url))
      call check(curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_HOST,part))
      if(part/=trim(host)) error stop 'Host'
      call check(curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_PORT,part))
      if(part/=trim(port)) error stop 'Port'
      call check(curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_PATH,part))
      if(part/=trim(path)) error stop 'Path'
      call check(curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_QUERY,part))
      if(part/=trim(query)) error stop 'Query'
      call check(curl_url_set(handle,CURLUPART_PATH,trim(newpath)))
      call check(curl_url_get(handle,CURLUPART_URL,part))
      url='https://'//trim(host)//':'//trim(port)//trim(newpath)//'?'//trim(query)
      if(part/=url) error stop 'Reconstructed URL'
      call curl_url_cleanup(handle)
      handle=c_null_ptr
   end do
   print '(a)', '64 offline URLs; 320 exact component/reconstruction references'
   print '(a)', 'PASS curl-url-reference'

name: gams-netcdf-slices-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/storage-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use netcdf
   implicit none
   integer :: n,m,i,j,id,dx,dy,var,dims(2),length,unit,checks
   real,allocatable :: values(:,:),loaded(:,:)
   real :: cell(1,1),update(1,1)
   character(4) :: magic
   character(20) :: name,units
   checks=0
   do n=1,4
      do m=1,6
         allocate(values(n,m),loaded(n,m))
         do j=1,m
            do i=1,n
               values(i,j)=real(11*i-3*j)/8
            end do
         end do
         call check(nf90_create('classic.nc',nf90_clobber,id))
         call check(nf90_def_dim(id,'row',n,dx))
         call check(nf90_def_dim(id,'column',m,dy))
         call check(nf90_def_var(id,'field',nf90_float,[dx,dy],var))
         call check(nf90_put_att(id,var,'units','dyadic'))
         call check(nf90_enddef(id))
         call check(nf90_put_var(id,var,values))
         update(1,1)=-999.5
         call check(nf90_put_var(id,var,update,start=[n,m],count=[1,1]))
         call check(nf90_close(id))
         open(newunit=unit,file='classic.nc',status='old',access='stream',form='unformatted')
         read(unit) magic
         close(unit)
         if(magic/='CDF'//achar(1)) error stop 'Classic format magic'
         call check(nf90_open('classic.nc',nf90_nowrite,id))
         call check(nf90_inq_varid(id,'field',var))
         call check(nf90_inquire_variable(id,var,dimids=dims))
         call check(nf90_inquire_dimension(id,dims(1),name=name,len=length))
         if(trim(name)/='row'.or.length/=n) error stop 'Row metadata'
         call check(nf90_inquire_dimension(id,dims(2),name=name,len=length))
         if(trim(name)/='column'.or.length/=m) error stop 'Column metadata'
         call check(nf90_get_att(id,var,'units',units))
         if(trim(units)/='dyadic') error stop 'Units'
         call check(nf90_get_var(id,var,loaded))
         do j=1,m
            do i=1,n
               call check(nf90_get_var(id,var,cell,start=[i,j],count=[1,1]))
               if(i==n.and.j==m) then
                  if(cell(1,1)/=-999.5.or.loaded(i,j)/=-999.5) error stop 'Updated cell'
               else
                  if(cell(1,1)/=real(11*i-3*j)/8) error stop 'Indexed cell'
                  if(loaded(i,j)/=real(11*i-3*j)/8) error stop 'Full array cell'
               end if
               checks=checks+2
            end do
         end do
         call check(nf90_close(id))
         open(newunit=unit,file='classic.nc',status='old')
         close(unit,status='delete')
         deallocate(values,loaded)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '24 classic files; exact full/indexed values after one-cell update: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS netcdf-slices-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(rc)
      integer,intent(in) :: rc
      if(rc/=nf90_noerr) error stop 'NetCDF API'
   end subroutine
end program

   character(20) :: case_text,threads_text,scale_text
   character(40) :: label
   character(:),allocatable :: command

         command='"'//trim(executable)//'" --case '//trim(case_text)
         if(mod(n,2)==0) then
            command=command//' --threads '
         else
            command=command//' -t '
         end if
         command=command//trim(threads_text)//' --scale '//trim(adjustl(scale_text))// &
            ' --name "case '//trim(case_text)//'"'
         if(mod(n,2)==0) command=command//' --verbose'
         call execute_command_line(command,cmdstat=status,exitstat=exit_code)
         if(status/=0.or.exit_code/=0) error stop 'Child parser check'
      end do
      print '(a)', '12 child invocations; 72 typed/default/flag references, short and long option names'
      print '(a)', 'PASS argparse-options-reference'
   else
      call get_command_argument(2,case_text)
      read(case_text,*) n
      options=argparser('Checked parser')
      call options%add_option_integer('-c','--case','Fixture',0)
      call options%add_option_integer('-t','--threads','Threads',1)
      call options%add_option_double('-s','--scale','Scale',1._real64)
      call options%add_option_string('-n','--name','Label','unset')
      call options%add_option_integer('-i','--iterations','Iterations',37)
      call options%add_option_logical('-v','--verbose','Verbose')
      call options%parse()
      write(label,'(a,i0)') 'case ',n
      if(options%get_option_integer('--case')/=n) error stop 'Case'
      if(options%get_option_integer('--threads')/=2*n+1) error stop 'Integer'
      if(options%get_option_double('--scale')/=real(n-7,real64)/8) error stop 'Real'
      if(trim(options%get_option_string('--name'))/=trim(label)) error stop 'Quoted string'
      if(options%get_option_integer('--iterations')/=37) error stop 'Default'
      if(options%has_option('--verbose').neqv.(mod(n,2)==0)) error stop 'Logical flag'
   end if
end program

name: gams-veggies-results-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/workflows-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
module checked_specification
   use veggies, only: result_t,assert_equals
   implicit none
contains
   function integer_case() result(check)
      type(result_t) :: check
      integer :: n,i
      check=assert_equals(0,0)
      do n=1,64
         check=check.and.assert_equals(n*(n+1)/2,sum([(i,i=1,n)]))
      end do
   end function
   function exact_real_case() result(check)
      type(result_t) :: check
      check=assert_equals(2.d0,0.25d0*8)
   end function
end module
program main
   use checked_specification
   use veggies, only: test_item_t,describe,it,run_tests
   implicit none
   type(test_item_t) :: tests
   type(result_t) :: check,combined
   integer :: i,j,failures
   do i=-8,8
      combined=assert_equals(i,i)
      failures=0
      do j=-8,8
         check=assert_equals(i,j)
         if(check%passed().neqv.(i==j)) error stop 'Equality truth table'
         if(check%num_asserts()/=1) error stop 'Assertion count'
         if(i/=j) failures=failures+1
         combined=combined.and.check
      end do
      if(combined%num_asserts()/=18) error stop 'Combined count'
      if(combined%num_failing_asserts()/=failures) error stop 'Failure count'
      if(combined%passed()) error stop 'Mixed result accepted'
   end do
   tests=describe('Checked framework consumers',[it('integer references',integer_case), &
      it('exact binary real',exact_real_case)])
   if(.not.run_tests(tests)) error stop 'Framework run'
   print '(a)', '289 equality outcomes and 17 mixed-result counts; two passing specification cases'
   print '(a)', 'PASS veggies-results-reference'
end program

program main

   implicit none
   integer :: status,unit,n,j

   logical :: exists

   if(status/=0.or..not.system_isdir('system-fixture')) error stop 'Directory creation'
   if(system_isreg('system-fixture')) error stop 'Directory misclassified'

         content(j:j)=achar(mod(17*j+n,128))
      end do
      open(newunit=unit,file='system-fixture/data.bin',status='new',access='stream',form='unformatted')
      write(unit) content(:n)
      close(unit)
      if(.not.system_isreg('system-fixture/data.bin')) error stop 'Regular-file type'
      if(system_isdir('system-fixture/data.bin')) error stop 'File misclassified'
      open(newunit=unit,file='system-fixture/data.bin',status='old',access='stream',form='unformatted')
      if(n>0) read(unit) loaded(:n)
      close(unit)
      if(n>0) then
         if(loaded(:n)/=content(:n)) error stop 'Binary payload'
      end if
      status=system_remove('system-fixture/data.bin')
      if(status/=0) error stop 'Remove file'
      inquire(file='system-fixture/data.bin',exist=exists)
      if(exists) error stop 'File remains'
   end do
   status=system_rmdir('system-fixture')
   if(status/=0.or.system_isdir('system-fixture')) error stop 'Remove directory'
   print '(a)', '65 Linux binary file lifecycles, lengths 0..64; directory/file type checks'
   print '(a)', 'PASS system-files-reference'
end program

   implicit none

   if(.not.c_associated(interp)) error stop 'Tcl interpreter'
   do n=0,64
      write(number,'(i0)') n
      script='set total 0; for {set i 1} {$i <= '//trim(number)// &
         '} {incr i} {incr total [expr {$i*$i}]}; set total'
      status=tcl_eval_ex(interp,script)
      if(status/=TCL_OK) error stop 'Tcl sum evaluation'
      result=tcl_get_string_result(interp)
      read(result,*,iostat=status) value
      if(status/=0.or.value/=n*(n+1)*(2*n+1)/6) error stop 'Closed-form sum of squares'
   end do
   status=tcl_eval_ex(interp,'expr {1 + }')
   if(status==TCL_OK) error stop 'Malformed expression accepted'

   if(len(result)==0) error stop 'Missing error text'
   status=tcl_eval_ex(interp,'expr {7*8}')
   if(status/=TCL_OK) error stop 'Tcl recovery'
   result=tcl_get_string_result(interp)

name: gams-fy-list-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/workflows-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   implicit none
   integer :: trial
   do trial=1,8
      call fixture(trial)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Eight integer/string list traces: append, middle insert/delete, lookup and absent search'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fy-list-reference'
contains
   subroutine fixture(t)
      use type_intlist, only: IntList,IntList_init,int_size=>size
      use type_stringlist, only: StringList,StringList_init,string_size=>size
      integer,intent(in) :: t
      type(IntList),allocatable :: numbers
      type(StringList),allocatable :: words
      integer :: oracle(128),n,step,j,k,value
      character(24) :: text,expected
      allocate(numbers,words)
      call IntList_init(numbers)
      call StringList_init(words)
      n=0
      do step=1,48
         n=n+1
         oracle(n)=1000*t+step
         call numbers%append(oracle(n))
         write(text,'(a,i0)') 'word-',step
         call words%append(trim(text))
         if(string_size(words)/=step) error stop 'String list size'
         if(mod(step,3)==0) then
            k=max(1,n/2)
            oracle(k+1:n+1)=oracle(k:n)
            value=-1000*t-step
            oracle(k)=value
            n=n+1
            call numbers%insert(k,value)
         end if
         if(mod(step,4)==0) then
            k=max(1,n/3)
            call numbers%delete(k)
            oracle(k:n-1)=oracle(k+1:n)
            n=n-1
         end if
         if(int_size(numbers)/=n) error stop 'Integer list size'
         do j=n,1,-1
            if(numbers%get(j)/=oracle(j)) error stop 'Integer sequence oracle'
            if(numbers%find(oracle(j))/=j) error stop 'Integer lookup'
         end do
         if(numbers%find(999999)/=0) error stop 'Absent integer'
         do j=step,1,-1
            write(expected,'(a,i0)') 'word-',j
            if(words%get(j)/=trim(expected)) error stop 'String sequence oracle'
            if(words%find(trim(expected))/=j) error stop 'String lookup'
         end do
         if(words%find('absent')/=0) error stop 'Absent string'
      end do
      deallocate(numbers,words)
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-stdlib-covariance-reference

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_stats, only: cov
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: x(:,:)
   real(real64) :: pair(3,3),expected(3,3),actual(3,3)
   integer :: n,k,l,i,j,c,checks
   checks=0
   do n=4,32
      allocate(x(n,3))
      do j=1,3
         do k=1,n
            x(k,j)=real(mod(k*j+3*j,11)-5,real64)/8+real((j-2)*k,real64)/16
         end do
      end do
      pair=0
      ! Pairwise differences avoid calling mean, variance, covariance or MATMUL.
      do j=1,3
         do i=1,3
            do l=2,n
               do k=1,l-1
                  pair(i,j)=pair(i,j)+(x(k,i)-x(l,i))*(x(k,j)-x(l,j))
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      do c=0,1
         expected=pair/real(n*(n-c),real64)
         actual=cov(x,dim=1,corrected=(c==1))
         call verify()
         actual=cov(transpose(x),dim=2,corrected=(c==1))
         call verify()
      end do
      deallocate(x)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '29 datasets; sample/population covariance and both axis conventions; entries: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-covariance-reference'
contains
   subroutine verify()
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Nonfinite covariance'
      if(any(abs(actual-expected)>2.e-12_real64*max(1._real64,abs(expected)))) error stop 'Pairwise oracle'
      checks=checks+9
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-stdlib-determinant-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: det,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64) :: lower(3,3),upper(3,3),a(3,3),original(3,3),row(3),actual,expected
   integer :: t,i
   do t=1,96
      lower=0
      upper=0
      do i=1,3
         lower(i,i)=1
         upper(i,i)=i+1
      end do
      lower(2,1)=mod(t,5)-2
      lower(3,1)=mod(t/5,5)-2
      lower(3,2)=mod(t/7,5)-2
      upper(1,2)=mod(t/3,7)-3
      upper(1,3)=mod(t/11,7)-3
      upper(2,3)=mod(t/13,7)-3
      a=matmul(lower,upper)
      if(mod(t,2)==0) then
         row=a(1,:)
         a(1,:)=a(3,:)
         a(3,:)=row
      end if
      ! Independent six-term determinant, not LU or a package factorization.
      expected=a(1,1)*(a(2,2)*a(3,3)-a(2,3)*a(3,2)) &
         -a(1,2)*(a(2,1)*a(3,3)-a(2,3)*a(3,1)) &
         +a(1,3)*(a(2,1)*a(3,2)-a(2,2)*a(3,1))
      original=a
      actual=det(a,err=state)
      if(.not.state%ok().or..not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'Determinant status'
      if(abs(actual-expected)>1.e-11_real64*abs(expected)) error stop 'Six-term determinant oracle'
      if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Input overwritten'
   end do
   print '(a)', '96 nonsingular real 3x3 determinants; positive/negative parity, six-term oracle, input preservation'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-determinant-reference'
end program

name: gams-stdlib-inverse-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: inv,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64),allocatable :: actual(:,:)
   real(real64) :: a(3,3),original(3,3),expected(3,3),identity(3,3),u(3),v(3),d(3),e(3),denominator
   integer :: t,i,j
   u=[1._real64,-1._real64,2._real64]
   d=[1._real64,2._real64,4._real64]
   e=[2._real64,1._real64,0.5_real64]
   identity=0
   do i=1,3
      identity(i,i)=1
   end do
   do t=1,128
      v=real([1+mod(t,3),1+mod(t/3,4),1+mod(t/12,5)],real64)/8
      denominator=1+sum(u*v)
      do j=1,3
         do i=1,3
            a(i,j)=d(i)*(identity(i,j)+u(i)*v(j))*e(j)
            expected(i,j)=(identity(i,j)-u(i)*v(j)/denominator)/(e(i)*d(j))
         end do
      end do
      original=a
      actual=inv(a,err=state)
      if(.not.state%ok()) error stop 'Inverse status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Nonfinite inverse'
      if(any(abs(actual-expected)>2.e-12_real64)) error stop 'Rank-one inverse oracle'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(a,actual)-identity))>2.e-12_real64) error stop 'Left inverse residual'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(actual,a)-identity))>2.e-12_real64) error stop 'Right inverse residual'
      if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Input overwritten'
   end do
   print '(a)', '128 scaled nonsymmetric rank-one inverses; 1,152 exact-form references and two-sided residuals'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-inverse-reference'
end program

name: gams-stdlib-trapezoid-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_quadrature, only: trapz
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: x(33),y(33),a,b,slope,constant,actual,expected
   integer :: n,i,k,checks
   checks=0
   do n=2,33
      do k=-4,4
         slope=real(k,real64)/4
         constant=real(n-17,real64)/8
         do i=1,n
            x(i)=real((i-1)**2,real64)/64-2
         end do
         y(:n)=slope*x(:n)+constant
         a=x(1)
         b=x(n)
         expected=slope*(b*b-a*a)/2+constant*(b-a)
         actual=trapz(y(:n),x(:n))
         call verify()
         actual=trapz(y(n:1:-1),x(n:1:-1))
         expected=-expected
         call verify()
         do i=1,n
            x(i)=real(i-1,real64)/8-2
         end do
         y(:n)=slope*x(:n)+constant
         a=x(1)
         b=x(n)
         expected=slope*(b*b-a*a)/2+constant*(b-a)
         actual=trapz(y(:n),0.125_real64)
         call verify()
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Affine antiderivatives on nonuniform, reversed and constant-spacing grids: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-trapezoid-reference'
contains
   subroutine verify()
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual).or.actual/=expected) error stop 'Affine integral oracle'
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-timer-brackets-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/statistics-services-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64,int64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use fortime, only: timer
   implicit none
   type(timer) :: wall,cpu
   integer(int64) :: outer0,inner0,inner1,outer1,rate,total,i,n
   real(real64) :: cpu0,cpu1,cpu2,cpu3,lo,hi,measured,slack
   integer :: t
   call system_clock(count_rate=rate)
   if(rate<=0) error stop 'Clock unavailable'
   do t=1,16
      call system_clock(outer0)
      call cpu_time(cpu0)
      call wall%timer_start()
      call cpu%ctimer_start()
      call system_clock(inner0)
      call cpu_time(cpu1)
      n=10000*t
      total=0
      do i=1,n
         total=total+i
      end do
      call cpu_time(cpu2)
      call system_clock(inner1)
      call cpu%ctimer_stop(nloops=t,print=.false.)
      call wall%timer_stop(nloops=t,print=.false.)
      call cpu_time(cpu3)
      call system_clock(outer1)
      if(total/=n*(n+1)/2) error stop 'Work checksum'
      measured=wall%elapsed_time*t
      slack=4._real64/real(rate,real64)
      lo=real(inner1-inner0,real64)/real(rate,real64)
      hi=real(outer1-outer0,real64)/real(rate,real64)
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(measured).or.measured<0) error stop 'Wall value'
      if(measured<lo-slack.or.measured>hi+slack) error stop 'Wall bracket'
      measured=cpu%cpu_time*t
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(measured).or.measured<0) error stop 'CPU value'
      if(measured<cpu2-cpu1-2.e-6_real64.or.measured>cpu3-cpu0+2.e-6_real64) error stop 'CPU bracket'
   end do
   print '(a)', '16 reused wall/CPU timer pairs; averaging, native inner/outer brackets and exact work checksums'
   print '(a)', 'PASS timer-brackets-reference'
end program

name: gams-assert-enforcement-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/statistics-services-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use assert_m, only: assert
   implicit none
   character(2048) :: executable
   character(512) :: line
   integer :: n,status,exit_code,length,unit,value
   logical :: found
   if(command_argument_count()>0) then
      call assert(.false.,'checked-assertion-enforcement-marker')
      print '(a)', 'Unexpected return from false assertion'
      stop
   end if
   do n=-32,32
      value=checked_square(n)
      if(value/=n*n) error stop 'Passing contract changed value'
   end do
   call get_command_argument(0,executable,length=length,status=status)
   if(status/=0.or.length>len(executable)) error stop 'Executable path'
   call execute_command_line('"'//trim(executable)//'" --expected-failure > assertion.log 2>&1', &
      cmdstat=status,exitstat=exit_code)
   if(status/=0.or.exit_code==0) error stop 'False assertion did not terminate child'
   found=.false.
   open(newunit=unit,file='assertion.log',status='old',action='read')
   do
      read(unit,'(a)',iostat=status) line
      if(status<0) exit
      if(status/=0) error stop 'Assertion log'
      if(index(line,'Unexpected return')>0) error stop 'Assertion was ignored'
      if(index(line,'checked-assertion-enforcement-marker')>0) found=.true.
   end do
   close(unit,status='delete')
   if(.not.found) error stop 'Missing assertion diagnostic'
   print '(a)', '65 pure-contract calls; false assertion terminates a child with the required diagnostic'
   print '(a)', 'PASS assert-enforcement-reference'
contains
   pure function checked_square(n) result(value)
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      integer :: value
      call assert(abs(n)<=32,'Bounded square input')
      value=n*n
      call assert(value>=0,'Nonnegative square')
   end function
end program

name: gams-mpifx-identity-reference
source:

! Exactly one MPI process; this is an API identity check, not parallel verification.
program main
   use libmpifx_module
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   type(mpifx_comm) :: comm
   real(real64) :: values(7),expected(7),reduced(7)
   integer :: t,i,status,total
   call mpifx_init(error=status)
   call check(status)
   call comm%init(error=status)
   call check(status)
   if(comm%size/=1.or.comm%rank/=0) error stop 'Requires one MPI process'
   do t=1,64
      do i=1,7
         expected(i)=real(t*i-100,real64)/8
      end do
      values=expected
      call mpifx_bcast(comm,values,error=status)
      call check(status)
      if(any(values/=expected)) error stop 'Broadcast identity'
      call mpifx_allreduce(comm,values,reduced,MPI_SUM,error=status)
      call check(status)
      if(any(reduced/=expected)) error stop 'Array reduction identity'
      call mpifx_allreduceip(comm,values,MPI_MAX,error=status)
      call check(status)
      if(any(values/=expected)) error stop 'In-place reduction identity'
      call mpifx_allreduce(comm,t-33,total,MPI_SUM,error=status)
      call check(status)
      if(total/=t-33) error stop 'Scalar reduction identity'
   end do
   call mpifx_finalize(error=status)
   call check(status)
   print '(a)', '64 one-process broadcast/reduction traces; 1,408 exact value references'
   print '(a)', 'PASS mpifx-identity-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(code)
      integer,intent(in) :: code
      if(code/=0) error stop 'MPI wrapper status'
   end subroutine
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: qr,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64) :: a(5,3),original(5,3),q(5,3),r(3,3),fullq(5,5),fullr(5,3),eye(5,5),scale
   integer :: t,i,j
   eye=0
   do i=1,5
      eye(i,i)=1
   end do
   do t=1,64
      do j=1,3
         do i=1,5
            a(i,j)=real(mod(t+7*i+3*j,17)-8,real64)/8
            if(i==j) a(i,j)=a(i,j)+j+2
         end do
      end do
      original=a
      scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(a)))
      call qr(a,q,r,err=state)
      if(.not.state%ok()) error stop 'Reduced QR status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(q)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(r))) error stop 'Nonfinite reduced QR'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(q,r)-original))>5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Reduced reconstruction'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(q),q)-eye(:3,:3)))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Reduced orthogonality'
      do j=1,3
         if(any(abs(r(j+1:3,j))>5.e-12_real64*scale)) error stop 'Reduced triangularity'
      end do
      if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Reduced input changed'
      call qr(a,fullq,fullr,err=state)
      if(.not.state%ok()) error stop 'Full QR status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(fullq)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(fullr))) error stop 'Nonfinite full QR'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(fullq,fullr)-original))>5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Full reconstruction'
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(fullq),fullq)-eye))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Full orthogonality'
      do j=1,3
         if(any(abs(fullr(j+1:5,j))>5.e-12_real64*scale)) error stop 'Full triangularity'
      end do
      if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Full input changed'
   end do
   print '(a)', '64 real 5x3 matrices; 128 full/reduced QR decompositions, reconstruction, orthogonality and triangularity'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-qr-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: eigh,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:),original(:,:),vectors(:,:),eye(:,:),lambda(:),expected(:),u(:)
   real(real64) :: shift,rho,scale
   integer :: n,t,i,j,triangle,checks
   checks=0
   do n=3,8
      allocate(a(n,n),original(n,n),vectors(n,n),eye(n,n),lambda(n),expected(n),u(n))
      eye=0
      do i=1,n
         eye(i,i)=1
      end do
      do t=1,8
         do i=1,n
            u(i)=mod(i+t,5)-2
         end do
         u(1)=1
         shift=-real(n,real64)/4
         rho=real(t,real64)/16
         do j=1,n
            do i=1,n
               a(i,j)=shift*eye(i,j)+rho*u(i)*u(j)
            end do
         end do
         original=a
         expected=shift
         expected(n)=shift+rho*sum(u*u)
         scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(a)))
         do triangle=0,1
            call eigh(a,lambda,vectors,upper_a=(triangle==1),err=state)
            if(.not.state%ok()) error stop 'Symmetric eigenproblem status'
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(lambda)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) error stop 'Nonfinite eigensystem'
            if(maxval(abs(lambda-expected))>3.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Rank-one eigenvalue oracle'
            if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(vectors),vectors)-eye))>3.e-12_real64) error stop 'Eigenvector orthogonality'
            do j=1,n
               if(maxval(abs(matmul(original,vectors(:,j))-lambda(j)*vectors(:,j)))> &
                  3.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Eigenpair residual'
            end do
            if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Eigenproblem input changed'
            checks=checks+n
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,original,vectors,eye,lambda,expected,u)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '96 symmetric eigensystems, orders 3..8; analytic eigenvalues with repeated roots: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-eigh-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: svd,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64) :: left(4,3),right(3,3),a(4,3),original(4,3),u(4,3),vt(3,3),work(4,3)
   real(real64) :: s(3),expected(3),eye(3,3),scale
   integer :: t,rank,i,j
   left(:,1)=[1._real64,1._real64,1._real64,1._real64]/2
   left(:,2)=[1._real64,-1._real64,1._real64,-1._real64]/2
   left(:,3)=[1._real64,1._real64,-1._real64,-1._real64]/2
   right=0
   right(1,1)=0.6_real64
   right(1,2)=-0.8_real64
   right(2,1)=0.8_real64
   right(2,2)=0.6_real64
   right(3,3)=1
   eye=0
   do i=1,3
      eye(i,i)=1
   end do
   do rank=1,3
      do t=1,16
         expected=[3._real64+real(t,real64)/8,2._real64+real(t,real64)/16,1._real64+real(t,real64)/32]
         expected(rank+1:3)=0
         do j=1,3
            work(:,j)=left(:,j)*expected(j)
         end do
         a=matmul(work,transpose(right))
         original=a
         scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(a)))
         call svd(a,s,u,vt,full_matrices=.false.,err=state)
         if(.not.state%ok()) error stop 'SVD status'
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(s)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(u)).or. &
            .not.all(ieee_is_finite(vt))) error stop 'Nonfinite SVD'
         if(maxval(abs(s-expected))>5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Constructed singular-value oracle'
         do j=1,3
            work(:,j)=u(:,j)*s(j)
            if(maxval(abs(matmul(original,vt(j,:))-s(j)*u(:,j)))>5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Left SVD residual'
            if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(original),u(:,j))-s(j)*vt(j,:)))> &
               5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Right SVD residual'
         end do
         if(maxval(abs(matmul(work,vt)-original))>5.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'SVD reconstruction'
         if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(u),u)-eye))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Left SVD orthogonality'
         if(maxval(abs(matmul(vt,transpose(vt))-eye))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Right SVD orthogonality'
         if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'SVD input changed'
      end do
   end do
   print '(a)', '48 real 4x3 matrices, ranks 1..3; 144 known singular values, paired residuals and orthogonality'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-svd-reference'
end program

name: gams-stdlib-pinv-reference
source:

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: pinv,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:),original(:,:),u(:),v(:),actual(:,:),expected(:,:),ap(:,:),pa(:,:)
   real(real64) :: denominator,scale
   integer :: m,n,t,i,j,checks
   checks=0
   do m=2,6
      do n=2,5
         allocate(a(m,n),original(m,n),u(m),v(n),actual(n,m),expected(n,m),ap(m,m),pa(n,n))
         do t=1,4
            do i=1,m
               u(i)=real(i+t,real64)/8
            end do
            do j=1,n
               v(j)=real((-1)**j*(j+2),real64)/4
            end do
            denominator=sum(u*u)*sum(v*v)
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,m
                  a(i,j)=u(i)*v(j)
                  expected(j,i)=v(j)*u(i)/denominator
               end do
            end do
            original=a
            actual=pinv(a,rtol=1.e-10_real64,err=state)
            if(.not.state%ok().or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Pseudoinverse status'
            if(maxval(abs(actual-expected))>2.e-11_real64) error stop 'Outer-product pseudoinverse oracle'
            ap=matmul(a,actual)
            pa=matmul(actual,a)
            scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(a)))
            if(maxval(abs(matmul(ap,a)-a))>2.e-11_real64*scale) error stop 'First Moore-Penrose identity'
            if(maxval(abs(matmul(pa,actual)-actual))>2.e-11_real64) error stop 'Second Moore-Penrose identity'
            if(maxval(abs(ap-transpose(ap)))>2.e-11_real64) error stop 'Third Moore-Penrose identity'
            if(maxval(abs(pa-transpose(pa)))>2.e-11_real64) error stop 'Fourth Moore-Penrose identity'
            if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Pseudoinverse input changed'
            checks=checks+m*n
         end do
         deallocate(a,original,u,v,actual,expected,ap,pa)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '80 rank-one rectangular matrices; closed-form pseudoinverse entries and four identities: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-pinv-reference'
end program

source:

program main
