   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: mnorm,linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   type(linalg_state_type) :: state
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:)
   real(real64) :: one,inf,fro,total,actual,expected
   integer :: m,n,t,i,j,checks
   checks=0
   do m=1,5
      do n=1,7
         allocate(a(m,n))
         do t=0,4
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,m
                  a(i,j)=real(mod(5*i+3*j+t,17)-8,real64)/8
               end do
            end do
            if(t==0) a=0
            one=0
            inf=0
            fro=0
            do j=1,n
               total=0
               do i=1,m
                  total=total+abs(a(i,j))
                  fro=fro+a(i,j)*a(i,j)
               end do
               one=max(one,total)
            end do
            do i=1,m
               total=0
               do j=1,n
                  total=total+abs(a(i,j))
               end do
               inf=max(inf,total)
            end do
            fro=sqrt(fro)
            actual=mnorm(a,'1',err=state)
            expected=one
            call verify()
            actual=mnorm(a,'Inf',err=state)
            expected=inf
            call verify()
            actual=mnorm(a,'Frobenius',err=state)
            expected=fro
            call verify()
         end do
         deallocate(a)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '175 real matrices, including zeros; scalar-loop 1/infinity/Frobenius norm references: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-matrix-norms-reference'
contains
   subroutine verify()
      if(.not.state%ok().or..not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'Matrix norm status'
      if(abs(actual-expected)>2.e-12_real64*max(1._real64,expected)) error stop 'Scalar-loop norm oracle'
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-stdlib-expm-reference

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: expm
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: a(3,3),original(3,3),expected(3,3),eye(3,3),nilpotent(3,3),rotation(2,2),angle,shift
   real(real64),allocatable :: actual(:,:)
   integer :: t,i,mode,checks
   eye=0
   do i=1,3
      eye(i,i)=1
   end do
   checks=0
   do t=-16,16
      shift=real(t,real64)/16
      nilpotent=0
      nilpotent(1,2)=real(t,real64)/8
      nilpotent(2,3)=real(modulo(t,7)-3,real64)/4
      nilpotent(1,3)=real(modulo(t,5)-2,real64)/8
      a=shift*eye+nilpotent
      original=a
      expected=exp(shift)*(eye+nilpotent+matmul(nilpotent,nilpotent)/2)
      do mode=1,2
         if(mode==1) then
            actual=expm(a)
         else
            actual=expm(a,order=12)
         end if
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Nonfinite matrix exponential'
         if(maxval(abs(actual-expected))>2.e-11_real64*max(1._real64,maxval(abs(expected)))) &
            error stop 'Shifted nilpotent exponential oracle'
         if(any(a/=original)) error stop 'Exponential input changed'
         checks=checks+9
      end do
      angle=real(t,real64)*acos(-1._real64)/32
      rotation=reshape([0._real64,angle,-angle,0._real64],[2,2])
      expected=0
      expected(1,1)=cos(angle)
      expected(2,2)=cos(angle)
      expected(1,2)=-sin(angle)
      expected(2,1)=sin(angle)
      do mode=1,2
         if(mode==1) then
            actual=expm(rotation)
         else
            actual=expm(rotation,order=12)
         end if
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Nonfinite rotation exponential'
         if(maxval(abs(actual-expected(:2,:2)))>2.e-11_real64) error stop 'Rotation exponential oracle'
         checks=checks+4
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', '132 exponential calls; shifted nilpotent and plane-rotation closed-form entries: ',checks
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-expm-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_quadrature, only: simps
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: x(33),y(33),a,b,c,d,lo,hi,expected,actual
   integer :: n,t,i,checks
   checks=0
   do n=3,33,2
      do t=-4,4
         a=real(t,real64)/8
         b=real(n-17,real64)/16
         c=0.25_real64
         d=-0.5_real64
         do i=1,n
            x(i)=real(i-1,real64)/16-1
         end do

program main

   use stdlib_quadrature, only: gauss_legendre
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: x(:),w(:),z(:)
   real(real64) :: lo,hi,expected,actual
   integer :: n,interval,p,checks
   checks=0
   do n=2,12
      allocate(x(n),w(n),z(n))
      do interval=1,3
         select case(interval)
         case(1)
            lo=-1
            hi=1
            call gauss_legendre(x,w)
         case(2)
            lo=0
            hi=1
            call gauss_legendre(x,w,interval=[lo,hi])
         case(3)
            lo=-0.5_real64
            hi=1.5_real64
            call gauss_legendre(x,w,interval=[lo,hi])
         end select
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(w))) error stop 'Nonfinite Gauss rule'
         if(any(x<=lo).or.any(x>=hi).or.any(w<=0)) error stop 'Gauss interior/positive weights'
         if(any(x(2:)<=x(:n-1))) error stop 'Gauss node ordering'
         if(maxval(abs(x+x(n:1:-1)-lo-hi))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Gauss node symmetry'
         if(maxval(abs(w-w(n:1:-1)))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Gauss weight symmetry'

            actual=sum(w*z**p)
            if(abs(actual-expected)>5.e-12_real64*(hi-lo)) error stop 'Gauss analytic moment'
            checks=checks+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,w,z)

   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-gauss-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: solve_constrained_lstsq
   use stdlib_linalg_state, only: linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: a(6,3),a0(6,3),b(6),b0(6),c(1,3),c0(1,3),d(1),d0(1),x(3)
   real(real64) :: s(3,3),si(3,3),diag(3),h(3),u(3),v(3),expected(3),gradient(3),lambda
   type(linalg_state_type) :: err
   integer :: t,i
   do t=1,96
      a0=0; s=0; si=0
      do i=1,3
         s(i,i)=1; si(i,i)=1
         diag(i)=1+real(mod(t+i,7),real64)/4
         a0(i,i)=diag(i); a0(i+3,i)=2*diag(i)
         b(i)=real(mod(t+3*i,11)-5,real64)/8
         b(i+3)=real(mod(2*t+i,13)-6,real64)/8
      end do
      s(1,2)=real(mod(t,5)-2,real64)/4
      s(2,3)=real(mod(t,7)-3,real64)/8
      si(1,2)=-s(1,2); si(2,3)=-s(2,3); si(1,3)=s(1,2)*s(2,3)
      v=[1._real64,real(mod(t,9)-4,real64)/8,-0.5_real64]
      h=5*diag**2
      u=(diag*b(:3)+2*diag*b(4:))/h
      d=real(mod(t,17)-8,real64)/8
      lambda=(dot_product(v,u)-d(1))/sum(v*v/h)
      expected=matmul(si,u-lambda*v/h)
      a=matmul(a0,s); c(1,:)=matmul(v,s)
      a0=a; b0=b; c0=c; d0=d
      call solve_constrained_lstsq(a,b,c,d,x,err=err)
      if(.not.err%ok()) error stop 'Constrained least-squares status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'Nonfinite constrained solution'
      if(maxval(abs(x-expected))>5.e-12_real64*max(1._real64,maxval(abs(expected)))) &
         error stop 'Independent equality-constrained minimizer'
      if(abs(dot_product(c0(1,:),x)-d0(1))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Equality feasibility'
      gradient=matmul(transpose(a0),matmul(a0,x)-b0)+lambda*c0(1,:)
      if(maxval(abs(gradient))>5.e-12_real64*max(1._real64,maxval(abs(b0)))) error stop 'KKT stationarity'
      if(any(a/=a0).or.any(b/=b0).or.any(c/=c0).or.any(d/=d0)) error stop 'Preserved constrained inputs'
   end do
   print '(a)', '96 equality-constrained fits versus independent diagonal-Hessian/shear oracle, feasibility and stationarity'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-constrained-ls-reference'
end program

program main

   use stdlib_linalg, only: solve_weighted_lstsq
   use stdlib_linalg_state, only: linalg_state_type
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:),saved(:,:),w(:),b(:)
   real(real64) :: x(2),expected(2),sw,sx,sxx,sy,sxy,delta,r0,r1,t
   type(linalg_state_type) :: err
   integer :: n,j,k
   do n=4,15
      allocate(a(n,2),saved(n,2),w(n),b(n))
      do k=1,8
         sw=0; sx=0; sxx=0; sy=0; sxy=0
         do j=1,n
            t=real(2*j-n-1,real64)/n
            a(j,:)=[1._real64,t]
            w(j)=real(1+mod(j*k,16),real64)
            b(j)=real(k-4,real64)/4+0.75_real64*t+t*t/4+(-1._real64)**j/16
            sw=sw+w(j); sx=sx+w(j)*t; sxx=sxx+w(j)*t*t
            sy=sy+w(j)*b(j); sxy=sxy+w(j)*t*b(j)
         end do
         delta=sw*sxx-sx*sx
         expected=[(sy*sxx-sx*sxy)/delta,(sw*sxy-sx*sy)/delta]
         saved=a
         call solve_weighted_lstsq(w,a,b,x,err=err)
         if(.not.err%ok()) error stop 'Weighted least-squares status'
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'Nonfinite weighted solution'
         if(maxval(abs(x-expected))>5.e-12_real64) error stop 'Independent weighted coefficients'
         r0=0; r1=0
         do j=1,n
            t=x(1)+x(2)*saved(j,2)-b(j)
            r0=r0+w(j)*t; r1=r1+w(j)*saved(j,2)*t
         end do
         if(max(abs(r0),abs(r1))>5.e-12_real64*sw) error stop 'Weighted normal equations'
         if(any(a/=saved)) error stop 'Weighted matrix preservation'
      end do
      deallocate(a,saved,w,b)
   end do
   print '(a)', '96 weighted line fits versus independent scalar-sum formulas and weighted normal equations'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-weighted-ls-reference'
end program

   real(real64) :: alpha,beta,r,scale
   complex(real64) :: values(3),expected(3),right(3,3),left(3,3),residual(3)
   logical :: used(3)
   type(linalg_state_type) :: err
   integer :: k,i,j,match
   do k=1,64
      alpha=real(mod(k,11)-5,real64)/4
      beta=real(1+mod(k,7),real64)/8
      r=3+real(mod(k,5),real64)/4
      s=0; si=0; b=0; q=0
      do i=1,3
         s(i,i)=1; si(i,i)=1; b(i,i)=2._real64**(i-1); q(i,i)=1
      end do
      s(1,2)=real(mod(k,7)-3,real64)/4
      s(2,3)=real(mod(k,5)-2,real64)/4
      si(1,2)=-s(1,2); si(2,3)=-s(2,3); si(1,3)=s(1,2)*s(2,3)
      t=0
      t(1,1)=alpha; t(2,2)=alpha; t(3,3)=r
      t(1,2)=-beta; t(2,1)=beta
      a=matmul(s,matmul(t,si))
      expected=[cmplx(alpha,beta,real64),cmplx(alpha,-beta,real64),cmplx(r,0._real64,real64)]
      b=q
      a0=a; b0=b
      call eig(a,values,right=right,left=left,err=err)
      if(.not.err%ok()) error stop 'Eigenproblem status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(right,real64))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(right)))) &
         error stop 'Nonfinite right eigenvectors'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(left,real64))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(left)))) &
         error stop 'Nonfinite left eigenvectors'
      scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(a0)),maxval(abs(b0)))
      do j=1,3
         if(abs(sum(abs(right(:,j))**2)-1)>8.e-12_real64) error stop 'Right vector normalization'
         if(abs(sum(abs(left(:,j))**2)-1)>8.e-12_real64) error stop 'Left vector normalization'
         residual=matmul(a0,right(:,j))-values(j)*matmul(b0,right(:,j))
         if(maxval(abs(residual))>8.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Right eigenvector equation'
         residual=matmul(transpose(a0),left(:,j))-conjg(values(j))*matmul(transpose(b0),left(:,j))
         if(maxval(abs(residual))>8.e-12_real64*scale) error stop 'Left eigenvector equation'
      end do
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(values,real64))).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(values)))) &
         error stop 'Nonfinite eigenvalues'
      used=.false.
      do j=1,3
         match=0
         do i=1,3
            if(.not.used(i).and.abs(values(j)-expected(i))<8.e-12_real64) match=i
         end do
         if(match==0) error stop 'Independent analytic eigenvalue set'
         used(match)=.true.
      end do
      if(any(a/=a0).or.any(b/=b0)) error stop 'Eigenproblem input preservation'
   end do
   print '(a)', '64 nonsymmetric three-by-three problems with analytic spectra: 192 eigenvalue references'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-nonsymmetric-eig-reference'
end program

source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/systems-spectra-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
module driver_operators
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: matrix(:,:),inverse_diagonal(:)
contains
   subroutine multiply(x,y,alpha,beta,op)
      real(real64),intent(in) :: x(:),alpha,beta
      real(real64),intent(inout) :: y(:)
      character(1),intent(in) :: op
      if(op/='N') error stop 'Unverified operator request'
      y=alpha*matmul(matrix,x)+beta*y
   end subroutine
   subroutine precondition(x,y,alpha,beta,op)
      real(real64),intent(in) :: x(:),alpha,beta
      real(real64),intent(inout) :: y(:)
      character(1),intent(in) :: op
      if(op/='N') error stop 'Unverified preconditioner request'
      y=alpha*inverse_diagonal*x+beta*y
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg_iterative_solvers, only: stdlib_solve_cg_kernel
   use stdlib_linalg_iterative_solvers, only: stdlib_linop_dp_type, stdlib_solver_workspace_dp_type
   use driver_operators, only: matrix, inverse_diagonal, multiply, precondition
   implicit none
   type(stdlib_linop_dp_type) :: operator, preconditioner
   type(stdlib_solver_workspace_dp_type) :: workspace
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:),saved(:,:),b(:),x(:),expected(:),d(:)
   real(real64) :: value,residual,scale
   integer :: n,t,i,j,calls
   calls=0
   operator%matvec=>multiply
   preconditioner%matvec=>precondition
   do n=2,18
      allocate(a(n,n),saved(n,n),b(n),x(n),expected(n),d(n))
      allocate(matrix(n,n),inverse_diagonal(n),workspace%tmp(n,3))
      do t=1,6
         do i=1,n
            expected(i)=(-1._real64)**i*(i+t)/16
            d(i)=1
         end do
         do i=1,n
            do j=1,n
               value=real(i*j,real64)/(100*n*n)
               if(i==j) value=value+2+real(i+t,real64)/16
               if(abs(i-j)==1) value=value-0.3_real64
               a(i,j)=d(i)*value*d(j)
            end do
         end do
         b=0
         do i=1,n
            do j=1,n
               b(i)=b(i)+a(i,j)*expected(j)
            end do
         end do
         x=0.125_real64
         saved=a
         matrix=a
         workspace%tmp=0
         inverse_diagonal=1
         call stdlib_solve_cg_kernel(operator,b,x,rtol=1.e-12_real64,atol=1.e-14_real64, &
              maxiter=10*n,workspace=workspace)
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'Nonfinite iterative solution'
         scale=max(1._real64,maxval(abs(expected)))

program main

   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:),original(:),reference(:)
   integer,allocatable :: order(:)
   integer(int32),allocatable :: indices(:)
   real(real64) :: value
   integer :: n,t,k,i,index,calls
   calls=0
   do n=1,31
      allocate(a(n),original(n),reference(n),order(n),indices(n))
      do t=1,6
         call fill(original,t)
         reference=original
         call reference_sort(reference,order,.false.)
         do k=1,n
            a=original
            call select(a,k,value)
            if(.not.ieee_is_finite(value).or.value/=reference(k)) error stop 'Known order statistic'
            if(a(k)/=value) error stop 'Selection pivot'
            if(any(a(:k-1)>value).or.any(a(k+1:)<value)) error stop 'Selection partition'
            do i=1,n
               if(count(a==original(i))/=count(original==original(i))) error stop 'Selection multiset'
            end do
            calls=calls+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,original,reference,order,indices)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Every rank on 186 finite duplicate-containing arrays versus independent insertion sort: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-select-reference'
contains
   subroutine fill(a,t)
      real(real64),intent(out) :: a(:)
      integer,intent(in) :: t
      integer :: i,n
      n=size(a)
      do i=1,n
         select case(t)
         case(1)
            a(i)=real(i-n/2,real64)/8
         case(2)
            a(i)=real(n+1-i-n/2,real64)/8
         case(3)
            a(i)=-0.5_real64
         case(4)
            a(i)=(-1._real64)**i*mod(i,7)/8
         case(5)
            a(i)=real(mod(17*i+3*t,23)-11,real64)/8
         case(6)
            a(i)=real((i-1)/3,real64)/8
         end select
      end do
   end subroutine
   subroutine reference_sort(values,order,reverse)
      real(real64),intent(inout) :: values(:)
      integer,intent(out) :: order(:)
      logical,intent(in) :: reverse
      real(real64) :: key
      integer :: i,j,index
      do i=1,size(values)
         order(i)=i
      end do
      do i=2,size(values)
         key=values(i); index=order(i); j=i-1

               if(values(j)>=key) exit
            else
               if(values(j)<=key) exit
            end if
            values(j+1)=values(j); order(j+1)=order(j); j=j-1
         end do
         values(j+1)=key; order(j+1)=index
      end do
   end subroutine
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64, int32, int64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_math, only: diff
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:),saved(:),work(:),output(:),expected(:)
   integer :: length,n,mode,i,j,k,c,calls
   calls=0
   do length=0,24
      allocate(a(length),saved(length))
      do i=1,length
         a(i)=real(i**3-2*i*i+mod(i,3),real64)/8
      end do
      saved=a
      do n=0,6
         do mode=1,2
            if(n==0.and.mode==2) cycle
            if(mode==1) then
               work=a
               output=diff(a,n=n)
            else
               work=[-2._real64,0.5_real64,a,3._real64]
               output=diff(a,n=n,prepend=[-2._real64,0.5_real64],append=[3._real64])
            end if
            allocate(expected(max(size(work)-n,0))); expected=0
            do i=1,size(expected)
               do j=0,n
                  c=1
                  do k=1,j
                     c=c*(n-k+1)/k
                  end do
                  expected(i)=expected(i)+(-1._real64)**(n-j)*c*work(i+j)
               end do
            end do
            if(size(output)/=size(expected)) error stop 'Difference output length'
            if(any(output/=expected)) error stop 'Independent binomial difference stencil'
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(output))) error stop 'Nonfinite differences'
            if(any(a/=saved)) error stop 'Difference input preservation'
            deallocate(expected)
            calls=calls+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,saved)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Array differences versus independent binomial stencils, orders 0..6, with/without padding: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-differences-reference'
end program

name: gams-stdlib-cross-product-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/pca-ordering-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64, int32, int64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: cross_product
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: a(3),b(3),actual(3),expected(3)
   integer :: i,j,t,u,calls
   calls=0
   do i=1,3
      a=0; a(i)=1
      do j=1,3
         b=0; b(j)=1
         call check_pair()
      end do
   end do
   do t=-32,32
      do u=-16,16
         a=real([t,u,t-u],real64)/8
         b=real([u,-t,t+u],real64)/16
         call check_pair()
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Cross products versus Levi-Civita determinant sums, antisymmetry and orthogonality: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-cross-product-reference'
contains
   subroutine check_pair()
      integer :: p,q,r,epsilon
      expected=0
      do p=1,3
         do q=1,3
            do r=1,3
               epsilon=((p-q)*(q-r)*(r-p))/2
               expected(p)=expected(p)+epsilon*a(q)*b(r)
            end do
         end do
      end do
      actual=cross_product(a,b)
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'Nonfinite cross product'
      if(any(actual/=expected)) error stop 'Independent determinant sum'
      if(any(actual+cross_product(b,a)/=0)) error stop 'Cross-product antisymmetry'
      if(dot_product(actual,a)/=0.or.dot_product(actual,b)/=0) error stop 'Cross-product orthogonality'
      calls=calls+1
   end subroutine
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64, int32, int64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: kronecker_product
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:,:),c(:,:),x(:,:),expected(:,:),y(:)
   real(real64) :: value
   integer :: ma,na,mb,nb,t,i,j,k,l,r,col,calls
   calls=0
   do ma=1,4
      do na=1,3
         do mb=1,4
            do nb=1,3
               allocate(a(ma,na),b(mb,nb),x(nb,na),expected(mb,ma))
               do j=1,na
                  do i=1,ma
                     a(i,j)=real(i-2*j,real64)/4
                  end do
                  do i=1,nb
                     x(i,j)=real(i+j,real64)/4
                  end do
               end do
               do t=-1,1
                  do j=1,nb
                     do i=1,mb
                        b(i,j)=real(t*(2*i+j),real64)/8
                     end do
                  end do
                  c=kronecker_product(a,b)
                  if(any(shape(c)/=[ma*mb,na*nb])) error stop 'Kronecker shape'
                  if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(c))) error stop 'Nonfinite Kronecker product'
                  do col=1,na*nb
                     do r=1,ma*mb
                        value=a((r-1)/mb+1,(col-1)/nb+1)*b(mod(r-1,mb)+1,mod(col-1,nb)+1)
                        if(c(r,col)/=value) error stop 'Independent flattened Kronecker index'
                     end do
                  end do
                  expected=0
                  do j=1,ma
                     do i=1,mb
                        do l=1,na
                           do k=1,nb
                              expected(i,j)=expected(i,j)+b(i,k)*x(k,l)*a(j,l)
                           end do
                        end do
                     end do
                  end do
                  y=matmul(c,reshape(x,[nb*na]))
                  if(any(y/=reshape(expected,[mb*ma]))) error stop 'Column-major tensor vec identity'
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               deallocate(a,b,x,expected)
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Rectangular tensor products versus independent index and column-major vec identities: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-kronecker-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64, int32, int64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: diag
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: v(:),a(:,:),dense(:,:),output(:),expected(:)
   real(real64) :: value
   integer :: n,k,m,i,j,r,col,constructs,extracts
   constructs=0; extracts=0
   do n=1,12
      allocate(v(n),expected(n))
      do i=1,n
         v(i)=real(2*i-n,real64)/8
      end do
      do k=-3,3
         m=n+abs(k)
         a=diag(v,k)
         if(any(shape(a)/=[m,m])) error stop 'Offset diagonal shape'
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(a))) error stop 'Nonfinite diagonal matrix'
         do j=1,m
            do i=1,m
               value=0
               if(j-i==k) value=v(min(i,j))
               if(a(i,j)/=value) error stop 'Independent diagonal initialization'
            end do
         end do
         constructs=constructs+1
         output=diag(a,k)
         if(size(output)/=n) error stop 'Diagonal round-trip length'
         if(any(output/=v)) error stop 'Embedded diagonal extraction'
         allocate(dense(m,m))
         do j=1,m
            do i=1,m
               dense(i,j)=real(3*i-2*j,real64)/8
            end do
         end do
         do i=1,n
            r=i+max(-k,0); col=i+max(k,0)
            expected(i)=real(3*r-2*col,real64)/8
         end do
         output=diag(dense,k)
         if(size(output)/=n) error stop 'Dense extraction length'
         if(any(output/=expected)) error stop 'Independent dense diagonal reference'
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(output))) error stop 'Nonfinite extracted diagonal'
         extracts=extracts+2
         deallocate(dense)
      end do
      deallocate(v,expected)
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Offset diagonal construction calls=',constructs,', independent/embedded extractions=',extracts
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-diagonals-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_linalg, only: outer_product
   implicit none
   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:),b(:),c(:,:),x(:),y(:)
   real(real64) :: dot,expected,frobenius
   integer :: n,m,t,i,j,k,l,calls
   calls=0
   do n=1,8
      do m=1,7
         allocate(a(n),b(m),x(m))
         do t=1,4
            do i=1,n
               a(i)=real(i-3*t,real64)/8
            end do
            do j=1,m
               b(j)=real(2*j-t,real64)/4
               x(j)=(-1._real64)**j*j/8
            end do
            if(t==4) a=0
            c=outer_product(a,b)
            if(any(shape(c)/=[n,m])) error stop 'Outer-product shape'
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(c))) error stop 'Nonfinite outer product'
            do j=1,m
               do i=1,n
                  if(c(i,j)/=a(i)*b(j)) error stop 'Outer-product entry reference'
               end do
            end do
            dot=0
            do j=1,m
               dot=dot+b(j)*x(j)
            end do
            y=matmul(c,x)
            do i=1,n
               expected=a(i)*dot
               if(y(i)/=expected) error stop 'Independent rank-one matrix action'
            end do
            do i=1,n-1
               do j=1,m-1
                  if(c(i,j)*c(i+1,j+1)/=c(i,j+1)*c(i+1,j)) error stop 'Zero rank-one adjacent minors'
               end do
            end do
            frobenius=sum(c*c)
            if(frobenius/=sum(a*a)*sum(b*b)) error stop 'Outer-product Frobenius identity'
            calls=calls+1
         end do
         deallocate(a,b,x)
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Rectangular rank-one products: entries, independent matrix action, minors and Frobenius identity: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-outer-product-reference'
end program

name: gams-stdlib-softmax-normalization-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/activations-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use stdlib_specialfunctions, only: softmax, logsoftmax, softmax_grad
   implicit none
   real(real64),parameter :: shifts(3)=[-1000._real64,0._real64,1000._real64]
   real(real64),allocatable :: w(:),x(:),saved(:),p(:),logs(:),gradient(:),reference(:)
   real(real64) :: wm(3,4),xm(3,4),savedm(3,4),pm(3,4),lm(3,4),gm(3,4),rm(3,4),denominator
   integer :: n,t,k,i,j,direction,vectors,matrices,entries
   vectors=0; matrices=0; entries=0
   do n=1,12
      allocate(w(n),x(n),saved(n))
      do t=1,4
         do i=1,n
            w(i)=2._real64**(mod(i*t,7)-3)
         end do
         denominator=0
         do i=1,n
            denominator=denominator+w(i)
         end do
         reference=w/denominator
         do k=1,3
            x=log(w)+shifts(k); saved=x
            p=softmax(x); logs=logsoftmax(x); gradient=softmax_grad(x)
            do i=1,n
               call check(p(i),reference(i))
               call check(logs(i),log(reference(i)))
               call check(gradient(i),reference(i)*(1-reference(i)))
            end do
            call check(sum(p),1._real64)
            if(any(x/=saved)) error stop 'Softmax vector input preservation'
            vectors=vectors+1; entries=entries+n
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(w,x,saved)
   end do
   do t=1,4
      do j=1,4
         do i=1,3
            wm(i,j)=2._real64**(mod(i+3*j+t,7)-3)
         end do
      end do
      do direction=1,2
         if(direction==1) then
            do j=1,4
               denominator=0
               do i=1,3
                  denominator=denominator+wm(i,j)
               end do
               rm(:,j)=wm(:,j)/denominator
            end do
         else
            do i=1,3
               denominator=0
               do j=1,4
                  denominator=denominator+wm(i,j)
               end do
               rm(i,:)=wm(i,:)/denominator
            end do
         end if
         do k=1,3
            xm=log(wm)+shifts(k); savedm=xm
            pm=softmax(xm,dim=direction); lm=logsoftmax(xm,dim=direction); gm=softmax_grad(xm,dim=direction)
            do j=1,4
               do i=1,3
                  call check(pm(i,j),rm(i,j))
                  call check(lm(i,j),log(rm(i,j)))
                  call check(gm(i,j),rm(i,j)*(1-rm(i,j)))
               end do
            end do
            if(direction==1) then
               do j=1,4
                  call check(sum(pm(:,j)),1._real64)
               end do
            else
               do i=1,3
                  call check(sum(pm(i,:)),1._real64)
               end do
            end if
            if(any(xm/=savedm)) error stop 'Softmax matrix input preservation'
            matrices=matrices+1; entries=entries+12
         end do
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0)', 'Rational/log-ratio softmax references: vectors=',vectors,', matrices=',matrices, &
      ', entries per function=',entries
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-softmax-normalization-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      real(real64),intent(in) :: actual,expected
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'Nonfinite softmax result'
      if(abs(actual-expected)>3.e-12_real64) error stop 'Independent normalization reference'
   end subroutine
end program

   real(real64),allocatable :: values(:)

   integer :: ia,ib,n,i,count
   count=0

      do ib=-4,4
         a=real(ia,real64)/2; b=real(ib,real64)/2

            do i=1,n
               if(n==1) then
                  r=b; zr=zb
               else
                  r=(real(n-i,real64)*a+real(i-1,real64)*b)/real(n-1,real64)
                  zr=(real(n-i,real64)*za+real(i-1,real64)*zb)/real(n-1,real64)

               call check(values(i),r)

   print '(a)', 'Exact rational tolerance pairs: 289; matrix, componentwise complex and NaN policies checked'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-tolerance-comparison-reference'
end program

program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64, int64

   use stdlib_linalg, only: is_square, is_diagonal, is_symmetric, is_skew_symmetric, is_hermitian, &
      is_triangular, is_hessenberg
   implicit none

   real(real64),allocatable :: a(:,:)
   complex(real64),allocatable :: z(:,:)
   integer :: n,i,j,m,count
   logical :: diagonal
   count=0
   do n=1,8
      allocate(a(n,n),z(n,n)); a=0; z=0
      if(.not.is_square(a).or..not.is_diagonal(a).or..not.is_symmetric(a)) error stop 'Zero matrix structure'
      if(.not.is_skew_symmetric(a).or..not.is_hermitian(z)) error stop 'Zero symmetry structure'
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            a=0; z=0; a(i,j)=1; z(i,j)=cmplx(1._real64,1._real64,real64); diagonal=i==j
            if(is_diagonal(a).neqv.diagonal) error stop 'One-hot diagonality'
            if(is_diagonal(z).neqv.diagonal) error stop 'Complex one-hot diagonality'
            if(is_symmetric(a).neqv.diagonal) error stop 'One-hot symmetry'
            if(is_symmetric(z).neqv.diagonal) error stop 'Complex transpose symmetry'
            if(is_skew_symmetric(a).or.is_hermitian(z)) error stop 'One-hot skew/Hermitian rejection'
            if(is_triangular(a,'U').neqv.(i<=j)) error stop 'Upper triangle coordinate'
            if(is_triangular(a,'L').neqv.(i>=j)) error stop 'Lower triangle coordinate'
            if(is_hessenberg(a,'u').neqv.(i<=j+1)) error stop 'Upper Hessenberg coordinate'
            if(is_hessenberg(a,'l').neqv.(i>=j-1)) error stop 'Lower Hessenberg coordinate'
            if(is_triangular(z,'u').neqv.(i<=j)) error stop 'Complex upper triangle'
            if(is_hessenberg(z,'L').neqv.(i>=j-1)) error stop 'Complex lower Hessenberg'
            count=count+1
         end do
      end do
      if(n>=2) then
         a=0; a(1,n)=2; a(n,1)=2
         if(.not.is_symmetric(a).or.is_skew_symmetric(a)) error stop 'Positive symmetric pair'
         a(n,1)=-2
         if(.not.is_skew_symmetric(a).or.is_symmetric(a)) error stop 'Positive skew pair'
         z=0; z(1,n)=cmplx(1._real64,2._real64,real64); z(n,1)=cmplx(1._real64,-2._real64,real64)
         if(.not.is_hermitian(z).or.is_symmetric(z)) error stop 'Genuinely complex Hermitian pair'
      end if
      deallocate(a,z)
   end do
   do m=1,7
      do n=1,6
         allocate(a(m,n)); a=0
         if(is_square(a).neqv.(m==n)) error stop 'Rectangular squareness'
         deallocate(a)
      end do
   end do

   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-matrix-structure-reference'
end program

name: gams-minpack-analytic-jacobian-systems-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/integrals-tensors-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
module manufactured_system
   use minpack_module, only: wp,hybrj1
   implicit none
   integer :: function_calls=0,jacobian_calls=0
contains
   subroutine equations(n,x,f,jac,ldjac,iflag)
      integer,intent(in) :: n,ldjac
      integer,intent(inout) :: iflag
      real(wp),intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(wp),intent(inout) :: f(n),jac(ldjac,n)
      real(wp) :: u(n)
      integer :: i
      u=x-[(real(i,wp)/4,i=1,n)]
      if(iflag==1) then
         function_calls=function_calls+1
         f=u+u**3/8
         do i=2,n
            f(i)=f(i)+u(i-1)**2/4
         end do
      else if(iflag==2) then
         jacobian_calls=jacobian_calls+1; jac=0
         do i=1,n
            jac(i,i)=1+3*u(i)**2/8
            if(i>1) jac(i,i-1)=u(i-1)/2
         end do
      end if
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use manufactured_system
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp),allocatable :: x(:),f(:),jac(:,:),work(:),reference(:),expected(:)
   real(wp) :: maximum_error,residual
   integer :: n,k,scale,i,lwa,info,flag,cases
   cases=0; maximum_error=0; residual=0
   do n=2,6
      lwa=n*(n+13)/2
      allocate(x(n),f(n),jac(n,n),work(lwa),reference(n),expected(n))
      expected=[(real(i,wp)/4,i=1,n)]
      do k=1,3
         do scale=-2,1
            x=expected+[(real((-1)**(i+k),wp)*2._wp**scale*real(i+k,wp)/real(n+k,wp),i=1,n)]
            function_calls=0; jacobian_calls=0
            call hybrj1(equations,n,x,f,jac,n,1.e-10_wp,info,work,lwa)
            if(info/=1) error stop 'MINPACK convergence status'
            if(function_calls<=0.or.jacobian_calls<=0) error stop 'Callback paths not used'
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(f))) error stop 'Nonfinite root/residual'
            reference=x-expected
            do i=n,2,-1
               reference(i)=reference(i)+reference(i)**3/8+(x(i-1)-expected(i-1))**2/4
            end do
            reference(1)=reference(1)+reference(1)**3/8
            if(maxval(abs(reference))>1.e-8_wp.or.maxval(abs(x-expected))>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'Known root'
            if(maxval(abs(f-reference))>1.e-12_wp) error stop 'Returned residual consistency'
            maximum_error=max(maximum_error,maxval(abs(x-expected)))
            residual=max(residual,maxval(abs(reference))); cases=cases+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,f,jac,work,reference,expected)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known-root triangular nonlinear systems with analytic Jacobians: ',cases
   print '(a,es12.4,a,es12.4)', 'Maximum root error: ',maximum_error,'; residual: ',residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS minpack-analytic-jacobian-systems-reference'
end program

   implicit none
   real(wp),allocatable :: x(:),saved(:),effective(:),actual(:),restored(:),reference(:)
   real(wp) :: pi,angle,re,im
   integer :: m,n,mode,pattern,j,k,cases
   pi=acos(-1._wp); cases=0
   do m=4,16
      allocate(x(m))
      do pattern=0,3
         do j=1,m
            select case(pattern)
            case(0)
               x(j)=1
            case(1)
               x(j)=0
               if(j==2) x(j)=1
            case(2)
               x(j)=real((-1)**j*j,wp)/8
            case(3)
               x(j)=real(mod(j*j+3*j,11)-5,wp)/8
            end select
         end do
         saved=x
         do mode=0,2
            n=m
            if(mode==0) n=m-2
            if(mode==2) n=m+3
            allocate(effective(n),reference(n)); effective=0
            effective(:min(n,m))=x(:min(n,m)); reference(1)=sum(effective)
            do k=1,(n-1)/2
               re=0; im=0
               do j=0,n-1
                  angle=2*pi*real(j*k,wp)/real(n,wp)
                  re=re+effective(j+1)*cos(angle); im=im-effective(j+1)*sin(angle)
               end do
               reference(2*k)=re; reference(2*k+1)=im
            end do
            if(mod(n,2)==0) reference(n)=sum([(effective(j+1)*real((-1)**j,wp),j=0,n-1)])
            actual=rfft(x,n=n); restored=irfft(actual,n=n)/real(n,wp)
            if(size(actual)/=n.or.size(restored)/=n) error stop 'Real FFT output shape'
            do k=1,n
               call check(actual(k),reference(k)); call check(restored(k),effective(k))
            end do
            if(any(x/=saved)) error stop 'Real FFT source preservation'
            cases=cases+1; deallocate(effective,reference)
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x)
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Packed real DFT, odd/even lengths, truncation and zero-padding cases: ',cases
   print '(a)', 'PASS fftpack-packed-real-transforms-reference'

name: gams-specialmatrices-rectangular-poisson-reference
source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/transforms-structures-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use specialmatrices_poisson2D, only: Poisson2D,solve
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(Poisson2D) :: a
   real(wp),allocatable :: exact(:,:),rhs(:,:),b(:,:),saved(:,:),actual(:,:),vector(:),grid(:,:),residual(:,:)
   real(wp) :: lx,ly,hx,hy,x,y,pi,eigenvalue
   integer :: nx,ny,domain,problem,i,j,cases
   pi=acos(-1._wp); cases=0
   do nx=2,7
      do ny=2,7
         allocate(exact(nx,ny),rhs(nx,ny))
         do domain=1,2
            lx=real(domain,wp)/2; ly=real(domain+1,wp)/2
            hx=lx/real(nx+1,wp); hy=ly/real(ny+1,wp); a=Poisson2D(nx,ny,lx,ly)
            do problem=1,2
               eigenvalue=-4*sin(pi/(2*real(nx+1,wp)))**2/hx**2 &
                  -4*sin(pi/real(ny+1,wp))**2/hy**2
               do j=1,ny
                  y=hy*j
                  do i=1,nx
                     x=hx*i
                     if(problem==1) then
                        exact(i,j)=x*(lx-x)*y*(ly-y)
                        rhs(i,j)=-2*(x*(lx-x)+y*(ly-y))
                     else
                        exact(i,j)=sin(pi*real(i,wp)/real(nx+1,wp))*sin(2*pi*real(j,wp)/real(ny+1,wp))
                        rhs(i,j)=eigenvalue*exact(i,j)
                     end if
                  end do
               end do
               b=reshape([reshape(rhs,[nx*ny]),2*reshape(rhs,[nx*ny])],[nx*ny,2]); saved=b
               actual=solve(a,b); vector=solve(a,b(:,1)); grid=reshape(actual(:,1),[nx,ny])
               residual=-2*(1/hx**2+1/hy**2)*grid
               residual(2:nx,:)=residual(2:nx,:)+grid(:nx-1,:)/hx**2
               residual(:nx-1,:)=residual(:nx-1,:)+grid(2:nx,:)/hx**2
               residual(:,2:ny)=residual(:,2:ny)+grid(:,:ny-1)/hy**2
               residual(:,:ny-1)=residual(:,:ny-1)+grid(:,2:ny)/hy**2
               do j=1,ny
                  do i=1,nx
                     call check(grid(i,j),exact(i,j)); call check(residual(i,j),rhs(i,j))
                     call check(vector(i+(j-1)*nx),exact(i,j))
                     call check(actual(i+(j-1)*nx,2),2*exact(i,j))
                  end do
               end do
               if(any(b/=saved)) error stop 'Poisson RHS preservation'

source:
! Independent MIT consumer; see licenses/transforms-structures-ten-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use pchip_module, only: dpchia,dpchid
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter :: nodes(6)=[-1.0_wp,-0.5_wp,0.25_wp,1.0_wp,1.75_wp,3.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter :: values(1,6)=reshape([2.0_wp,-0.25_wp,0.5_wp,0.75_wp,-1.0_wp,1.5_wp],[1,6])
   real(wp),parameter :: slopes(1,6)=reshape([0.5_wp,-0.75_wp,1.0_wp,0.0_wp,1.25_wp,-0.5_wp],[1,6])
   real(wp) :: a,b,actual,expected,h,left,right,middle,offset,total,t,value
   integer :: i,j,k,sign,ier,cases
   logical :: skip
   cases=0
   do i=0,8
      a=nodes(1)+real(i,wp)*(nodes(6)-nodes(1))/8
      do j=0,8
         b=nodes(1)+real(j,wp)*(nodes(6)-nodes(1))/8
         expected=reference_integral(a,b); skip=.false.; ier=0
         actual=dpchia(6,nodes,values,slopes,1,skip,a,b,ier)
         if(ier/=0) error stop 'Hermite arbitrary-endpoint integral status'
         call check(actual,expected); cases=cases+1
      end do
   end do
   do i=1,6
      do j=1,6
         skip=.false.; ier=0
         actual=dpchid(6,nodes,values,slopes,1,skip,i,j,ier)
         if(ier/=0) error stop 'Hermite node-index integral status'
         call check(actual,reference_integral(nodes(i),nodes(j))); cases=cases+1
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Piecewise cubic integrals with arbitrary/reversed/node-index bounds: ',cases
   print '(a)', 'PASS pchip-hermite-integrals-reference'
contains
   function reference_integral(a,b) result(result)
      real(wp),intent(in) :: a,b
      real(wp) :: result,left,right,h,middle,offset,t,v
      integer :: i,side
      result=0
      do i=1,5
         left=max(min(a,b),nodes(i)); right=min(max(a,b),nodes(i+1))
         if(left>=right) cycle
         h=nodes(i+1)-nodes(i); middle=(left+right)/2; offset=(right-left)/(2*sqrt(3._wp))
         do side=-1,1,2
            t=(middle+side*offset-nodes(i))/h
            v=(2*t**3-3*t*t+1)*values(1,i)+(-2*t**3+3*t*t)*values(1,i+1) &
               +h*((t**3-2*t*t+t)*slopes(1,i)+(t**3-t*t)*slopes(1,i+1))
            result=result+(right-left)*v/2
         end do
      end do
      if(b<a) result=-result
   end function
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      real(wp),intent(in) :: actual,expected
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'Nonfinite result'
      if(abs(actual-expected)>2.e-9_wp*max(1._wp,abs(expected))) error stop 'Independent reference'
   end subroutine
end program
